About Lilly

At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients.

We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world.

Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve.

We bring our best to this work because people depend on it.

If you're driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.

About Lilly's India Affiliate

Few careers offer the opportunity to work directly for the people your work is ultimately meant to serve.

Lilly's India affiliate is one of them.

Whether you are building brand strategies, developing sales capabilities, creating market access, or enabling the teams that do — the work you do here ensures that Lilly's medicines reach the people who need them.

Job Description

The Clinical Development Consultant (CRL) is responsible for the management of clinical sites being considered and/or participating in Lilly clinical trials; inclusive of site identification and qualification, the timely delivery of clinical trial enrollment in accordance with scientific objectives, timely delivery of database locks, issues management at clinical trial sites, and ensuring inspection readiness at all times for assigned therapeutic area(s) within a region/country that enables global program delivery. This is achieved by the CRL's accountability for comprehensive site management, leveraging of information/tools to make/have informed decisions and discussions, and high-quality interactions with global clinical trial sites to drive to an unparallel customer experience. The CRL is also responsible for oversight of vendor monitoring activities at clinical trial sites, including the identification, mitigation and escalation of significant findings and trends. Additional local responsibilities may be required as needed/appropriate for the local geography.

Clinical Investigator Management

  • Accountable for activities required at clinical trial sites and by investigators and site staff participating in Lilly trials; inclusive of site identification and qualification, enrollment planning and execution, to database lock and close out
  • Accountable for comprehensive site management activities to ensure timely delivery of enrollment readiness, trial recruitment/enrollment and database locks; inclusive of performance management and issue mitigation, identification and resolution
  • Responsible for identifying potential opportunities to accelerate trial enrollment, while driving to an unparalleled clinical trial/customer experience
  • Accountable for the application of scientific, therapeutic area, and institutional/regional expertise to inform and ensure timely delivery of trial enrollment and quality data
  • Accountable for the development of strategic institutional/site relationships to optimize the delivery of clinical trial programs; including across therapeutic areas where applicable

Clinical Trial Management


  • Responsible for the development and implementation of applicable site risk plans to ensure delivery of clinical trial enrollment commitments and database locks
  • Ensure site and country level inspection readiness at all times
  • Leverage metrics to inform site/country/regional level decision making
  • Work with internal and external teams to remove barriers to trial execution at a site and/or country level
  • Responsible for understanding local treatment paradigms and standard of care to support targeted feasibility and strategic allocation of trials as required
  • Provide vendor oversight for site monitoring activities at site/country level

Business Management and Engagement


  • Establishes and develops strong professional relationships with active/potential clinical investigators to expand/maintain clinical research partnership opportunities and provide an unparalleled experience for participation in Lilly clinical trials
  • Cross functional collaboration and partnership to ensure alignment in priorities and deliver the portfolio
  • Perform targeted sites prospecting in alignment with portfolio strategy & priority
  • Maintain therapeutic and technical expertise to enable scientific discussions with the investigator and site personnel
  • Serve as an effective communication bridge between sites, third party vendors and Lilly
  • Influence and challenge internal and external factors in order to improve clinical research delivery

Minimum Qualification Requirements


  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Minimum of 8–10 years experience in the pharmaceutical industry and/or clinical research and strong working knowledge of Good Clinical Practice
  • Therapeutic expertise and knowledge of the clinical research landscape; ability to acquire and maintain therapeutic expertise to support portfolio needs
  • Strong self-management and organizational skills; ability to manage workload, set personal priorities and adjust as needed
  • Demonstrated strategic agility & broad business acumen

jobs.description:
Ventra is a leading business solutions provider for facility-based physicians practicing anesthesia, emergency medicine, hospital medicine, pathology, and radiology. Job Summary

  • The Vendor Performance and Operations Analyst play a critical operational role in the Patient Responsibility Center of Excellence by providing real-time data monitoring, quality assurance, and performance analytics across all self-pay vendors. This position is responsible for continuously validating vendor input and output data, developing and maintaining performance scorecards, identifying trends and anomalies, and delivering actionable insights to support vendor management and operational optimization.

  • Develop and maintain escalation protocols for data quality issues, vendor performance problems, and SLA breaches.

  • Demonstrated experience with vendor performance monitoring or third-party management.
  • Experience developing performance dashboards, scorecards, or KPI tracking systems.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities


  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with ability to translate data into actionable insights.
  • Deep understanding of revenue cycle workflows, particularly self-pay operations.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, data analysis, dashboard creation).
  • Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Google Analytics, or similar).
  • Familiarity with SQL and ability to query databases to extract and analyze data.
  • Experience with healthcare billing systems or platforms (Epic, Cerner, Athena, or similar).
  • Knowledge of healthcare compliance requirements and billing regulations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to present data to non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Collaborative team player with strong cross-functional communication skills.
  • Proactive approach to identifying and addressing issues before they escalate.
  • Ability to learn new systems and tools quickly.
  • Customer service orientation with focus on delivering value to internal stakeholders.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

Serve as a subject matter expert in learning and development for a global organization designing and delivering training focused on benefits open enrollment HIPAA compliance and payer and provider processes. Partner with stakeholders to build effective hybrid learning experiences for night shift teams that improve compliance operational accuracy and service quality.

Responsibilities

  • Design and deliver structured learning programs that strengthen understanding of benefits open enrollment processes for hybrid night shift teams in provider and payer environments.
  • Develop detailed learning materials that translate complex HIPAA compliance rules into clear and practical guidance tailored for operations and support staff.
  • Conduct engaging virtual and in person training sessions that focus on real world payer and provider scenarios to improve accuracy and consistency in daily tasks.
  • Analyze training feedback and performance metrics to refine course content so that programs continuously improve and remain aligned with business goals.
  • Collaborate with operations managers and process experts to identify learning gaps related to benefits open enrollment workflows and create targeted training interventions.

  • Coordinate with quality and compliance teams to ensure that training for night shift staff reduces errors and supports audit readiness across processes.
  • Use learning management systems to schedule sessions enroll participants track completion and generate reports for stakeholders in a timely manner.
  • Provide one on one coaching and small group refreshers for individuals who need additional support with HIPAA or benefits open enrollment topics.
  • Partner with workforce management and human resources teams to align training calendars with business volumes while respecting hybrid work patterns and night shift schedules.
  • Support new hire onboarding by integrating foundational modules on payer and provider operations into structured learning paths that accelerate job readiness.
  • Document training outcomes and share concise insights with leaders so that learning initiatives clearly demonstrate value to clients and the wider healthcare ecosystem.

Qualifications

  • possess a bachelors degree or equivalent experience in fields such as human resources education healthcare administration or business with a strong focus on learning and development.

  • manage multiple training requests and timelines while maintaining attention to detail and meeting commitments without the need for travel.

  • work comfortably in cross functional teams that span operations quality compliance and human resources with a focus on shared outcomes and learner success.

Refraction accuracy programme

Competency certification ladder

Eye exam NPS improvement

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Introduction

Availity is one of the leading health information networks in the United States, processing more than 4 billion transactions annually and connecting more than two million healthcare providers and over two thousand technology partners to health plans nationwide. Our teams of technology, business, and customer service professionals in Bangalore, India, are working together to transform healthcare delivery in the United States through innovation and collaboration. Our technologists help develop cutting-edge revenue cycle solutions that help hospitals, health systems, and physicians maximize payments and optimize their workflows.

Availity is a diverse group of people whose talents, curiosity and passion steer the company to create innovative solutions for the US Healthcare industry. If you are a driven, creative and collaborative individual, with exceptional technology skills to drive innovation, we want to hear from you.

Job Description

Debugs software products through the use of systematic tests to develop, apply and maintain quality standards for firm products. Develops, modifies and executes software test plans, automated scripts and programs for testing. Analyzes and writes test standards and procedures. Maintains documentation of test results to assist in debugging and modification of software. Analyzes test results to ensure existing functionality and recommends corrective action. Consults with development engineers in resolution of problems. Provides feedback in preparation of technical appraisals of programming languages, systems and computation software. Ensures quality computer integration into the overall functions of scientific computation, data acquisition and processing.

Roles & Responsibilities

About Availity

Availity is a leading healthcare technology company focused on simplifying healthcare administration and solving real-world challenges for healthcare providers, health plans, and patients. Our technology helps reduce complexity so providers can spend less time navigating administrative systems and more time focused on patient care.

About Availity India

Availity India is an important part of Availity's global growth journey. Based in Bengaluru, our India teams partner closely with U.S. and global stakeholders across technology, product, operations, customer support, and corporate functions.

Our India organization is being built with a strong focus on ownership, learning, collaboration, engineering excellence, and meaningful business impact. Associates in India have the opportunity to solve complex problems, contribute to global initiatives, and support products and services that are part of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Quality Assurance Engineer to join our team in Bengaluru. You will be responsible for continuously improving the quality of the Availity's product line by

preventing, quickly detecting, and validating product and process defects, delivering market and customer-driven business results. You will evaluate the test results, prepare change requests, and generate measures to assess product quality. In this role, you will work with an integrated team of developers, product managers, product owners, and system analysts for test planning, test automation and execution, and product validation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build automation frameworks from scratch and enhance existing ones.
  • Author Gherkin feature files and maintains step definitions.
  • Execute automated test suites and maintain test stability.
  • Participate in grooming sessions and contribute to acceptance criteria.
  • Ensure comprehensive coverage of functional, regression, and integration tests.
  • Troubleshoot automation failures and improve test resilience.
  • Work closely with Dev teams to run automation in distributed environments.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years in software testing with at least 2years in automation.
  • Expertise in Selenium WebDriver and Cucumber BDD frameworks.
  • Good Java coding background.
  • Experience with CI/CD environments and Git workflows.
  • Knowledge of testing REST APIs and microservices.
  • Experience with Docker, AWS/Azure (good to have).
  • Strong analytical mindset and leadership ability.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with U.S. or global stakeholders.
  • Experience in healthcare technology, SaaS, product engineering, operations, shared services, or customer-facing environments.
  • Excellent communication. Absolutely, essential to perform at maximum efficiency within the team.
  • Strong problem-solving, ownership, and execution mindset.
  • Experience in a fast-growing or scaling organization.
  • Experience working in a matrixed reporting structure.

Why Join Availity India

  • Meaningful impact: Work on solutions that help simplify healthcare administration and support better provider and patient experiences.
  • Global exposure: Partner with U.S. teams and leaders while contributing from India to global business priorities.
  • Learning and growth: Be part of a culture that values continuous learning, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and career development.
  • Flexible work experience: Work in a way that supports productivity, collaboration, and team needs across remote, hybrid, and office-based models.
  • Holistic rewards: Benefit from competitive compensation, health and insurance benefits, paid time off, company holidays, leave benefits, Employee Assistance Program support, and learning programs.
  • Inclusive workplace: Join a casual, collaborative, and inclusive environment where associates are encouraged to bring ideas forward.
  • Office experience: For office-based associates, Availity India provides amenities such as coffee and tea, subsidized meals, recreation areas, and eligible night-shift transportation support.

What To Expect From The Hiring Process

Our hiring process is designed to be transparent and engaging. Depending on the role, it may include application review, recruiter discussion, technical or functional assessment, hiring manager interviews, team or leadership conversations, offer discussion, background verification, and onboarding support.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Availity is committed to building an inclusive workplace where all associates feel valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and encourage individuals who are excited by collaboration, innovation, and meaningful impact to apply.

Eligibility

Video Camera Usage

Availity fosters a collaborative and open culture where communication and engagement are central to our success. As a remote first company, we are also camera-first and provide all associates with camera/video capability to simulate the office environment. If you are not able to use your camera for all virtual meetings, you should not apply for this role.

Having cameras on helps create a more connected, interactive, and productive environment, allowing teams to communicate more effectively and build stronger working relationships. The usage of cameras also enhances security and protects sensitive company information. Video participation is required to ensure that only authorized personnel are present in meetings and to prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, preventing social engineering, or the sharing of confidential information with non-participants.

    • Coordinate drafting, negotiation, execution, amendments, and closeout of contracts.

    • Coordinate with Procurement, Legal, Finance, Compliance, Quality, and 3rd parties to support drafting, negotiation, execution, and issue resolution.

    • Ensure contract delivery complies with Takeda policies, financial controls, quality requirements, healthcare compliance obligations, and applicable transparency reporting requirements.
    • Manage supplier onboarding/updates, contract records, purchase order approval, invoice reconciliation, accruals, and related system activities.
    • Oversee proper purchase order (PO) approval and management, invoice reconciliation, and accrual reporting related to contracts. Where relevant, ensures on-time delivery of transparency reporting requirements.
  • Engage with external stakeholders.
  • Provide advanced guidance and training to junior staff.
DIMENSIONS AND ASPECTS:

  • Strong project management skills and demonstrated ability to act independently through complex cross-functional matrices.
  • Proactive, resourceful, self-motivated, and possess good interpersonal skills to interact professionally with all levels in the organization.
  • Excellent general problem-solving skills and a proven ability to manage multiple projects and to organize complex tasks. Recognize process improvement opportunities and makes recommendations.
  • Accurate and precise communication skills are necessary with experience of international partnerships with multiple international contributors to individual projects.
  • Strong knowledge of procurement & financial systems such as Ariba, MDG, legal CLMs, Medispend, salesforce, Microsoft office, Power BI and Power Automate.
  • Excellent understanding of contracting requirements in line with Takeda policies and external regulations.
  • Negotiation skills (internal and external facing)

Leadership:

  • Enterprise level leadership with the ability to inspire, motivate and drive results.
  • Ability to distil complex issues and ideas down to simple comprehensible terms, and to present complex information clearly and with confidence.
  • Excellent communicator, able to persuasively convey both ideas and data, verbally and in writing.
  • Proven skills as an effective team player who can engender credibility and confidence within and outside the company.
  • Leads small functional teams or projects ; represent the organization in project or contractual matters
  • Ability to provide guidance and coach junior team members.
  • Embrace and demonstrate a diversity and inclusion mindset and role -model these behaviors for the organization.
  • Champion diversity.

Interaction:

  • Effectively represents function in negotiations with the ability to resolve conflict in a constructive manner.
  • Ability to build strong relationships and collaborate effectively across Takeda functions and geographies

  • capable of independently managing and improving organization structures and processes
  • can coach others in effective organization
  • Role models respect and inclusion, creating a culture that fosters innovation.

Complexity:

  • Ability to work in a global ecosystem (internal and external) with a high degree of complexity.
  • Ability to see and understand broader, enterprise level perspective.

EDUCATION, BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCIES AND SKILLS :

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in, life sciences, law, procurement, or a related field
  • Excellent English proficiency essential, including the ability to work with English-language contractual and business documentation.

jobs.description:
About Qure.AI:

Qure.AI is the world's fastest-growing medical AI company, boasting an impressive 13 FDA and 62 CE marking clearances to date. We develop cutting-edge solutions that significantly enhance patient outcomes across various care domains, including lung cancer, tuberculosis, and stroke. Our innovative technologies have positively impacted over 22 million patients in more than 90 countries worldwide. At Qure.ai, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

About the job

Job Title: Clinical Research Scientist – Oncology

Department: Operations - Health Economics and Outcomes Research

Location: Mumbai or Bangalore, India

Years of Experience: 5-8 years

Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent

Key Relationships

Vice President – Operations, Operational Research and Impact Measurement

Job Description

Qure.ai is seeking an experienced Clinical Research Scientist to lead the design and execution of high-quality clinical research studies that generate evidence for our AI-enabled oncology solutions, with a primary focus on lung health applications in the United States market. This is an India-based full-time role focused on research on AI-enabled novel disease detection pathways within the US healthcare ecosystem. The role will involve developing real-world evidence and prospective study protocols, supporting peer-reviewed scientific dissemination, and partnering with pharmaceutical, academic, and health-system collaborators, including providers and payers across the US.

This position requires strong scientific rigour, the ability to translate clinical needs into robust study designs, and comfort operating in the interdisciplinary, fast-paced environments typical of healthcare AI. While prior research experience in oncology and/or lung health is welcomed, a strong foundation in clinical research methodology combined with a genuine interest in AI applications for oncology is what we are most looking for.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Support the design and execution of retrospective, prospective, reader, real-world evidence, validation and implementation studies to demonstrate the clinical utility, real-world impact, and effectiveness of Qure's AI solutions for early detection and improved patient outcomes.
  • Develop study protocols, statistical analysis plans, case report forms, and IRB documentation aligned with US clinical practice workflows.
  • Support real-world evidence (RWE) studies leveraging US data sources, including claims, electronic health records, and oncology registries, often in partnership with pharmaceutical collaborators and academic medical centers.
  • Collaborate with Product, Business Development, and R&D teams to ensure clinical studies align with product adoption and market access goals within the US market.
  • Engage with principal investigators, clinicians, external experts, key opinion leaders, CROs, pharmaceutical stakeholders, and other research partners to validate study designs, ensure rigorous study execution and generate high-quality evidence for publication.
  • Conduct data quality review, ground-truth adjudication processes, study monitoring, and issue resolution in collaboration with clinical, technical and operational stakeholders.
  • Draft scientific manuscripts, abstracts, posters, conference presentations, white papers, technical reports for dissemination of research findings through publication in peer-reviewed journals, conference abstracts, posters, and oral presentations at major oncology and imaging meetings.
  • Conduct targeted and systematic literature reviews to inform study design, protocol development, clinical assumptions, endpoint selection, and publication planning.
  • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of the US lung health landscape, including relevant clinical guidelines, screening pathways, reimbursement context, and adoption considerations for AI-enabled technologies.
  • Help translate research findings and real-world evidence on clinical and health system outcomes and into clear scientific narratives for external stakeholders, including clinicians, providers, payers, life sciences partners, and policy stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of SOPs, study templates, and internal frameworks for clinical research execution at Qure.ai.
  • Ensure high standards of scientific integrity, documentation, regulatory compliance, and reproducibility across all clinical research outputs.

Skills and Expertise

  • Master's degree (minimum) in a relevant discipline such as Clinical Research, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Translational Science or a related quantitative field; candidates with MD, MD-PhD, or PhD qualifications are strongly encouraged to apply.
  • 5–8 years of relevant experience in clinical research, real-world evidence generation, or evidence-based medicine within pharmaceutical, medical device, CRO, academic, or healthcare AI environments.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and executing clinical research studies, including protocol development, endpoint definition, study documentation, statistical analysis, and manuscript writing.
  • Familiarity with study designs across observational, prospective cohort studies, randomized controlled trials, and real-world evidence methodologies.
  • Direct experience supporting US-based clinical research and working knowledge of the US healthcare context is a strong advantage.
  • Demonstrated Proficiency in Python or R or similar tools for statistical analysis.
  • Strong grasp of biostatistics including sample size calculations and advanced statistical analysis, especially in multi-centre study designs.
  • Demonstrated scientific writing skills with a track record of peer-reviewed publications, conference proceedings, or other academic outputs.

  • Self-driven and detail-oriented, with the ability to take ownership of projects in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Other Considerations

jobs.title: Senior RWD Analyst
jobs.description:
Position Summary

NeuroDiscovery AI leverages large-scale healthcare data across neurological diseases to generate biomarker-driven insights that support drug discovery and development. The Senior RWD Analyst owns the real-world data layer that makes those insights possible — turning raw claims, EHR, and registry data into curated, validated, analysis-ready assets.

This role is responsible for the data side of the study lifecycle: sourcing and profiling datasets, standardizing them, building reusable cohort and feature logic, and enforcing the quality controls that downstream RWE analysts and scientists depend on. The Senior Analyst operates independently, partners closely with data engineering and RWE, and strengthens data-quality best practices across the analytics function.

  • Ingest, transform, and standardize large-scale claims, EHR, and registry data into analysis-ready form
  • Develop and maintain reusable cohort definitions, code sets, and feature libraries for downstream RWE use
  • Build and optimize advanced SQL pipelines for large healthcare datasets
  • Profile data for completeness, consistency, and plausibility; build and run structured data-quality checks
  • Conduct detailed QC of data outputs, including review of other analysts data work
  • Document data provenance, transformations, assumptions, and known data caveats
  • Ensure reproducibility and validation across data pipelines
  • Partner with RWE analysts and data engineering to translate study needs into data requirements
  • Contribute to development of data standards and process improvements

    • 3–6 years of experience in RWD, RWE, healthcare analytics, or pharmaceutical research
    • Advanced SQL and strong Python proficiency
    • Hands-on experience with healthcare data (claims, EHR, registries)
    • Strong track record in data quality, validation, and documentation
    • Familiarity with common data models (OMOP, CDM) a plus
    • Familiarity with epidemiology and outcomes research a plus
    • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills
    • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment

About the Role

We are looking for a Pharmacist who is careful, responsible, and enjoys working with medicines and prescriptions. In this role, you will read handwritten prescriptions (Parchis), convert them into digital records, and check that the information is correct. You will identify the right medicines, brands, strengths, and quantities, and enter them into our system with high accuracy. Your work helps customers receive the correct medicines and helps our team process orders quickly and safely. You will also work closely with other teams whenever a prescription needs clarification or additional checks.

Key Responsibilities

·       Read handwritten prescriptions (Parchis) and convert them into accurate digital records.

·       Identify the correct medicine name, strength, dosage, quantity, and other prescription details.

·       Annotate prescriptions with complete and correct information in the system.

·       Search medicine databases and verify medicine brands, compositions, and alternatives whenever required.

·       Maintain accurate medicine and prescription data in company systems.

·       Inform the team if a prescription is unclear, incomplete, or needs clarification.

·       Follow company SOPs and pharmacy guidelines while processing every prescription.

·       Complete daily work targets without compromising accuracy or quality.

·       Keep all patient and prescription information confidential and handle it responsibly.

Skills & Competencies

·       Good knowledge of medicines, brands, generic compositions, and prescriptions.

·       Strong attention to detail and ability to spot small mistakes.

·       Basic computer skills and comfort using digital systems.

·       Good communication skills to work with internal teams.

·       Ability to stay focused while handling repetitive work.

·       Knowledge of pharmaceutical regulations, production, quality assurance, formulation, or distribution will be an added advantage.

Success Metrics / KPIs

·       Convert 90–120 prescriptions (Parchis) every day with less than 10% error.

·       Accurately annotate 50–60 prescriptions every day.

·       Maintain high quality and accuracy in all prescription records.

·       Complete work within the required timelines.

·       Follow all SOPs and quality standards consistently.

What We're Looking For

·       Pays close attention to details and likes doing accurate work.

·       Responsible and takes ownership of assigned work.

·       Has a strong work ethic and completes tasks on time.

·       Curious and willing to learn about new medicines and processes.

·       Works well independently and as part of a team.

·       Maintains confidentiality and handles information with care.

About the Company

SayaCare is a fast-growing e-health company that makes healthcare simple, affordable, and easy to access. We use technology to help people get genuine medicines and trusted healthcare services across India. Our team believes in learning, teamwork, ownership, and always doing what is right for the customer. If you want to build a career where your work has a real impact on people's health, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: NOC Senior Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Introduction

Availity is one of the leading health information networks in the United States, processing more than 4 billion transactions annually and connecting more than two million healthcare providers and over two thousand technology partners to health plans nationwide. Our teams of technology, business, and customer service professionals in Bangalore, India, are working together to transform healthcare delivery in the United States through innovation and collaboration. Our technologists help develop cutting-edge revenue cycle solutions that help hospitals, health systems, and physicians maximize payments and optimize their workflows.

Availity is a diverse group of people whose talents, curiosity and passion steer the company to create innovative solutions for the US Healthcare industry. If you are a driven, creative and collaborative individual, with exceptional technology skills to drive innovation, we want to hear from you.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced NOC Senior Engineer to support 24x7 operations, major incident management, cloud infrastructure support, and operational excellence initiatives. This is a senior hands-on role responsible for advanced technical troubleshooting, L3 escalations, proactive monitoring, automation, and ensuring the reliability and availability of critical production systems across cloud, infrastructure, and platform environments.

Roles & Responsibilities

About Availity

Availity is a leading healthcare technology company focused on simplifying healthcare administration and solving real-world challenges for healthcare providers, health plans, and patients. Our technology helps reduce complexity, so providers can spend less time navigating administrative systems and more time focused on patient care.

About Availity India

Availity India is an important part of Availity's global growth journey. Based in Bengaluru, our India teams partner closely with U.S. and global stakeholders across technology, product, operations, customer support, and corporate functions.

Our India organization is being built with a strong focus on ownership, learning, collaboration, engineering excellence, and meaningful business impact. Associates in India have the opportunity to solve complex problems, contribute to global initiatives, and support products and services that are part of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced NOC Senior Engineer to support 24x7 operations, major incident management, cloud infrastructure support, and operational excellence initiatives. This is a senior hands-on role responsible for advanced technical troubleshooting, L3 escalations, proactive monitoring, automation, and ensuring the reliability and availability of critical production systems across cloud, infrastructure, and platform environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the L3 technical escalation point and senior authority for P1/P2 incidents.
  • Lead incident triage, stabilization, recovery efforts, and operational restoration during major outages.
  • Collaborate with Major Incident Managers, Operations teams, and engineering stakeholders during critical incidents.
  • Ensure adherence to SLA, MTTR, and MTTA targets.
  • Support and execute incident command processes, escalation control, and stakeholder communication.
  • Own proactive monitoring effectiveness across infrastructure, cloud, and platform services.
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring tools, including Splunk, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Grafana, and Prometheus.
  • Manage AWS operational environments including EC2, VPC, Route 53, Security Groups, Load Balancers, CloudWatch, EKS, and RDS.
  • Support Azure operations, Azure SQL, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics environments.
  • Troubleshoot Linux and Windows server environments.
  • Support Kubernetes (EKS) infrastructure, containerized workloads, and platform reliability.
  • Drive automation and operational efficiency using Terraform, PowerShell, Bash, and Python.
  • Participate in RCA reviews, Problem Management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Analyze alert noise, optimize monitoring thresholds, and improve operational visibility.
  • Mentor NOC Engineers and provide technical leadership during assigned shifts.
  • Ensure operational continuity through structured shift handovers and follow-the-sun support models.

Required Qualifications

  • 7-10 years of experience in NOC Operations, SRE, Cloud Operations, Infrastructure Support, or Production Support environments.
  • Strong experience handling P1/P2 incidents and serving as an advanced technical escalation point.
  • Hands-on operational experience with AWS cloud services.
  • Experience supporting Azure infrastructure and services.
  • Strong Linux and Windows administration and troubleshooting skills.
  • Hands-on experience with Splunk and enterprise monitoring platforms.
  • Experience with Kubernetes (EKS), containerized environments, and cloud-native operations.
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts including DNS, Routing, Load Balancing, Firewalls, Security Groups, and Connectivity Troubleshooting.
  • Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, or equivalent ITSM platforms.
  • Automation and scripting experience using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar technologies.
  • Experience working in 24x7 operational environments with rotational shift models.
  • Strong communication, technical leadership, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, New Relic, AppDynamics, or Site24x7.
  • Working knowledge of Terraform, Infrastructure as Code, Git, Rundeck, and CI/CD concepts.
  • Understanding IAM, cloud security monitoring, vulnerability management, and security incident response.
  • Exposure to SRE principles, observability engineering, and reliability practices.
  • Experience in Healthcare Technology environments.
  • HIPAA awareness and compliance knowledge.
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional.
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA).
  • ITIL Foundation Certification.

Why Join Availity India

  • Meaningful impact: Work on solutions that help simplify healthcare administration and support better provider and patient experiences.
  • Global exposure: Partner with U.S. teams and leaders while contributing from India to global business priorities.
  • Learning and growth: Be part of a culture that values continuous learning, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and career development.
  • Flexible work experience: Work in a way that supports productivity, collaboration, and team needs across remote, hybrid, and office-based models.
  • Holistic rewards: Benefit from competitive compensation, health and insurance benefits, paid time off, company holidays, leave benefits, Employee Assistance Program support, and learning programs.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in cloud networking, routing and switching, network security, observability platforms, and incident management within a global enterprise environment supporting business-critical platforms across multiple regions and time zones.

About The Role

EzyHelpers is a trusted home care and domestic helper service provider based in Bangalore. We help families find reliable, trained, and verified caregivers, nursing assistants, home helpers, cooks, nannies, elderly care attendants, and patient care support staff. As we expand our healthcare and caregiving services, we are looking for a dedicated and responsible Care Coordinator – Home Healthcare who understands the caregiving ecosystem and can coordinate effectively with nurses, physiotherapists, caregivers, patients, and families.

This is an office-based coordination and operations role. You will understand patient and family requirements, coordinate with staff nurses, nursing assistants, physiotherapists, and caregivers, manage caregiver availability, and ensure smooth, timely service delivery and follow-up for clients. The ideal candidate has experience across elderly care, patient care, post-operative care, palliative care, physiotherapy support coordination, and home-based caregiving services.

What you'll do

Your day-to-day responsibilities

  • Speak with families to understand care requirements in detail — elderly, post-operative, palliative, bedridden, dementia, physiotherapy support, general caregiving, or nursing support.
  • Ask the right questions to assess the patient's condition, mobility level, medical dependency, food habits, language preference, duty timings, and family expectations; document everything in the internal tracker.
  • Coordinate with staff nurses, nursing assistants, GDA/ANM/GNM candidates, physiotherapists, and caregivers; check availability, experience, location, language skills, and suitability.
  • Match the right caregiver or healthcare support staff to client needs, and brief them on patient condition, family expectations, hygiene standards, duty timings, and responsibilities before assignment.
  • Manage day-to-day coordination between clients, caregivers, nurses, physiotherapists, and internal teams; follow up after placement to ensure satisfaction.
  • Resolve issues around caregiver behaviour, attendance, duty understanding, replacements, or service gaps; arrange replacements and ensure continuity of care without disruption.
  • Help families choose the right level of care based on the patient's condition, and escalate medical or clinical concerns to qualified professionals when needed.
  • Screen and profile caregivers, nursing assistants, staff nurses, and physiotherapists by skills, past cases, language, location, salary expectation, shift preference, and availability; maintain an updated staff database.
  • Maintain polite, clear, professional communication with families; give realistic updates without overpromising and handle concerns with empathy and ownership.
  • Coordinate with the sales and operations team for closures and service delivery.
  • Maintain accurate records of requirements, staff profiles, placements, follow-ups, complaints, replacements, and service status; prepare daily/weekly reports on active cases, pending requirements, staff availability, and escalations.

What we're looking for

Skills And Experience Required

  • 2–3 years of experience in home healthcare operations, elderly/patient care coordination, nursing bureau or caregiver placement, hospital discharge or physiotherapy service coordination, palliative care support, healthcare customer support, or medical/nursing staff coordination.
  • Good understanding of home healthcare and caregiving services and the ability to understand patient and elderly care requirements.
  • Strong communication in English and Hindi; Kannada is an added advantage.
  • Ability to coordinate with caregivers, nurses, physiotherapists, and families.
  • Strong follow-up and documentation skills.
  • Empathy and patience while handling families and elderly care cases, including sensitive healthcare conversations.
  • Good judgment in matching the right caregiver to the right family.
  • Comfortable working from the office 6 days a week.
  • Basic computer knowledge — Google Sheets, Excel, WhatsApp, CRM, or internal tracking tools.

Nice to have

Bonus points if you have these

  • Background in healthcare, home healthcare, nursing bureau, elderly care, rehabilitation, physiotherapy coordination, or patient care services.
  • Experience dealing with elderly patients, bedridden patients, post-operative cases, or palliative care cases.
  • Experience speaking with staff nurses, physiotherapists, nursing assistants, caregivers, and patient families.
  • Graduate in any discipline; healthcare management, nursing-related qualification, or GDA/ANM/GNM/B.Sc Nursing exposure (formal medical qualification not mandatory).
  • Calm under pressure with the ability to solve operational issues quickly and balance client expectations with staff availability.

Care knowledge areas

  • Elderly care, post-operative care, and palliative care.
  • Bedridden patient support and stroke recovery support.
  • Dementia and Alzheimer's care; mobility support.
  • Physiotherapy coordination; patient hygiene and feeding support.
  • Medicine reminder support and hospital-to-home transition care.

Key performance indicators

  • Number of care requirements successfully coordinated.
  • Quality of caregiver and nurse matching.
  • Client satisfaction after placement.
  • Timely follow-ups and issue resolution.
  • Accuracy of documentation and reporting.
  • Reduction in replacement cases due to better matching.
  • Speed of coordination between client and care staff.
  • Quality of communication with families and internal teams.

Work setup & compensation

  • Full-time, office-based role at our HSR Layout, Bangalore office.
  • Working days: 6 days a week.
  • Salary based on experience, communication skills, healthcare exposure, and ability to manage care coordination responsibilities.

Why join EzyHelpers

  • Work in a fast-growing home healthcare and caregiving company.
  • Meaningful work that directly supports elderly people, patients, and families.
  • Exposure to healthcare operations, caregiver management, and client coordination.
  • Growth as EzyHelpers expands deeper into elderly care, patient care, and professional home caregiving.
  • A mission-driven team that values dignity, reliability, and care.

What if your expertise in genomics and clinical data could directly shape how AI understands and advances personalized medicine for millions of patients worldwide We're looking for a Precision Medicine Data Lead to bring deep domain knowledge to cutting-edge AI training projects — helping ensure that the models influencing healthcare and life sciences research are built on a foundation of rigorous, expertly governed data.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role designed for experienced professionals in healthcare data, genomics, or life sciences analytics who want to apply their skills at the frontier of AI development.

  • Lead analytical strategies that transform complex, integrated datasets into actionable insights for precision medicine and clinical research applications
  • Assess and improve how AI systems interpret, reason about, and generate healthcare and genomic data

Who You Are

  • Experienced working with large-scale healthcare, genomic, or life sciences datasets in analytics or data leadership roles

  • Skilled at translating complex, multi-modal data into clear, meaningful insights for scientific and clinical audiences
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with clinical, research, and engineering teams in regulated or highly technical settings
  • Detail-oriented and rigorous — you hold yourself to high standards of accuracy and scientific integrity

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience with data annotation, data quality review, or AI evaluation workflows
  • Familiarity with precision medicine frameworks, EHR systems, or genomic data platforms
  • Background in bioinformatics, clinical informatics, or translational research
  • Experience communicating data findings to non-technical clinical or executive stakeholders

Why Join Us

  • Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you

Architectural Finishes and Interior Fit-Out Management
jobs.description:
Job Title

Project Engineer

Job Description Summary

We are seeking an experienced and results-oriented Project Engineer (Finishes) to lead and manage all architectural, interior fit-out, and finishing works for a large-scale hospital construction project in Bengaluru. The role will be responsible for planning, coordinating, executing, and delivering high-quality finishing works in compliance with project specifications, healthcare standards, budget requirements, and construction schedules.

The ideal candidate should possess strong experience in hospital, healthcare, hotel, commercial, projects and demonstrate expertise in managing multidisciplinary teams, specialist subcontractors, and complex stakeholder interfaces.

Job Description

About the Role

  • Develop and implement detailed execution plans for architectural and interior finishing works.
  • Prepare area-wise and milestone-based finishing schedules aligned with the overall project programme.
  • Monitor progress against planned targets and implement corrective actions to mitigate delays.
  • Ensure timely completion of all finishing activities while maintaining quality, safety, and cost objectives.
  • Coordinate with clients, consultants, Contractors, architects, and MEP teams to ensure seamless project execution.
  • Review construction drawings, specifications, room data sheets, and finish schedules for constructability and completeness.
  • Resolve design and site-related issues through effective coordination with relevant stakeholders.
  • Ensure timely availability of approved drawings and technical documentation for execution.
  • Prepare procurement plans and material delivery schedules for finishing works.
  • Coordinate with procurement teams to ensure timely sourcing and delivery of approved materials.
  • Review material submittals, mock-ups, and samples for compliance with project specifications.
  • Monitor material consumption, wastage, and storage practices at site.
  • Lead execution of architectural finishes including flooring, wall finishes, ceilings, painting, joinery, partition systems, and interior fit-out works.
  • Manage specialist subcontractors and ensure adherence to approved methodologies and quality standards.
  • Coordinate with MEP and medical equipment installation teams to ensure smooth interface management.
  • Drive productivity improvements and optimize resource deployment.
  • Ensure all works are executed in accordance with approved specifications, quality standards, and healthcare requirements.
  • Establish benchmark areas and mock-ups for approval before large-scale implementation.
  • Conduct regular inspections and quality audits.
  • Monitor closure of non-conformance reports (NCRs), defects, and punch list items.
  • Promote and enforce compliance with project health, safety, and environmental requirements.
  • Ensure safe execution of all finishing activities and maintain high standards of housekeeping.
  • Participate in safety inspections, audits, and incident investigations as required.

Cost & Commercial Management

  • Monitor project budgets related to finishing works and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
  • Review subcontractor progress, measurements, and payment certifications.
  • Evaluate variations and change requests and provide recommendations to project management.
  • Coordinate completion and readiness of areas for testing and commissioning activities.
  • Ensure timely closure of snag lists and punch points.
  • Support phased handover activities and preparation of project close-out documentation.
  • Ensure delivery of completed areas in a patient-ready condition.
  • Lead coordination meetings with clients, consultants, contractors, and vendors.
  • Prepare and present weekly and monthly progress reports.
  • Escalate critical issues and recommend mitigation measures to senior management.
  • Foster collaborative relationships among project stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management.
  • Professional certifications in Project Management will be an added advantage.
  • 10–12 years of overall experience in building construction projects.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience managing finishing works for hospital, healthcare, pharmaceutical, commercial, or institutional projects.
  • Proven experience in delivering large-scale projects with stringent quality and operational requirements.
  • Architectural Finishes and Interior Fit-Out Management
  • Hospital Construction and Healthcare Facility Standards
  • Design Coordination and Drawing Review
  • Procurement and Vendor Management
  • Project Scheduling and Progress Monitoring
  • Quality Assurance and Inspection Processes
  • Cost and Commercial Awareness
  • MEP Coordination and Interface Management
  • Testing, Commissioning, and Handover Management

Why join Cushman & Wakefield

As one of the leading global real estate services firms transforming the way people work, shop and live working at Cushman & Wakefield means you will benefit from;

  • Being part of a growing global company;
  • Career development and a promote from within culture;
  • An organisation committed to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to providing work-life balance for our people in an inclusive, rewarding environment.

We achieve this by providing a flexible and agile work environment by focusing on technology and autonomy to help our people achieve their career ambitions. We focus on career progression and foster a promotion from within culture, leveraging global opportunities to ensure we retain our top talent. We encourage continuous learning and development opportunities to develop personal, professional and technical capabilities, and we reward with a comprehensive employee benefits program.

We have a vision of the future, where people simply belong.

That's why we support and celebrate inclusive causes, not just on days of recognition throughout the year, but every day. We embrace diversity across race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or persons with disabilities or protected veteran status.

We ensure DEI is part of our DNA as a global community - it means we go way beyond than just talking about it - we live it. If you want to live it too, join us.

jobs.title: EYP-CDD-Manager
jobs.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

Manager – Commercial Diligence - Healthcare

Full Job Description

We are seeking an experienced team member with expertise in Commercial Due Diligence, Strategy Consulting, and healthcare sector research to join our Healthcare CDD practice. This is an exceptional opportunity to be part of a leading firm while playing a pivotal role in the growth of our Health Sciences & Wellness (HS&W) practice. As a member of our EY-Parthenon Commercial Due Diligence (CDD) team, you will work closely with private equity investors and corporate clients to evaluate investment opportunities across healthcare services, healthcare IT, digital health, payer services, provider services, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical devices or related end-markets/subsectors. The role requires a hands-on approach to diligence execution and the ability to independently drive key workstreams from hypothesis generation through final recommendations.

Your key responsibilities:

  • Utilize an answer-first approach to lead commercial diligence engagements and growth strategy engagements for private equity and corporate clients.
  • Independently own and drive critical diligence workstreams, including market assessment, growth outlook, customer analysis, competitive benchmarking, and target positioning.
  • Lead day-to-day CDD execution, develop hypotheses, structure analyses, manage junior team members, and synthesize findings into client-ready recommendations.
  • Conduct detailed market and value chain assessments across healthcare end markets, identifying growth drivers, margin dynamics, competitive intensity, and key transaction risks.
  • Review transaction rationale to identify critical business issues, commercial risks, and value creation opportunities relating to proposed investments.
  • Support management interviews, expert calls, customer research, and triangulation of multiple data sources to develop evidence-based conclusions.
  • Support business development activities by leading pursuits and strengthening relationships with existing clients.
  • Participate in building a sector-focused practice and contribute to knowledge development, credentials, and thought leadership within the HS&W sector.
  • Collaborate effectively with global stakeholders across cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

  • Strategy Consulting, Commercial Due Diligence, or Transaction Advisory experience with leading consulting firms, including Big 4, MBB, and boutique consulting firms.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering Commercial Due Diligence, growth strategy, market assessment, or transaction-related engagements.
  • Relevant sector experience in healthcare services, provider services, payer services, healthcare IT / digital health, pharmaceuticals, and medical devices & diagnostics
  • Proven ability to independently manage workstreams, supervise analysts, and deliver high-quality outputs with limited oversight.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to assess industries, markets, competitors, customers, and value chains to identify investment risks and opportunities.

Ideal candidate profile

  • 7 - 9 years of experience in Commercial Due Diligence, Strategy Consulting, or Transaction Strategy.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare and/or Life Sciences markets and business models.
  • Experience working on multiple buy-side / sell side Commercial Due Diligence engagements.
  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced private equity timelines.
  • Able to independently structure problems, manage stakeholders, and translate analyses into actionable investment insights.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach junior team members while remaining heavily involved in analysis and storyline development.

What The Job Would Entail

As part of our EY-Parthenon team, you will help clients develop their investment strategies and evaluate potential transactions. Working with EY-Parthenon's proprietary frameworks, you will help clients to take steps the best way to raise, invest, optimize, and preserve their capital. This includes conducting commercial due diligence, developing growth and market entry strategies, and conducting strategic portfolio reviews. The client base spans across industries and includes Private

Equity firms, Blue chip corporates and multinational investors

What We Offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies, and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We will introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

  • Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
  • Success, as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
  • Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
  • Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

What Working At EY Offers

At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

  • Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
  • The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you
  • A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
  • An opportunity to be a part of market-prominent, multi-disciplinary team of 3000 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
  • Opportunities to work with EY SaT practices globally with prominent businesses across a range of industries

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

jobs.title: Senior Medical Writer Medical Information
jobs.description:
Overview


Cactus Life Sciences is a remote-first organization, and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.

If you are looking for challenging and rewarding work which combines your understanding of medical science and aptitude for writing into one unique job, the Senior Medical Writer,Medical Information role is for you. This is an opportunity to grow your career and make a greater impact on the lives around you.


Responsibilities


  • Taking ownership and responsibility for development (write, review, proofread, and data-check) of high-quality, client-ready scientific, medical, and educational materials like slides, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, MSL/training slide decks, infographics, congress and meetings materials, literature searches and reviews, standard response letters/medical information letters, and HCP engagement content according to client and audience needs with excellent attention to detail.
  • Actively involve in reviewing materials developed by scientific writers to ensure strategic alignment and scientific accuracy as needed and providing clear constructive feedback, support, and supervision to writers. Mentor and train scientific writers by sharing best practices and client preferences, thereby contributing to skill development within the team.
  • Having excellent knowledge of product/account to enable meaningful interactions with clients and authors, including consultancy where necessary.
  • Building and maintaining strong, long-term relationships with international pharmaceutical clients, healthcare professionals, and key stakeholders, including authors, reviewers, and KOLs across therapeutic areas. This involves anticipating client needs, advising on strategic and tactical plans, and recommending improvements to scientific content and new ways to disseminate data effectively.
  • Attend workshops/seminars/trainings to hone your skills and contribute to organizational objectives. Attending client and other external meetings and supporting senior team members as needed.

Also, supporting with the development of visual content and materials using effective data visualization techniques and approaches. Contributing to innovative out of the box solutions for medical writing projects.

  • Supporting with pitches, both during the preparation phase and the actual pitch.

jobs.title: Clinical Research & Data Analytics Executive
jobs.description:
About Teleradiology Solutions

Teleradiology Solutions (TRS) is a pioneer in teleradiology, delivering round-the-clock diagnostic radiology reporting and support to hospitals and healthcare providers across India, the US, and other global markets. Founded in 2002 by two Yale-trained physicians and headquartered in Ardmore, PA, TRS today serves over 150 hospitals across 21 countries.

The company pairs a network of board-certified radiologists — including ABR-certified specialists — with technology-driven workflows and its AI-enabled arm, dAIgnostiX, to deliver fast, accurate, and reliable imaging interpretation. dAIgnostiX is based out of Bengaluru (Whitefield). TRS/dAIX also maintains an active academic focus (www.radguru.net) and ongoing research interests, including AI in radiology.

Position Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Research & Data Analytics Executive to support clinical research, radiology data management, and AI validation initiatives. The role involves managing and analyzing radiology datasets, ensuring data quality and accuracy, coordinating AI case validation, and providing analytical support for research projects, publications, conferences, and operational decision-making. The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively with radiologists, researchers, and cross-functional teams.  

 

Job Description

 

1.Research Data Mining & Analytics

  • Maintain and update the ER Master Database every 15 days, ensuring accuracy and completeness. 
  • Perform data cleaning, pathology-wise segregation, and image download management every 4 days. 
  • Mine, organise and analyse data based on modality, pathology, procedure and research requirements. 
  • Provide data support for research projects, publications, conferences and training programmes. 

 

2. AI case validation

  •  Coordinate with radiologists and technical teams for timely AI case validation. Maintain AI validation trackers, case archives and validation records.
  • Maintain AI validation trackers, validation records, case archives, and supporting documentation to ensure complete traceability.
  • Monitor the progress of AI validation activities and proactively follow up with stakeholders to resolve pending validations or data gaps.

 

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biomedical Engineering, Health Informatics, Clinical Research, Data Science, or a related field.
  • 3 plus years of experience in clinical data management, healthcare analytics, or medical imaging.
  • Experience handling large clinical or radiology datasets is preferred. 

Required Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent proficiency in Microsoft Excel (advanced functions, Pivot Tables, Power Query preferred).
  • Experience with SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with AI validation workflows in healthcare is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.

jobs.title: General Physician Intern
jobs.description:
Job Description

Position: General Physician ( Intern )

Department: Medical / Clinical

Employment Type: Internship  

Location: Bodhgaya, Bihar 

Duration: 6 Months

Reporting To: Senior doctors / Chief Managing Director

Company Description

Vastu Vihar Biotech Pvt. Ltd. is the R&D unit of Technoculture Research, based in Bodhgaya, Bihar, working at the forefront of drug development using ribozyme-based therapies. The organization focuses on pre-clinical and clinical trials targeting diseases such as asthma, psoriasis, and chronic hepatitis. With a mission to contribute meaningfully to human health, the team is committed to combating challenging and long-standing diseases. VV Biotech is steadily progressing toward its goal of developing ribozyme as a core drug molecule and has recently achieved stable, active in vivo and in vitro results. This work involves testing ribozyme molecules with semi-natural lipopeptide vesicles for mRNA cleavage of key chemokines and cytokines.

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated and responsible General Physician Intern to support our medical and healthcare activities. The intern will work under the supervision of experienced medical professionals and gain practical exposure to patient assessment, basic clinical evaluation, preventive healthcare, documentation, and general medical support. The ideal candidate should have good clinical knowledge, strong communication skills, a professional attitude, and a willingness to learn and work in a multidisciplinary environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct basic patient history taking and preliminary assessment under supervision.
  • Assist in recording and monitoring vital signs such as blood pressure, pulse rate, temperature, and oxygen saturation.
  • Support basic physical examinations as directed by the supervising physician.
  • Assist in identifying common signs and symptoms and escalate concerns to the senior physician.
  • Review and maintain patient medical records and clinical documentation.
  • Assist in monitoring patients and following up on their health status.
  • Support preventive healthcare activities, health awareness programs, and routine medical check-ups.
  • Assist in coordinating laboratory investigations and reviewing reports under the supervision of a senior doctor.
  • Maintain confidentiality and ensure proper handling of patient information and medical records.
  • Follow all applicable medical, safety, hygiene, and ethical standards.
  • Coordinate with nursing, laboratory, HR, and other relevant teams for smooth healthcare operations.
  • Assist in emergency response and first-aid support within the scope of training and supervision.
  • Perform other medical and clinical support duties as assigned by the reporting physician.

Eligibility & Qualifications

  • MBBS from a recognized medical institution/university.
  • Internship completion status as per applicable medical regulations.
  • Valid registration with the appropriate medical council, wherever applicable.
  • Fresh MBBS graduates/interns are encouraged to apply.
  • Basic knowledge of general medicine, clinical examination, and patient care.
  • Knowledge of medical documentation and basic computer applications will be an advantage.

Required Skills

  • Good clinical observation and assessment skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to interact professionally with patients and employees.
  • Good documentation and record-keeping skills.
  • Ability to work effectively under the guidance of senior medical professionals.
  • Responsible, empathetic, and patient-oriented approach.
  • Good time management and organizational skills.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to a professional healthcare environment.

Key Learning Opportunities

During the internship, the candidate will gain exposure to:

  • General patient assessment and clinical history taking.
  • Basic physical examination techniques.
  • Preventive and occupational healthcare.
  • Medical documentation and patient records.
  • Basic interpretation of laboratory investigation reports under supervision.
  • Health screening and employee wellness programs.
  • Clinical coordination and healthcare administration.
  • Professional medical ethics and workplace healthcare practices.

jobs.description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won't find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

  • Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
  • A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You'll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
  • Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm's diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you'll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
  • World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

Your Impact

You will support the development, maintenance, and enhancement of data pipelines and workflows that power analytics and AI-driven solutions for social, healthcare, and public sector clients.

You will be part of the SHaPE Tech team be based in our Gurugram or Bengaluru office in India as part of the Social, Healthcare and Public Entities (SHaPE) practice. You will collaborate with our SHaPE analytics teams in other technology hubs in the US, Europe, India, and Costa Rica.

You will work under the guidance of senior engineers to build and maintain data pipelines and ETL workflows that are reliable, scalable, and efficient. You will work with structured and unstructured data using tools such as Python, SQL, and distributed data platforms, and contribute to the development of data models, transformations, and data quality checks. Your work will help ensure that data is accurate, well-structured, and ready for downstream analytics and AI use cases.

You will contribute to testing, debugging, and monitoring data workflows to ensure smooth and reliable data delivery. You will participate in code reviews, follow engineering best practices, and help document data processes, pipelines, and workflows to support maintainability and knowledge sharing across teams.

You will collaborate closely with data engineers, data scientists, and consulting teams to deliver high-quality data solutions that support analytics and AI-driven insights. You will also assist in the integration of data solutions into broader analytical and machine learning use cases, gaining exposure to emerging technologies such as LLM-based workflows and modern data platforms.

Our SHaPE Tech organization leverages big-data analytics platforms which includes 100 terabytes of integrated claim, encounter, clinical, consumer and other data. The team consists of 100 dedicated experts and 250 affiliated professionals with industry, advanced analytics, statistics, clinical and software expertise, all of whom work to design, deliver and operate advanced analytic tools to help social, public and healthcare clients around the world.

McKinsey's SHaPE fosters innovation through advanced analytics, user-centered design, predictive forecasting, and new product development. We are a community of entrepreneurs within McKinsey, using technology to drive meaningful client impact. Through self-service analytics, software-as-a-service solutions, strategic acquisitions, and a strong ecosystem of alliances, we are redefining what it means to work with McKinsey.

Your Qualifications and Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • 2+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, or a related role
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL with a basic understanding of data structures and algorithms
  • Understanding of data processing frameworks (e.g., Pandas, PySpark, Spark), ETL/ELT pipelines, and data warehousing concepts
  • Familiarity with Git/version control systems
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and distributed data platforms such as Databricks or similar tools (preferred)
  • Basic understanding of CI/CD concepts, APIs, and data integration techniques
  • Knowledge of statistical data analysis using R is a plus
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn in a fast-paced environment
  • Interest in AI/ML or LLM-based applications, with exposure to applying data engineering in social, healthcare, or public sector domains
