Job Title: Business Development Executive

Role Overview

Looking for a proactive, self-driven, and result-oriented Business Development Executive (South) to drive sales of our medical bed actuators and healthcare motion solutions across South India.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, developing strong customer relationships, managing the complete sales cycle, and expanding the company's presence within the healthcare and medical equipment industry. This is a field-based role requiring extensive travel to customer locations while working remotely.

Product Portfolio

The role involves promoting the company's healthcare motion solutions, including:

  • Medical Bed Actuators
  • Hospital Bed Motion Solutions
  • ICU Bed Actuators
  • Homecare Bed Actuators
  • Medical Furniture Motion Solutions

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive sales of medical bed actuators used in hospital beds, ICU beds, homecare beds, and medical furniture.
  • Identify and develop new business opportunities with hospital bed manufacturers, medical equipment OEMs, distributors, and dealers.
  • Travel extensively to customer and prospect locations for business meetings, presentations, and sales activities.
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing customers through regular visits and follow-ups.
  • Conduct product demonstrations and techno-commercial discussions with prospective customers.
  • Understand customer technical requirements and coordinate with internal technical and engineering teams to provide suitable solutions.
  • Achieve assigned sales targets while expanding market presence across the allocated territory.
  • Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer feedback to identify new business opportunities.
  • Participate in medical exhibitions, trade shows, and industry events to generate business leads and strengthen brand visibility.
  • Prepare regular sales reports and maintain accurate CRM records.

Work Mode

  • Work From Home role.
  • No daily office reporting is required.
  • Regular and extensive travel to customer and prospect locations is mandatory.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • 1–5 years of experience in B2B Sales, preferably in Medical Devices, Hospital Equipment, Actuators, Healthcare Products, or Industrial Products.
  • Comfortable with extensive travel and field sales.
  • Good communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to communicate in more than one South Indian language.
  • Basic technical understanding or the ability to quickly learn medical and mechanical products.
  • Degree or Diploma in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or Sales & Marketing is preferred.

Ideal Candidate

  • Self-motivated, disciplined, and target-oriented.
  • Strong customer relationship management and business development skills.
  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities.
  • Capable of independently managing field sales activities.
  • Passionate about building long-term customer relationships and achieving sales targets.

jobs.title: Billing Specialist I
jobs.description:
Who We Are Looking For

As a WebPT Junior Billing Specialist, you'll be responsible for successfully filing, collecting, and resubmitting claims via electronic claim submission. You will also act as a lead within the department by assigning and directing work to other team members.

What You'll Be Doing As A Part of Our Team

  • Review, prepare, and submit electronic claims.
  • Diagnose and resolve issues associated with escalated or problematic accounts.
  • Identify and resolve exclusion trends, and follow up and re-submit claims when necessary.
  • Ensure first pass acceptance (FPA) and educate the team on any issues affecting FPA metrics.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality and compliance, adhering to all HIPAA regulations.
  • Perform such clerical functions preparing and stamping department mail and maintaining postage equipment and supplies.
  • Be ready to fly by the seat of your pants. This role is ever-evolving—just like WebPT—so while you don't need to be Cirque du Soleil flexible, we may occasionally ask you to do a few cartwheels, or at least try some things outside of your wheelhouse.

What You Should Have To Qualify


  • Have knowledge of ICD-10 and CPT codes as well as insurance guidelines—especially Medicare and Medicaid.
  • Must demonstrate flexibility and ability to multi-task in a fast paced environment.
  • Attention to detail, suggest areas of improvement.
  • Be organized, ahead of schedule, communicative, accountable
  • Excellent time management skills.
  • Partner and foster working relationships with colleagues, members and vendors as applicable.
  • Be energetic, possess integrity and a positive attitude, and have a hunger for knowledge and a passion for sharing it.
  • Know how to roll up your sleeves. We have a lot of brass tacks here, and we like to get down to em.
  • Jibe with our company culture. We're talkin energy, integrity, positivity, a hunger for knowledge, and a passion for your role and team. Bring all that and a bag of chips. Seriously, though, we love chips.
  • 1-5 years of experience in medical billing.
  • High School Diploma or GED

Ideally, You Would Also Have These


  • Have experience with a variety of medical billing software.
  • Prior working knowledge of ICD-9 (bonus points for ICD-10) and CPT codes as well as insurance guidelines—especially Medicare and Medicaid.

Culture is at our Core


  • Service: Create Raving Fans
  • Accountability: Follow Up; Own Up
  • Attitude: Possess True Grit
  • Personality: Be Minty
  • Work Ethic: Be Rock Solid
  • Community Outreach: Give Back
  • Health and Wellness: Live Better
  • Resource Efficiency: Do Más With Menos

About Us


Here, we work hard—but we have lots of fun doing it. We believe in equal opportunity for all, autonomy, trailblazing, and always doing right by our Members. Most importantly, though, we believe in empowering rehab therapy professionals to achieve greatness in practice. So, if you're a can-do kinda person who loves to help Members win and enjoys working from just about anywhere—then you'll fit right in. We've got big plans, but we can't achieve them without you. Join us, and let's achieve greatness.

jobs.title: Product Launch & Lifecycle Manager
jobs.description:
About Amgen

Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world's toughest diseases, and make people's lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what's known today.

About The Role

Role Description: Let's do this. Let's change the world. We are seeking an individual who thrives in ambiguity, capable of driving end-to-end process excellence and performance management with speed and precision.

In this vital role, you will lead Regional Operations activities supporting product launches and lifecycle management across the US, ELMAC and JAPAC regions. You will act as the regional Operations representative for Global Product Development Teams (PDTs), Product Lifecycle Teams (PLTs), Regional Operations Team (ROTs), Launch Teams and Affiliate Supply Chain organizations, ensuring successful commercialization and lifecycle execution for existing products.

You will coordinate cross-functional activities across manufacturing sites, regional planning, regulatory, commercialization and affiliate organizations to ensure timely launches, lifecycle changes and uninterrupted product supply. Success in this role requires strong project leadership, stakeholder management and the ability to influence a complex global matrix organization.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Regional Product Launch & Lifecycle Management

  • Lead Regional Operations activities for launches of existing products, new presentations, new strengths and other lifecycle initiatives.
  • Develop and execute regional launch and lifecycle strategies aligned with global product strategy and regulatory filing plans.
  • Generate project charters and ensure governance through appropriate project gate reviews.
  • Coordinate site readiness activities with manufacturing and packaging sites to ensure successful implementation.
  • Drive SKU creation, rationalization and regional implementation planning.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the Regional Operations representative on Global Product Development Teams (PDTs).
  • Represent Regional Operations within Product Lifecycle Teams (PLTs) and Regional Operations Teams (ROTs), ensuring regional requirements are incorporated into lifecycle planning.
  • Participate in local Launch Teams with affiliates and country organizations.
  • Build strong partnerships with Global Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Regulatory Affairs, Commercial, Quality and Planning organizations.

Regional Business Partnership

  • Present launch plans, lifecycle activities and portfolio updates to regional stakeholders.
  • Support affiliate organizations in business case preparation and launch prioritization.
  • Ensure effective communication between global teams and regional stakeholders.

Project Leadership & Operational Excellence

  • Lead multiple cross-functional projects simultaneously while managing timelines, risks and dependencies.
  • Identify and escalate issues that may impact successful launches or lifecycle implementation.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to simplify processes and improve execution.
  • Support implementation of best practices and standardization across Regional Operations.

Performance Management

  • Monitor departmental KPIs related to launches, lifecycle management and project execution.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational performance and execution excellence.
  • Provide regular project status updates to senior stakeholders and governance forums.

Functional Skills:

Must-Have Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business or related discipline.
  • 8+ years of experience in Supply Chain, Product Management, Commercialization or Operations within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Demonstrated project management experience leading cross-functional initiatives.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills in a global matrix organization.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational and communication skills.
  • Fluent in English (written and verbal).

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Knowledge of pharmaceutical commercialization and product lifecycle management.
  • Basic understanding of GMP and pharmaceutical regulatory requirements.
  • Project Management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, IPMA or equivalent).
  • Experience working in international and cross-cultural environments.

Professional Certifications:

Preferred:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business or related field.
  • PMP, PRINCE2, IPMA or equivalent Project Management certification.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and influencing capability.
  • Ability to work effectively across global, virtual teams.
  • Strong project leadership and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • Problem-solving and decision-making skills.

  • Collaborative mindset with a focus on delivering business outcomes.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive execution through influence.

jobs.title: Contracts & Pricing Execution Mgr
jobs.description:
Manager, Medicaid – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN)

Join Amgen's Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you're part of something bigger, it's because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

What You Will Do

As the Manager, Medicaid – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN), you will lead AIN-based execution of U.S. Medicaid rebate operations within the Contracts & Pricing Execution function. This role is responsible for managing Medicaid invoice processing, claim validation, CLD analytics, dispute management, payment package support, reporting, reconciliation, operational controls, documentation, and continuous improvement for a highly regulated U.S. Medicaid operating environment.

Reporting to the Senior Manager/Director, Contracts & Pricing Execution, you will partner closely with ATO Medicaid process owners, U.S.-based Government Pricing, Finance, Compliance, Contracting, Market Access, Information Systems, and AIN cross-functional teams to ensure accurate, compliant, scalable, and audit-ready Medicaid execution. The role will provide leadership to AIN-based associates and analysts supporting Medicaid operations while preserving appropriate ATO oversight for complex states, judgment-based decisions, approvals, and compliance ownership.

Key Responsibilities

Medicaid Operations Management

  • Lead end-to-end execution of U.S. Medicaid rebate operations within CPE, covering quarter setup, program readiness, invoice intake, claim loading, invoice validation, CLD processing, disputes, payment package preparation, payment execution support, reporting, and reconciliation.
  • Oversee operational delivery for standard-state Medicaid activities transitioning to AIN while ensuring complex-state issues, high-risk exceptions, approvals, and judgment-based decisions are appropriately escalated to ATO retained owners.
  • Manage workloads, state portfolios, invoice cycles, open items, exception inventories, dispute aging, payment timelines, and quarter-close deliverables to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant execution.
  • Establish operational discipline across trackers, KPI reporting, work allocation, service expectations, quality checks, readiness gates, and issue escalation routines.

Quarter Setup, Contract / Program Updates & URA Readiness

  • Oversee Medicaid program setup and maintenance activities including supplemental program updates, customer/payee readiness, program term changes, and reference data coordination in Model N.
  • Coordinate with Government Pricing, Contracting, Finance, Compliance, Information Systems, and ATO Medicaid process owners to ensure pricing, URA publication, and program readiness steps are completed before invoice processing begins.
  • Ensure AIN execution teams follow SOP-aligned controls for AWP, URA, program updates, access reviews, and evidence retention, while ATO retains final oversight for complex contract interpretation and pricing/terms risk decisions.

Invoice Processing, Validation & CLD Analytics

  • Lead Medicaid invoice receipt tracking, invoice conversion, Model N upload preparation, and first-pass validation for standard states and repeatable workstreams.
  • Oversee validation activities including units, NDC, reimbursement, URA reasonableness, duplicate discount indicators, ESRD/medical benefit considerations, managed care vs. FFS nuances, and state-specific exception logic.
  • Drive CLD formatting, claim-level analytics, historical utilization review, trend analysis, and exception documentation to support accurate payment and dispute decisions.
  • Ensure complex validation issues, state-specific nuance, high financial exposure, or ambiguous policy interpretation are routed to ATO/US stakeholders with clear evidence and recommendations.

Dispute Management, Payment Processing & Financial Controls

  • Oversee dispute identification, dispute code documentation, dispute tracking, resolution follow-up, interest accrual support, and aging governance across Medicaid invoices and adjustments.
  • Lead payment package preparation and review readiness including ROSI, PQAS, remittance support, approval evidence, SAP/Model N reconciliation support, and SharePoint archival documentation.
  • Partner with Finance and ATO retained owners to support GL reconciliation, budget-to-actual review, payment variance analysis, dispute rollforward visibility, and quarter-close controls.
  • Ensure SOX-aligned documentation, review evidence, and decision logs are maintained for audit readiness and financial control requirements.

Systems, Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Serve as an AIN business operations lead for Model N, Validata, SAP, state portals, AIR/automation, SharePoint repositories, Tableau/Qlik/Power BI reporting, and related Medicaid workflow tools.
  • Partner with Information Systems and ATO process owners on system access readiness, defect resolution, UAT, workflow enhancements, automation opportunities, and process scalability initiatives.
  • Drive SOP, work instruction, decision tree, state-specific exception playbook, training material, and knowledge repository development to reduce SME dependency and strengthen repeatable execution.
  • Use reporting, dashboards, process metrics, and automation opportunities to improve cycle time, first-pass quality, dispute visibility, and operational transparency.

People Leadership & Transition Readiness

  • Lead, coach, and develop AIN-based Medicaid Associates / Senior Associates supporting Medicaid operations and transition execution.
  • Build a structured onboarding and KT model across learning, shadowing, reverse shadowing, supervised execution, and readiness sign-off before independent ownership expands.
  • Partner with ATO Medicaid SMEs to define skills, proficiency levels, QA standards, escalation rules, and readiness criteria for each Medicaid process step.
  • Create a culture of accountability, compliance, quality, continuous improvement, stakeholder service, and One CPE collaboration across ATO and AIN.

Compliance, Controls & Audit Readiness

  • Ensure compliance with SOX controls, internal policies, pricing governance requirements, audit standards, and applicable pharmaceutical contracting regulations
  • Maintain audit-ready documentation, approval evidence, decision logs, dispute records, and process workpapers supporting operational compliance.
  • Identify operational, compliance, financial, and data integrity risks and lead mitigation and remediation efforts.
  • Support internal, external, and SOX audit activities and drive closure of audit observations.

What We Expect Of You

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The ideal candidate is a strong Medicaid / managed markets operations leader with experience in U.S. healthcare or pharmaceutical rebate operations, financial controls, systems enablement, and people leadership. This individual combines operational discipline, Medicaid domain knowledge, analytical rigor, stakeholder collaboration, and a continuous improvement mindset to build a scalable AIN Medicaid capability.

Basic Qualifications

  • Master's degree in finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or related discipline.
  • 9–12 years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical / biotech operations, managed markets, Medicaid rebate operations, revenue management, finance, pricing, contracting, analytics, or related U.S. healthcare operations.
  • 3+ years of experience leading people, managing operational teams, or leading complex cross-functional delivery in a controlled environment.
  • Experience operating with U.S.-based stakeholders across Finance, Market Access, Government Pricing, Compliance, IT, or Contract Operations.
  • 3+ years of experience leading people or managing operational teams.
  • Experience coordinating structured work across reporting, systems/process support, documentation, controls, or related business operations activities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep understanding of U.S. Medicaid Drug Rebate Program operations, Medicaid rebate adjudication, supplemental rebates, CLD processing, dispute management, ROSI/PQAS, and payment package requirements.
  • Experience with Model N Revenue Management / PbN, Validata, Revitas Flex, SAP, SharePoint, Tableau, Qlik, Power BI, Power Query, Alteryx, or comparable revenue management and analytics platforms.
  • Working knowledge of AMP, Best Price, URA, AWP, NDC, 340B duplicate discount concepts, managed care utilization, ESRD/medical claims considerations, and Gross-to-Net operations.
  • Experience supporting SOX controls, audit readiness, SOP/work instruction documentation, access reviews, issue management, UAT, and system enhancement activities.
  • Proven ability to lead transition, KT, process standardization, automation, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives in a distributed global operating model.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, influencing, escalation management, analytical, and executive-ready reporting skills.

jobs.title: Senior Medical Lead
jobs.description:
At Biocon Biologics, we are creating a model for the future of healthcare for all. We are a leading company in the biosimilars revolution where patients come first. Our ambition is to impact a billion lives and we do this by fostering a culture of affordable innovation, patient centricity and disruptive thinking. We are a multicultural global company where employees have a purpose and passion to work closely with partners and patients. We have proven end to end expertise in the field of biosimilars, from its development, manufacturing, clinical development, regulatory approvals to commercialization. We have a long-term commitment to bring high quality affordable biosimilars to patients all over the globe.

About the Role:

The Medical Lead will be responsible for driving clinical strategy across the product lifecycle—from Target Product Profile (TPP) development through regulatory submission and approval. This role provides medical oversight for clinical trials, ensures compliance with global regulatory standards, and leads cross-functional collaboration with internal teams, CROs, and regulatory authorities. The position requires strong expertise in clinical development, medical monitoring, and regulatory interactions, particularly for novel biologics and molecules.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Clinical Strategy & Development

  • Lead clinical strategy development from TPP through dossier submission to global regulatory authorities (e.g., USFDA, EMA, CDSCO).
  • Contribute to and review Clinical Development Plans (CDP), Investigator's Brochure (IB), and study protocols.
  • Drive clinical development strategies for novel biologics and new molecular entities.
  • Identify and implement approaches for accelerated trial execution with a patient-centric focus.
  • Provide medical rationale and scientific justification for products and therapy areas.

2. Clinical Trial Oversight & Execution

  • Provide medical oversight for clinical trials in compliance with GCP, SOPs, and regulatory requirements.
  • Support study conduct activities including site selection, investigator interactions, and vendor/CRO management.
  • Attend and contribute to study initiation meetings, investigator meetings, and governance boards/committees.
  • Review study-level data, including GCP issue reports, protocol deviations, and safety signals.
  • Conduct medical monitoring, including review of lab alerts, SAEs, and EDC data.
  • Ensure accuracy of trial information in registries such as ClinicalTrials.gov and CTRI.
  • Support database lock (DBL) activities and provide inputs on Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs).

3. Regulatory & Scientific Engagement

  • Lead scientific interactions with regulatory authorities for clinical aspects (IND, IMPD, MAA/CTD submissions).
  • Prepare and review regulatory documents, including briefing books, protocol synopses, safety documents, and annual updates.
  • Support responses to regulatory, marketing, and molecule-related queries.
  • Participate in advisory boards, Clinical Advisory Boards (CAB), DSMB meetings, and regulatory discussions.

4. Medical Writing & Documentation

  • Prepare and review key clinical documents including protocols, ICFs, SAP, DMP, SMP, DSMB charter, MMP, imaging charter, and CSRs.
  • Collaborate with medical writers to review and finalize Clinical Study Reports (CSR), including discussions and conclusions.
  • Provide inputs into statistical outputs and interim analysis (DSMB meetings).

5. Safety & Pharmacovigilance

  • Monitor subject safety throughout clinical trials and review safety data.
  • Collaborate with pharmacovigilance teams for preparation and review of safety documentation.
  • Ensure timely identification, escalation, and resolution of safety concerns.

6. Compliance, Audits & Quality

  • Ensure adherence to GCP, regulatory requirements, and internal SOPs.
  • Support audits and regulatory inspections.
  • Contribute to SOP development, review, and continuous process improvements.

7. Stakeholder & Team Management

  • Manage interactions with CROs, vendors, investigators, and cross-functional teams.
  • Line manage and mentor medical/scientific staff (if applicable).
  • Participate in external scientific discussions, partnerships, and consultant engagements.

8. Scientific Communication

  • Support dissemination of scientific knowledge through publications, presentations, and training initiatives.

Academic Qualification:

  • Bachelors or Master's degree, equivalent or higher qualification within Life sciences/ Pharmacy/ MBBS /MD/ Healthcare Degree in alternative Medicine/ BDS with at least 10 years of experience in clinical development.
  • Additional certification in Clinical Research or Regulatory Affairs is an advantage.

Work Experience:

  • 10+ years of experience in Clinical Development / Medical Affairs within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Proven experience in end-to-end clinical trial management and regulatory submissions.
  • Experience in novel biologics, complex molecules, or global clinical programs preferred.
  • Strong exposure to regulatory interactions (USFDA, EMA, CDSCO, PMDA, etc.).

Key Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong clinical and scientific acumen
  • In-depth knowledge of GCP, regulatory guidelines, and clinical trial processes
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving ability
  • Leadership and team management capability
  • High attention to detail and data interpretation skills

We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it's work worth doing. If you're driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

About Lilly

At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients.

We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world.

Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve.

We bring our best to this work because people depend on it.

  • Performance Metrics: Feedback of KOLs; participation in programs as per plan.
  • Reporting and Analysis: Review on-demand reports, 90 day action plans and monthly trackers of team members; Validate Stock and sales statements for the area; prepare weekly reports on FLS-SLS for the team after incorporating inputs from individual team members, for the purpose of tracking sales; Prepare a monthly sales tracker for the area; present overall performance during the monthly business reviews and highlight positives points and challenges of the area.
  • Performance Metrics: Timely and accurate report submission and data analysis.
  • Key Stakeholders: Doctors, paramedical & hospital staff, hospital purchase in-charge, retailers, and stockists. Internal departments like HR, Marketing, Medical, Finance etc.

  • Time management

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Analytics & Intelligence - Lead Analyst (Integrated Insights Lead)

Roche India - Roche Services and Solutions

Chennai or Hyderabad

A healthier future. It's what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That's what makes us Roche.

We are Roche, committed to advancing science so that we all have more time with the people we love. We established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) in India to drive analytics & technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe. We are seeking a dynamic and transformative professional who thrives in a collaborative environment and is passionate about making a difference.

As an Analytics & Intelligence - Lead Analyst (Integrated Insights Lead), you will partner with the Global Pharma Strategy - Ecosystem Insights team in shaping Roche's Pharma strategy through market and customer-centric insights. This role functions as an internal consultant and strategist, partnering with commercial and cross-functional leaders to integrate data and activate insights-driven problem solving with foresight. The Opportunity

  • Influence Strategy: Drive and influence global disease area, individual asset, and commercialization strategies by integrating and analyzing complex market dynamics, customer needs, and the competitive landscape
  • Generate Insights: Lead customer and market-centric insights, embedding the voice of the customer (patients, healthcare professionals, and other key partners) in all strategies
  • Provide Financial & Performance Analysis: Deliver market valuations, product/portfolio forecasts, periodic situation analysis to inform portfolio performance and evolution, and performance tracking
  • Manage Data Integration & Analysis: Integrate data across multiple sources (primary/secondary research, CRM, epi data, real-world evidence, etc.) to understand and predict market evolution, customer attitudes, needs, behaviors, and perceptions
  • Lead Project Execution: Effectively plan, organize, and oversee insights and analytics projects from inception to completion, ensuring they address business questions and are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget
  • Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with teams such as R&D, Product Development, and Medical Affairs, and with critical must-win markets, ensuring accountability across all partners
  • Manage Agency Partners: Identify, onboard, and maintain relationships with premier external insights agency partners specializing in areas like customer insights, demand estimation, positioning, and performance tracking, utilizing innovative tools including AI

Who You Are
  • Education & Experience: You possess a Bachelor's Degree and 6+ years of experience in primary market research in the pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry, including analyzing insights from secondary sources. A Master's Degree or PhD is a preferred skill
  • Technical Expertise: Demonstrated experience in epidemiology-based forecasting, market valuations, and insights generation methodologies in primary and secondary market research, as well as experience with CRM analytics and real-world evidence
  • Strategic Problem Solver: Excellent strategic problem solver with a passion for customer insights, market dynamics, and innovation, translating complex market and customer data into clear, actionable insights
  • Impactful Storyteller: Strong analytical and storytelling skills, developing forward-looking strategies that anticipate market trends, customer needs, and competitive dynamics
  • Collaboration & Influence: Experience supporting R&D strategy and/or commercialization strategy, with demonstrated experience in working with senior leaders and influencing without authority, forming strong partnerships across function and geographies
  • Earlier experience on Infectious Diseases therapy area is an added advantage


Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100'000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let's build a healthier future, together.

Senior Programmer Analyst - Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation

The Senior Programmer Analyst performs advanced statistical programming activities to support clinical research projects and plays a key role in delivering high-quality, regulatory-compliant programming outputs. This role independently leads programming activities for moderately complex studies or serves as a senior programming team member on larger, more complex projects.

The successful candidate will have end-to-end clinical programming experience, taking ownership of the entire study lifecycle-from protocol and SAP review through SDTM and ADaM dataset development, TLF programming, quality control, and submission-ready deliverables. In addition, the Senior Programmer Analyst provides technical guidance, mentoring, and training to junior programmers while collaborating closely with biostatisticians, data management, and cross-functional study teams.

What You'll Do

  • Lead statistical programming activities for selected clinical studies of moderate complexity, partnering directly with project leaders, biostatisticians, and client representatives to establish programming strategies, timelines, and deliverables.

  • Independently manage end-to-end statistical programming activities throughout the clinical study lifecycle, including:

    • Reviewing study documents such as Protocols, Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs), CRFs, and specifications.

    • Developing, validating, and maintaining CDISC-compliant SDTM and ADaM datasets.

    • Programming, validating, and delivering Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs).

    • Performing quality control (QC) and ensuring traceability from raw data through final outputs.

    • Supporting regulatory submission-ready deliverables in accordance with FDA, EMA, PMDA, and other applicable standards.

  • Develop, execute, maintain, and validate SAS programs for data integration, data transformation, reporting, and analysis across multiple data management systems and operating environments.

  • Generate and validate datasets, reports, listings, tables, figures, and derived outputs while ensuring programming quality and compliance with company and regulatory standards.

  • Independently manage programming assignments, priorities, and timelines while delivering high-quality work within project schedules and contractual obligations.

  • Collaborate effectively with Biostatistics, Clinical Data Management, Medical Writing, Clinical Operations, and other cross-functional teams to ensure successful study execution.

  • Perform programming quality control reviews and contribute to continuous process improvements and programming standards.

  • Mentor, train, and provide technical guidance to junior programmers through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and best practices.

  • Contribute to departmental initiatives, including SOP development, working practice documents, training materials, process improvements, and innovation projects.

  • Support proposal development and bid defense activities by providing statistical programming input and effort estimates.

Education & Experience Requirements

  • Master's degree in computer science, Statistics, Biostatistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline with at least 5 years of relevant experience

OR

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Statistics, Biostatistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline (or equivalent qualification) with at least 6 years of relevant statistical programming experience.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong SAS programming experience with the ability to independently develop and validate clinical programming deliverables.

  • Demonstrated end-to-end clinical programming experience, including SDTM, ADaM, TLF programming, validation, and regulatory submission support.

  • Strong understanding of CDISC standards, including SDTM and ADaM.

  • Experience performing programming QC and validation using industry best practices.

  • Solid understanding of clinical trial processes and the statistical programming lifecycle.

  • Strong understanding of relational databases and complex clinical data structures.

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively collaborate with global teams and clients.

  • Ability to independently manage multiple studies and competing priorities.

  • Experience mentoring junior programmers and providing technical leadership.

  • Demonstrated initiative, accountability, and commitment to quality.

  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and project needs.

Working Conditions

  • Work is performed primarily in an office or hybrid environment with standard office equipment.

  • Occasional domestic and international travel may be required.

Why Join Us

When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global organization dedicated to enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. You'll work alongside talented professionals in a collaborative environment where innovation, continuous learning, and career growth are encouraged.

Join us and help accelerate the delivery of life-changing therapies through high-quality statistical programming and scientific excellence.

jobs.title: Product Manager IGT-S
jobs.description:
Job Title

Product Manager IGT-S

Job Description

Product Manager IGT-S

As Product Manager, you will support product planning, development, and lifecycle management activities while applying strong AI expertise to enhance customer insight generation, requirements development, data-driven decision-making, and product management practices. You will work in a global, multidisciplinary environment within Philips Healthcare, helping to deliver innovative solutions that create value for customers and patients.

Your Role:

As Product Manager, you will work closely with cross-functional teams to translate customer, market, and business needs into product requirements and roadmap recommendations. A strong background in Artificial Intelligence is essential, as you will be expected to leverage AI technologies and AI-driven approaches to improve product management effectiveness, uncover actionable insights, streamline decision-making, and drive innovation across all phases of product development and lifecycle management.

  • Support product roadmap development, business case creation, and PDLM planning activities using customer, market, and data-driven insights, including AI-enabled analysis tools.
  • Contribute to product development and PDLM activities from concept through launch, sustaining engineering, and lifecycle management while leveraging AI-enabled approaches to improve efficiency and decision-making.
  • Gather, analyze, and synthesize customer, clinical, market, and field insights into actionable product requirements using modern analytics and AI-assisted tools.
  • Work closely with R&D, Architecture, Clinical, Service, RA, Quality, and commercial teams to deliver successful products and support PDLM execution.
  • Support product lifecycle activities, including feature enhancements, compatibility management, obsolescence planning, and customer-driven improvements.
  • Monitor product adoption, customer satisfaction, product quality, and business performance to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Drive data-informed decision-making using modern analytics, AI-powered insights, and digital tools.
  • Leverage AI technologies and productivity tools to improve product discovery, customer insight generation, requirements definition, evidence generation, and overall product management effectiveness.
  • Evaluate emerging technology trends, including AI, to identify opportunities to enhance products, workflows, and customer value.
  • Influence stakeholders across multiple functions and geographies to support product objectives and business priorities.

You are a part of Image Guided Therapy Systems (IGT-S) is a global leader in image-guided solutions that enable minimally invasive diagnosis and treatment across multiple clinical domains. The IGT-S organization is responsible for the global marketing, development, and manufacturing of innovative systems, software, and services that help clinicians perform complex procedures with greater precision, efficiency, and confidence.

You will be part of the Product Management team, working closely with cross-functional stakeholders to translate customer, clinical, and business needs into successful products and solutions. The team is responsible for driving product innovation, supporting new product development, and managing products throughout their lifecycle.

As part of Philips Healthcare, you will contribute to meaningful innovations that improve patient outcomes and enhance the experience of both clinicians and patients. This position is based in Bangalore and reports to the Director of Product Management.

You are fit if:

  • Master's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, Product Management or equivalent.
  • 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Marketing, Strategy, or related leadership roles in a technology-driven environment.
  • Experience in healthcare technology, medical devices, or regulated industries is preferred.
  • Strong background in Artificial Intelligence, including practical experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI-assisted product development, and AI-driven business processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply AI technologies to solve customer problems, drive business outcomes, and improve product management effectiveness.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience applying AI to improve productivity, innovation, or business processes.
  • Experience with Microsoft Copilot and other AI-enabled productivity tools.
  • Experience working within Product Development Lifecycle Management (PDLM) processes
  • Experience supporting global product launches and post-market product lifecycle activities.
  • Knowledge of medical device regulations and quality processes.

How we work together:
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week.

Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company's facilities.

Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company's main facilities, generally at the customers or suppliers locations.

This role is an office-based role.

About Philips:
We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.

The role ensures compliance with applicable regulatory standards, Quality Management System (QMS) requirements, and company procedures while supporting R&D, product development, validation, technology transfer, and regulatory submissions.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Design & Technical Documentation

  • Prepare, review, and maintain Design History Files (DHF), Design Inputs, Design Outputs, Design Verification & Validation documents, Design Review records, Design Change documentation, Design of Experiments (DOE), protocols, reports, and technical specifications.
  • Prepare and maintain Device Master Records (DMR), Batch Manufacturing Records (BMR), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions (WIs), forms, engineering documents, and project documentation.
  • Develop and maintain Technical Files supporting product development and commercialization.

2. Regulatory Documentation

  • Prepare and maintain product artwork, labels, Instructions for Use (IFUs), packaging inserts, and packaging documentation.
  • Coordinate timely submission of project documents to the Regulatory Affairs department.
  • Ensure all documentation complies with ISO 13485, CE MDR, CDSCO, and company Quality Management System requirements.

3. Document Control & Quality Management

  • Maintain document revision history, version control, approvals, distribution, traceability, and archival in accordance with document control procedures.
  • Monitor document status and ensure completion within established project timelines.
  • Maintain effective document control systems to support regulatory compliance and audit readiness.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance documentation quality and efficiency.

4. Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Collaborate with R&D, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Production, Engineering, Clinical Affairs, and Manufacturing teams for documentation preparation and review.
  • Support product development, process validation, product transfer, engineering changes, and manufacturing documentation activities.
  • Follow up with cross-functional teams to ensure timely completion and approval of project documents.

5. Quality, Compliance & Audit Support

  • Support internal audits, external audits, customer audits, and regulatory inspections by providing accurate and timely documentation.
  • Ensure documentation confidentiality, integrity, completeness, and regulatory compliance.
  • Support implementation of Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs requirements across assigned projects.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About The Company

Persistent Systems is a global leader in technology services and solutions, dedicated to helping organizations across various industries innovate and transform their digital landscape. With a rich history of delivering cutting-edge solutions, Persistent Systems prides itself on fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning. The company specializes in software product development, digital transformation, and technology consulting, serving clients worldwide with a focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Persistent Systems values diversity, inclusion, and sustainability, striving to create an empowering environment where employees can thrive and contribute to impactful projects that shape the future of technology.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst with a strong background in MS SQL, Healthcare Data Modeling & Integration, and Statistics to join our dynamic team at Persistent Systems. In this role, you will be instrumental in building scalable and efficient cloud infrastructure, implementing system health monitoring, and developing continuous integration pipelines. Your expertise will support healthcare analytics initiatives, ensuring accurate data processing, reporting, and insights that drive strategic decision-making. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of US healthcare datasets, data warehousing, and analytics tools, and will be responsible for collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions that meet regulatory and business requirements.

Qualifications

To succeed in this role, candidates should possess a bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Statistics, Healthcare Analytics, or a related field. A minimum of 7 years of hands-on experience working with US healthcare data, including benefits, claims, and eligibility datasets, is essential. Proficiency in SQL for querying and analyzing large healthcare datasets is required, along with familiarity with modern data warehousing platforms such as Snowflake and MySQL. Candidates should have experience creating healthcare process and data flow documentation using tools like Microsoft Visio or equivalent. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data validation skills are critical, complemented by excellent communication abilities to liaise effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Responsibilities

The responsibilities of this role include a broad spectrum of healthcare data analysis, modeling, and stakeholder engagement:

  • Perform comprehensive analysis and reporting on large-scale US healthcare datasets, including claims, eligibility, provider, utilization, and quality data.
  • Write, optimize, and validate complex SQL queries to extract meaningful insights from relational databases.
  • Conduct data validation, reconciliation, and transformation processes to ensure accuracy and compliance with regulatory standards.
  • Support healthcare data modeling and integration efforts by working with Snowflake, MySQL, and related platforms to develop data marts and analytics layers.
  • Collaborate with data engineering teams to facilitate reliable data ingestion from source systems such as claims processing, provider systems, and eligibility feeds.
  • Contribute to analytics initiatives aimed at value-based care, population health management, quality improvement, and operational efficiency.
  • Create detailed process flows, data lineage diagrams, and system architecture visuals using tools like Microsoft Visio or draw.io to document healthcare data workflows.
  • Document healthcare business rules, data definitions, metrics logic, and reporting methodologies to ensure standardization and clarity across teams.
  • Partner with business stakeholders including Healthcare Operations, Finance, Clinical, Quality, and Compliance teams to understand reporting needs and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Present findings, trends, and strategic recommendations to leadership and cross-functional teams in a clear and actionable manner.

Benefits

Persistent Systems offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional growth of our employees:

  • Competitive salary packages aligned with industry standards and individual experience.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and development through quarterly growth initiatives, company-sponsored higher education, and certification programs.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge technologies and innovative projects in healthcare analytics and cloud infrastructure.
  • Engagement activities such as project parties, flexible work hours, and recognition programs like Long Service awards.
  • Annual health check-ups to promote health and wellness.
  • Insurance coverage including group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents.

Equal Opportunity

Persistent Systems is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, regardless of gender, gender identity, or background. We support hybrid work arrangements and flexible hours to accommodate various lifestyles. Our office facilities are accessibility-friendly, equipped with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities. If you have specific requirements, please inform us during your application process or at any point during your employment. We believe that a diverse workforce enriches our culture and drives innovation, and we are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for all.

Let's unleash your full potential at Persistent - persistent.com/careers

Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind.

jobs.title: Manager, Intellectual Property
jobs.description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late-stage pipeline. The company's patient-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.

Job Summary

Job Description – Manager IP – Azurity

Azurity Pharmaceuticals is seeking an experienced and skilled patent professional to join the expanding Intellectual Property (IP) team. The candidate will possess sound IP knowledge, does comprehensive IP analyses, identifies patent barriers, and deliver actionable insights to guide product development and lifecycle management. The candidate will support cross-functional initiatives and will play key role in protecting company's innovative pipeline across key global markets. This role is key to driving global product development that aligns with Azurity's mission of delivering affordable, accessible healthcare solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Portfolio Management & Strategy
  • Conduct thorough IP due diligence to support product selection, licensing, M&A, and strategic partnerships.
  • Monitor competitor activities, brand pipelines, patent expiry timelines, and ongoing clinical trials to perform portfolio planning.
  • Guide new product opportunity identification through an IP lens, enabling lifecycle extension and exclusivity strategies.
  • IP Strategy & Risk Management
  • Prepare comprehensive patent landscape and perform whitespace analyses across global markets (India, US, EU, Canda, China, Australia etc.) to identify IP barriers and opportunities.
  • Perform prior art searches, patentability assessments, landscape analysis, and freedom-to-operate (FTO)evaluations.
  • Analyze Orange Book-listed patents & Pending Patent Applications and develop IP strategies in compliance with regulatory and legal requirements.
  • Generate risk assessment reports & provide IP clearances for proposed formulations, synthesis routes, polymorphs, and manufacturing processes.
  • Develop non-infringement and patent invalidation strategies, including prior art search and claim construction.
  • Draft, file, and prosecute patent applications (including formulation, process, and use patents) to strengthen the company's IP portfolio.
  • Provide scientific and technical input to attorneys while responding to office actions.
  • Litigation & Regulatory Support
  • Provide strategic support to the Legal team on patent litigations, including IPR (Inter Partes Review) and PGR (Post-Grant Review) proceedings.
  • Monitor ongoing litigations, especially within the U.S., and assess potential impact.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration
  • Collaborate with the R&D team to identify patentable inventions and formulate patentable strategies.
  • Partner with the R&D team to identify opportunities for differentiated product filings, including 505(b)(2) and ANDA strategies.
  • Conduct literature reviews (patent and non-patent) to support R&D and IP analysis.
  • Market & Competitive Intelligence
  • Continuously monitor market trends, IP filings, and competitive developments through SEC filings, earnings calls, and public disclosures.
  • Conduct whitespace analysis and technology mapping to identify new opportunities.

Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in Pharmacy or a related scientific discipline.
  • 8–10 years of relevant experience in Intellectual Property domain within the pharmaceutical industry, preferably with a focus on formulations.

Preferred Skills & Attributes

  • Deep understanding of global patent systems and procedures (including Indian, US, EP, and PCT).
  • Demonstrated expertise in patent analysis, drafting, prosecution, and litigation support.
  • Exposure to P-IV litigations is highly desirable.
  • Expertise in global IP law, with hands-on experience in patent filing, prosecution, and infringement/invalidity analysis.
  • Strong command over FTO analysis, Orange Book navigation, and regulatory IP alignment (including 505(b)(2) applications).
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills with an ability to work effectively in cross-functional and global teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive mindset.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills for effective cross-functional collaboration.
  • Comfort working across multiple time zones and adapting to a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. jobs.title: Performance marketing manager
jobs.description:
Company Description: Amiy Naturals, founded in 2025, India's most effective skincare solutions, offering ingestibeles and topicals that work from within to improve skin health. Amiy's formulas target issues such as acne, pigmentation, inflammation, gut health, and anxiety. Developed in Amiy's laboratories in Bhopal, India, the company focuses on fast, effective, and clean formulations without unnecessary additives, aiming to deliver visible transformation in days.

Performance marketing manager

Location: Bhopal

Reports To: CEO / Founder / Board

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience Level: 2–3 years

About the Role

We're looking for a Performance marketing manager who leads from the front on performance marketing — someone equally comfortable setting company-wide marketing strategy in the boardroom and working on Ads Manager as their everyday task. This is not a purely strategic, hands-off leadership role: we want a manager who will upload a campaign, read a dashboard, and spot inefficiency in real time, while also owning the full marketing organization, budget, and P&L.

You'll be the most senior marketing voice in the company, directly accountable to the CEO/Board for revenue growth, customer acquisition efficiency, and brand health — with performance marketing as your primary task of the business.

Core Focus: Performance Marketing

  • Own end-to-end paid media strategy and execution across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other paid channels (search, shopping, display, retargeting, marketplace ads like Amazon/Flipkart Ads)
  • Set and be accountable for CAC, ROAS, MER (marketing efficiency ratio), and revenue targets across all paid channels
  • Build, launch, and manage campaigns hands-on — audience strategy, bid strategy, budget pacing, creative rotation
  • Run a structured, always-on testing roadmap across creative, copy, audiences, landing pages, and offers
  • Own budget allocation and reallocation across channels/campaigns in real time based on performance
  • Build and maintain advanced performance dashboards and reporting cadences (daily pacing, weekly deep-dives, monthly strategy reviews)
  • Bring benchmarking rigor — know what good CAC/ROAS/CTR looks like for the category and push the team toward it
  • Partner closely with creative/design teams to brief, test, and iterate on ad creative using performance data
  • Ensure robust tracking and attribution infrastructure (GA4, Meta Pixel/CAPI, server-side tracking, UTM governance)
  • Evaluate and pilot new paid channels/formats as they emerge (e.g., retail media, connected TV, programmatic)

Affiliate Marketing

  • Own and scale the affiliate marketing program end-to-end — strategy, recruitment, and performance management
  • Recruit and onboard high-quality affiliate partners, content publishers, coupon/deal sites, and niche influencer-affiliates
  • Negotiate commission structures, exclusive deals, and placement terms with top-performing partners
  • Manage affiliate network platforms (Impact, ShareASale, Refersion, Rakuten Advertising, Awin, PartnerStack, etc.)
  • Continuously audit and optimize the partner mix — identify and cut low-quality/fraudulent traffic, double down on high-LTV partners
  • Track affiliate program performance (incremental revenue, EPC, conversion rate by partner) and report on program health and ROI
  • Build affiliate marketing calendars aligned with sales events, launches, and seasonal pushes
  • Ensure compliance with affiliate program terms, brand guidelines, and disclosure requirements (FTC/ASCI as applicable)
  • Explore adjacent partnership opportunities — cashback platforms, comparison sites, co-marketing deals

Additional Responsibilities (Broader Marketing Leadership)

Influencer Marketing

  • Own affiliate program strategy, partner recruitment, and network management (Impact, ShareASale, Refersion, PartnerStack, Awin, etc.)
  • Build and scale influencer marketing — outreach, gifting, contracts, and partnership negotiation
  • Directly negotiate high-value partnerships and network deals

Social Media & Content Marketing

  • Own social media strategy, brand voice, and content calendar across platforms
  • Own content marketing strategy (blog, video, long-form) supporting SEO, brand, and demand generation

CRM & Loyalty

  • Own CRM/lifecycle marketing strategy across email, SMS, and push (Klaviyo, HubSpot, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, etc.)
  • Design and scale loyalty and referral programs to drive retention and LTV

SEO

  • Set SEO strategy (technical, on-page, content) and own organic traffic/revenue targets

CRO & Marketing Analytics

  • Own the CRO testing roadmap for PDPs, landing pages, and checkout
  • Build and own marketing analytics and attribution capability (multi-touch attribution, MMM as the business scales)

MarTech Stack

  • Own the marketing technology stack — CDP, tag management (GTM), analytics, automation, CRM/ESP
  • Evaluate and implement new tools; ensure clean data flow across systems

E-commerce Platform & Checkout Experience

  • Working knowledge of Shopify and store/app management as it relates to marketing performance
  • Familiarity with checkout optimization tools (Shopflo or similar) and payment gateways (Razorpay, PayU, Stripe, Cashfree, etc.)
  • Partner with tech/product teams to resolve platform issues affecting conversion or attribution

Team & Agency Management

  • Build, lead, and mentor the entire marketing organization (performance, affiliates, social, CRM, SEO, content, analytics)
  • Select and manage external agencies and freelancers; hold them accountable to KPIs

Budget & P&L Ownership

  • Own the total marketing budget — forecasting, allocation, and ROI accountability across every channel
  • Own marketing's contribution to overall company P&L; balance acquisition spend against LTV and margin
  • Present marketing performance, strategy, and financial impact directly to the CEO/Board

Requirements

  • 2-3 years in performance marketing, including significant senior leadership experience in a healthcare or pharmaceutical D2C brand
  • Deep, current hands-on expertise in performance marketing — able to operate in Google Ads/Meta Ads platforms personally, not delegate
  • Demonstrated ownership of large ad budgets and marketing P&L, with clear, quantifiable CAC/ROAS outcomes
  • Proven experience building/scaling affiliate and influencer programs
  • Strong command of marketing analytics, attribution, and MarTech stacks
  • Experience building and leading marketing teams and managing agencies at scale
  • Familiarity with e-commerce platforms (Shopify, Magento, WooCommerce), checkout tools, and payment gateways
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills — able to operate as a peer to the CEO/Board

Looking for

  • Prior experience at a healthcare or pharmaceutical consumer brand
  • Experience scaling a marketing org from seed to series
  • Managing and scaling high ARRs with a consistent growth trajectory
  • Exposure to PR, communications and collaborations
  • MBA or equivalent strategic business background
  • Preferably a technical education and prior experience

Compensation

Competitive salary, 2% equity shares with a vesting period of 4 years with a 1 year cliff

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About The Company

Persistent Systems is a global technology services company renowned for delivering innovative solutions across various industries, including healthcare, finance, and manufacturing. With a strong focus on digital transformation, persistent innovation, and customer success, Persistent Systems has established itself as a trusted partner for organizations seeking to leverage technology for business growth. The company emphasizes a collaborative culture that fosters continuous learning, diversity, and inclusion, ensuring employees are empowered to reach their full potential. Persistent Systems is committed to maintaining high standards of integrity, excellence, and social responsibility, making it a preferred employer for talented professionals worldwide.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst specializing in healthcare data to join our dynamic team at Persistent Systems. In this role, you will be instrumental in analyzing complex healthcare datasets, building scalable data models, and supporting data integration efforts to enhance our healthcare analytics capabilities. Your expertise will help us develop efficient cloud infrastructure, automate system health checks, and optimize data workflows. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including data engineering, operations, and clinical stakeholders, to deliver actionable insights that drive strategic decision-making. This position offers an excellent opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies in a fast-paced environment, contributing to impactful healthcare initiatives focused on value-based care, population health, and quality improvement.

Qualifications

To succeed in this role, candidates should possess a bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Statistics, Healthcare Analytics, or a related field. A minimum of 7 years of hands-on experience working with US healthcare datasets, including claims, benefits, and eligibility data, is required. Proficiency in SQL for querying and analyzing large healthcare datasets is essential. Familiarity with modern data warehousing platforms such as Snowflake and MySQL, along with experience in healthcare data modeling, is highly desirable. Candidates should have strong analytical, problem-solving, and data validation skills, as well as excellent communication abilities to effectively collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience creating process and data flow documentation using tools like Microsoft Visio or draw.io will be advantageous.

Responsibilities

The primary responsibilities of this role include healthcare data analysis and reporting, which involves analyzing large-scale US healthcare datasets, including claims, provider, utilization, and quality data. You will write and optimize complex SQL queries to extract, validate, and analyze data, ensuring accuracy and reliability for regulatory and business reporting needs. Supporting healthcare data modeling and integration is a key aspect, requiring collaboration with data engineering teams to facilitate the reliable ingestion of data from source systems such as claims processing platforms and provider systems.

You will also be involved in process mapping and documentation, creating detailed process flows, data lineage diagrams, and system architecture visuals to streamline healthcare data workflows. Documenting healthcare business rules, data definitions, metrics logic, and reporting methodologies will be vital in maintaining standardization and ensuring clarity across teams. Additionally, you will partner with various stakeholders—including Healthcare Operations, Finance, Clinical, Quality, and Compliance teams—to understand their reporting needs, translate complex data into clear insights, and present findings to leadership and cross-functional teams effectively.

Benefits

Persistent Systems offers a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional growth of our employees. We emphasize a culture focused on talent development, providing quarterly growth opportunities, and sponsoring higher education and certifications to enhance your skills. Employees have access to work with the latest technologies and participate in engaging initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards. Additionally, we provide annual health check-ups and insurance coverage, including group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization plans for employees and their families, including spouses, children, and parents.

Equal Opportunity

Persistent Systems is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind and welcome applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, regardless of gender or gender preference. We support hybrid work arrangements and flexible hours to accommodate diverse lifestyles. Our offices are accessibility-friendly, equipped with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities. If you have specific requirements related to your disability, please inform us during the application process or at any point during your employment. We believe that diversity strengthens our organization and are dedicated to providing an equitable environment where everyone can thrive.

jobs.title: OT Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description: Operation Theatre (OT) Manager

Job Summary

The Operation Theatre (OT) Manager is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations of the Operation Theatre complex, ensuring the efficient delivery of high-quality surgical services while maintaining patient safety, regulatory compliance, and optimal resource utilization. The role involves managing OT staff, coordinating surgical schedules, ensuring equipment and consumables are available, and collaborating with surgeons, anesthetists, nursing teams, and hospital departments to deliver seamless perioperative care.

Success in this role is measured by efficient OT utilization, adherence to patient safety and infection control standards, minimal surgery delays or cancellations, high clinical quality, and a positive experience for patients and clinicians. The OT Manager plays a critical role in supporting the hospital's surgical services and operational excellence.

Key ResponsibilitiesOT Operations Management

  • Oversee the daily functioning of all Operation Theatres to ensure smooth and efficient surgical services.
  • Plan and coordinate OT schedules in collaboration with surgeons, anesthetists, and nursing teams.
  • Monitor OT utilization and optimize theatre efficiency to minimize delays and cancellations.
  • Ensure timely preparation of operating rooms before every procedure.
  • Coordinate emergency surgeries while balancing scheduled elective procedures.

Team Leadership

  • Supervise, mentor, and manage OT nurses, technicians, attendants, and support staff.
  • Prepare staff duty rosters and ensure adequate manpower across all shifts.
  • Conduct regular team meetings, performance reviews, and training sessions.
  • Promote a culture of teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Patient Safety & Quality

  • Ensure strict adherence to patient safety protocols, including WHO Surgical Safety Checklist.
  • Monitor compliance with infection prevention and control practices.
  • Ensure proper patient identification, surgical site verification, and safe handling of surgical specimens.
  • Investigate incidents, near misses, and adverse events, and implement corrective actions.

Equipment & Inventory Management

  • Ensure availability and proper functioning of OT equipment and surgical instruments.
  • Coordinate preventive maintenance and calibration with the Biomedical Engineering team.
  • Monitor inventory levels of surgical consumables, implants, and sterile supplies.
  • Coordinate procurement to prevent stock shortages and minimize wastage.

Sterilization & Infection Control

  • Work closely with CSSD to ensure timely sterilization and availability of instruments.
  • Monitor OT cleaning protocols and environmental hygiene standards.
  • Ensure compliance with NABH, biomedical waste management, and infection control guidelines.

Coordination & Communication

  • Liaise with surgeons, anesthetists, ICU, wards, emergency department, laboratory, radiology, pharmacy, and CSSD for smooth patient flow.
  • Coordinate with admission, billing, and front office teams regarding surgical cases.
  • Ensure effective communication with patients and families regarding OT-related processes whenever required.

Compliance & Documentation

  • Ensure complete and accurate OT documentation and maintenance of surgical records.
  • Monitor compliance with hospital policies, legal requirements, and accreditation standards.
  • Participate in internal audits, quality improvement initiatives, and accreditation activities.

Financial & Operational Performance

  • Monitor OT operational costs and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
  • Track OT utilization, turnaround time, cancellation rates, and other operational KPIs.
  • Prepare periodic reports and present operational insights to hospital leadership.
  • Support initiatives to improve productivity, patient satisfaction, and clinical outcomes.

QualificationsEducation

  • Bachelor's Degree with relevant OT experience.
  • Master's Degree in Hospital Administration (MHA) or MBA in Healthcare Management is preferred.

Experience

  • 5–8 years of experience in Operation Theatre management or perioperative services.
  • Minimum 2–3 years of experience in a supervisory or managerial role in a multi-specialty hospital.

Skills

  • Strong leadership and people management skills.
  • Excellent planning, scheduling, and organizational abilities.
  • Sound knowledge of OT workflows, surgical procedures, and perioperative care.
  • Thorough understanding of infection control, sterilization, and patient safety standards.
  • Knowledge of NABH/JCI standards and healthcare regulations.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage emergencies and make quick operational decisions.
  • Proficiency in Hospital Information Systems (HIS) and Microsoft Office.

Certifications (Preferred)

  • Certification in Operation Theatre Nursing or Perioperative Nursing.
  • NABH/Internal Quality Auditor training.
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) and Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) certification.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • OT Utilization Rate
  • On-time Surgery Start Rate
  • OT Turnaround Time
  • Surgery Cancellation Rate
  • Compliance with WHO Surgical Safety Checklist
  • Infection Control Compliance
  • Patient and Surgeon Satisfaction Scores
