jobs.title: Medical Imaging Annotation Specialist (Chest X-Ray / Radiology)
jobs.description:
Hiring: Medical Imaging Annotation Specialist (Chest X-Ray / Radiology)

Location: Remote

Engagement: Long-Term Contract

Industry: Medical Imaging / Healthcare AI / Radiology

We are seeking experienced Medical Imaging Annotation Specialists with strong expertise in Chest Radiography (Chest X-Rays) to support a long-term AI data annotation project focused on medical imaging.

This opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience in interpreting chest radiographs and identifying radiological findings with a high degree of accuracy.

Role Overview

As a Medical Imaging Annotation Specialist, you will review chest X-ray images and accurately identify predefined radiological findings. Your annotations will contribute to the development and evaluation of advanced AI systems used in medical imaging.

This role requires strong clinical knowledge, attention to detail, and experience working with chest radiographs. Familiarity with medical imaging workflows and DICOM files is highly preferred.

Responsibilities

  • Review chest X-ray (CXR) images and identify all applicable radiological findings.
  • Accurately annotate images according to detailed project guidelines.
  • Create structured JSON outputs for each annotated image.
  • Ensure annotations are clinically accurate, consistent, and complete.
  • Follow quality assurance standards and annotation protocols.
  • Work independently while meeting project timelines and quality expectations.
  • Participate in pilot evaluations and ongoing quality reviews.

Findings to be Annotated

Candidates should be able to identify one or more of the following findings on chest X-rays:

  • Pleural Effusion
  • Cardiomegaly
  • Atelectasis
  • Consolidation
  • Edema
  • Emphysema
  • Fibrosis
  • Hernia
  • Infiltration
  • Mass
  • Nodule
  • Pleural Thickening
  • Pneumothorax

Each image may contain none, one, or multiple findings.

Required Qualifications

  • Medical degree or equivalent healthcare qualification with relevant radiology experience.
  • Demonstrated experience interpreting Chest X-Ray (CXR) images.
  • Experience in radiology reporting, medical imaging analysis, or medical image annotation.
  • Strong understanding of thoracic anatomy and common chest pathologies.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to high-quality annotation.
  • Ability to follow structured annotation guidelines and deliver consistent outputs.
  • Strong written English communication skills.

Preferred Background

We welcome applications from professionals such as:

  • Consultant Radiologists
  • Diagnostic Radiologists
  • Chest/Thoracic Radiologists
  • MD Radiology
  • DNB Radiology
  • Radiology Residents (with relevant experience)
  • Medical Imaging Specialists
  • Medical Imaging Annotation Specialists
  • Clinical Imaging Researchers
  • Healthcare AI Annotation Professionals
  • Physicians with significant experience interpreting chest radiographs

Preferred Skills

  • Chest Radiography Interpretation
  • Thoracic Imaging
  • Medical Image Annotation
  • DICOM Viewer Experience
  • Radiology Reporting
  • Medical Imaging AI
  • Clinical Quality Review
  • JSON-based Annotation Workflows
  • Medical Image Quality Assessment
  • Healthcare AI Data Labeling

Pilot Evaluation

As part of the evaluation process, shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a five-image pilot assessment.

The pilot consists of reviewing five chest X-ray PNG images, identifying all applicable findings, and submitting one JSON file for each image based on the provided annotation guidelines.

Please note:

  • The pilot is conducted solely for quality evaluation.
  • The pilot is unpaid.
  • Detailed annotation guidelines and output specifications will be shared with shortlisted candidates before the assessment.

Long-Term Engagement

Candidates who successfully complete the pilot and meet the required quality standards will be considered for the long-term project.

How to Apply

If you have experience in chest radiography, radiology reporting, or medical imaging annotation and are interested in contributing to a large-scale healthcare AI initiative, we encourage you to apply

When applying, please include:

  • Updated CV/Resume
  • Current designation
  • Years of experience in Radiology or Medical Imaging
  • Experience with Chest X-Ray interpretation
  • Experience in medical imaging annotation (if applicable)
  • Experience working with DICOM images or viewers (if applicable)

What if your expertise in healthcare data governance could directly shape how AI understands and works with clinical information — influencing systems that will support patient care and medical decision-making for millions of people

We're looking for experienced Hospital Health Data Governance Leads to help train and evaluate cutting-edge AI models being built for the healthcare space. jobs.title: General Manager Quality
jobs.description:
Role Objective

A key objective of this position is to lead and govern the Quality function at the manufacturing site, ensuring uncompromised product quality, patient safety, and compliance with global regulatory requirements (USFDA, EU-GMP, MHRA, WHO-GMP, TGA, and other regulated markets) across sterile injectable operations. The role is responsible for building a robust Quality Management System, driving a strong quality culture, ensuring inspection readiness, and enabling business continuity through consistent, compliant, and right-first-time manufacturing and testing of injectable products.

Desired Candidate Profile

  • B.Pharm / M.Pharm / M.Sc. (Chemistry or Microbiology) or equivalent; a Ph.D. or additional certification in Quality/Regulatory Affairs will be an added advantage.
  • 18–22 years of progressive experience in Quality Assurance/Quality Control, with a mandatory and demonstrable background in pharma injectable (sterile/parenteral) manufacturing – vials, ampoules, PFS, lyophilized products, or biologics.
  • Prior experience of successfully hosting and clearing regulatory inspections (USFDA, EU-GMP, MHRA, WHO, ANVISA, etc.) at an injectable facility.
  • Proven track record in leading site quality operations for a large-scale, high-volume sterile manufacturing plant.
  • Strong exposure to aseptic processing, isolator/RABS technology, media fill validation, and environmental monitoring programs.
  • Demonstrated leadership in managing large, multi-level quality teams (QA, QC, Microbiology, Validation, Regulatory Compliance).
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to interface with regulators, corporate quality, and site leadership.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Provide strategic leadership to the site Quality function (QA, QC, Microbiology, Validation, and Documentation) in line with corporate quality objectives.
  • Own and drive the site Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring alignment with global GMP/GDP standards.
  • Set annual quality objectives, KPIs, and improvement plans for the site.
  • Ensure regulatory compliance and inspection readiness for all applicable health authorities.
  • Lead preparation for and hosting of USFDA, EU-GMP, MHRA, WHO-GMP, and other customer/regulatory audits.
  • Ensure timely closure of audit observations, CAPAs, and warning letter responses, where applicable.
  • Govern quality systems specific to sterile/injectable manufacturing.
  • Oversee aseptic process validation, media fills, environmental monitoring, and sterility assurance programs.
  • Ensure robust control over deviations, OOS/OOT, change controls, CAPA, and market complaints.
  • Drive Quality Risk Management across manufacturing, packaging, and laboratory operations.
  • Implement risk-based approaches (QRM/ICH Q9) for critical process and product quality attributes.
  • Lead validation and qualification programs.
  • Ensure equipment, utility, process, and cleaning validations are executed and maintained in a validated state.
  • Build and mentor a high-performing Quality organization.
  • Develop talent, succession plans, and training programs to strengthen quality capability at the site.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams (Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs) to ensure quality is embedded across the value chain.
  • Report site quality performance, risks, and compliance status to senior leadership and corporate quality on a periodic basis.

Functional Skills Required

  • In-depth knowledge of cGMP, GLP, GDP, and global regulatory guidelines (USFDA, 21 CFR 211, EU Annex 1, ICH Q7-Q10).
  • Strong command of sterile/injectable manufacturing processes – aseptic filling, lyophilization, terminal sterilization, and container closure integrity.
  • Expertise in Quality Management Systems: deviations, CAPA, change control, OOS/OOT investigations, and complaint management.
  • Sound knowledge of validation and qualification (process, cleaning, equipment, computer system validation).
  • Experience with data integrity requirements (ALCOA+) and computerized system compliance (21 CFR Part 11).
  • Working knowledge of Quality Risk Management tools (FMEA, HACCP, QRM as per ICH Q9).
  • Proficiency in handling regulatory audits, customer audits, and corporate quality reviews independently.
  • Familiarity with statistical tools and trending techniques for quality data analysis.

Behavioral Skills Required

  • Strong leadership and people management capability to lead large, cross-functional teams.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Overview


Cactus Life Sciences partners with the global biopharma industry to drive innovation and elevate patient outcomes through agile, science-driven medical communications. We transform complex data into actionable insights, bridging the critical gaps between research, decision-making, and real-world healthcare impact. We are seeking an experiencedcandidate for the Account managers role.
The Account Manager (AM) plays a crucial role in managing accounts and standard projects independently, ensuring they are completed on budget, on schedule, and to the required specifications. This role is critical in meeting the organization's KPIs and consistently meeting clients expectations. Additionally, AMs may support larger, more complex accounts and projects under the guidance of senior team members.
Please note: While we are a remote-first organization, this role is specifically for candidates located on the East Coast of the US.


Responsibilities


Five core responsibilities underpin the role of the AM:

1) Client Management: Building strong client relationships to support account growth and assist in maintaining Key Account Plans (KAPs)

  • Support and collaborate with senior CS team to develop KAPs and maintain client engagement plan, helping to ensure successful delivery of anticipated annual fee
  • Along with the Medical Account Lead build and maintain solid relationships with clients to ensure account sustainability and growth
  • Support senior CS team to develop scopes of work
  • Share client insights with senior CS team to develop preferred ways of working on account and be a knowledge point for account health checks.
  • Actively seeks first-hand client feedback, and seeks support from senior team members to implement new solutions
  • Maintain regular client communications ensuring service levels are being met. Where needed, flag concerns to senior team members to help support risk mitigation plan(s)
  • Update CRM/Excel (client meetings, objectives, financial insights) for account(s)
  • Willing to travel to client meetings and for onsite responsibilities

2) Strategic and commercial insight: With Medical / CS Account Leads work towards trusted advisership with clients, supporting client discussions

  • Seek advice from senior CS support (e.g., line manager, CSD) to understand client's broader enterprise environment
  • Ensure implementation of MSA framework (e.g., hourly rates, charging for travel time) and internal processes, seeking support if required.
  • Seek to understand the therapy area, product, and asset competitors, as well as knowledge of CLS services
  • Seek to understand client's broader environment e.g., governing body limitations such as ISMPP/ABPI/Sunshine Act, and evolving opportunities such as social media and AI to ensure best possible solutions for accounts and service offerings

3) Account team leadership: Supports smooth running of accounts through project management excellence

  • Ensure smooth account delivery by leading status meetings, maintaining proactive client communication, tracking project timelines and finances, prioritizing workload, and fostering strong collaboration across internal teams with clear role understanding.
  • Request support from senior CS team members (e.g., line manager, CSD) to cascade negative client feedback to the team
  • Utilize CS Leadership (e.g., Executive Sponsor/CSD) support for complex, strategic, innovative and new service projects.
  • On accounts, attend standard project briefings and client debriefs (with Medical Account Lead and senior CS support, where needed). Embed key learnings and improved ways of working on account delivery
  • Regularly review (monthly) performance of account (quality/project recoveries/timelines/fee vs forecast)
  • With support of senior CS team (e.g., Executive Sponsor/CSD), embrace team changes (where necessary), retaining a flexible mindset
  • With support of senior CS team (e.g., line manager, CSD) cascade client's internal processes and MSA account specifics to account team, to facilitate ongoing adherence (including compliance training, Sunshine/EFPIA reporting, AE reporting, financial aspects etc.)

4) Business maintenance: Identify organic account growth opportunities and where appropriate make recommendations to the client

  • Where possible, identify and generate new opportunities within existing accounts, calling upon expertise of senior CS team to explore new project types / opportunities.
  • Increase knowledge of Cactus Medical capabilities and service offerings.
  • With support of senior CS team, develop proposals on existing account(s) to drive organic growth
  • Along with CS leadership, implement client engagement plan (as part of KAP) to sustain and grow account (with sign off from Executive Sponsor)

5) Financial/KPI accountability: Support in achieving account financial targets with an understanding of interconnected KPIs

  • Clear knowledge of organizational metrics and what is needed from account teams
  • Support senior CS team with account data (where required) for their MSA negotiations and meetings with procurement
  • With support of senior CS team, assist in the development of KAPs with input from Medical Account Lead and Project Management Account Lead
  • Ensures accurate monthly financial reporting including development of SoWs and simple reconciliations, out of scope tracking and flagging to client, assessing fee vs forecast flagging gaps accordingly to senior CS team member
  • Support senior CS Lead in securing annual project conversion and organic growth to meet account targets in support of repeat/continual business
  • Ensure formal approval (from Finance and Executive Sponsor) obtained before any discounts, rebates, and write-offs are provided to the client
  • Where possible, assist in the development of streamlined / efficient account reporting practices and circulate to broader client service team

Qualifications and Prerequisites


  • Degree minimum (life science degree advantageous) or demonstrable experience in medical communications or pharmaceutical industry. Fluency in English, both written and spoken, fluency in other languages is beneficial
  • 2+ years experience within healthcare communications agencies (medical communications preferable).
  • Demonstrable client relationship building skills, experience in leading small accounts and/or multiple projects. Understands the importance of KPI measurement within a business setting
  • Microsoft Office suite (e.g., Microsoft Project), Adobe, AI utilization, omnichannel/digital knowledge

Benefits of this Role


  • Annual leaves, public holidays, personal days, and a special day off for your birthday
  • Supportive leave options including maternity, paternity, and sabbatical opportunities
  • Comprehensive health coverage for you and your family, including dental and vision care
  • Holistic wellness supports access to medical, mental health, and specialist care
  • Financial security through life assurance and income protection
  • Retirement savings plan with employer contributions and flexible options
  • Company-provided mobile phone to keep you connected

Application Process


Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised.Our selection process involves an initial screening by a recruiter, and two interview rounds.

Equal Opportunity

Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed.We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

AI at Cactus Life Sciences

The life sciences industry is undergoing a fundamental shift in how scientific knowledge is created, communicated, and delivered. We are building our work around it.

AI is embedded meaningfully across everything we do, through proprietary platforms purpose-built for life sciences and generative tools that deliver measurable value to our clients. It is core to how we operate, and an expected way of working for everyone who joins us.

We believe in Human-Anchored AI™: whatever your discipline - science, communications, strategy, or operations, you will work in an environment where AI augments your expertise rather than replaces it.

You will build skills that are in genuine demand and still taking shape across the industry. If you are curious and focused on building capabilities for the world where human intelligence meets artificial intelligence, this is where you belong.


About CACTUS


At Cactus Life Sciences (cactuslifesciences.com), we believe the future of medical communications lies at the intersection of science, technology, and human connection. Headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, with teams in Switzerland, the United Kingdom, India, and Japan, we help biopharmaceutical organizations redefine scientific exchange - leveraging AI, automation, and innovation while keeping patients at the heart of everything we do.


Our expertise spans medical strategy, scientific content development, and medical education across therapeutic areas and the product lifecycle. By blending scientific rigor, agile operational models, and future-ready technologies, we partner with medical affairs teams to catalyze their transformation, adapt to a changing landscape, and drive meaningful outcomes for healthcare communities worldwide.

Company Description KITES Senior Care is a geriatric care specialist brand founded in Bangalore, India, in 2016 by experienced doctors and healthcare professionals to serve as a trusted care continuum partner for older adults and their families. The organization focuses on providing personalized, evidence-based care that supports the medical, emotional, and social needs of seniors. KITES Senior Care delivers services at home, in senior living communities, and through its Assisted Care Centers, ensuring continuity of care across settings. Trusted by over 2,000 families, the team is committed to safety, dignity, and quality of life for every client.
Role Description The Chief Medical Officer (CMO) will provide clinical leadership and oversight for geriatric care services at KITES Senior Care. This part-time, on-site role is based in Kochi and involves guiding medical protocols, supervising clinical teams, and ensuring adherence to best practices in geriatric medicine. The CMO will review and refine care pathways, participate in case discussions, and collaborate with multidisciplinary staff to optimize outcomes for older adults in home care, senior living, and Assisted Care Centers. Day-to-day responsibilities include clinical governance, quality and safety monitoring, utilization management, and coordination with operational leadership to align medical strategy with organizational goals. The CMO will also engage in strategic planning, contribute to managed care initiatives, and support medical affairs activities, including training, stakeholder communication, and regulatory compliance.
Qualifications
  • Strong clinical expertise in Medicine, with a focus on geriatrics or internal medicine, and demonstrated experience caring for older adults.
  • Proficiency in Utilization Management and Managed Care to ensure appropriate, cost-effective, and high-quality clinical services.
  • Experience in Medical Affairs, including clinical governance, protocol development, and collaboration with multidisciplinary teams.
  • Ability in Strategic Planning to shape and implement medical strategy, quality initiatives, and long-term service development.
  • Valid medical degree (MBBS or equivalent) and relevant postgraduate qualification; current medical licensure in India.
  • Prior leadership experience in a clinical or healthcare management role, preferably in geriatric care or long-term care settings.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and mentoring skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with diverse clinical and non-clinical staff.
  • Commitment to ethical, person-centered care and familiarity with elder care regulations and quality standards.

2. Debtors Management & Collections

  • Outstanding Analysis: Conduct periodical reviews of total debtors outstanding alongside detailed overdue analysis.

jobs.title: IT Applications Engineer - Technology IT
jobs.description:
About Signant Health

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.

About The Role

The IT Applications Engineer is a generalist engineering and support role responsible for the day-to-day administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of Signant Health's core business applications. The role carries particular depth in NetSuite, Microsoft 365, Box, and Atlassian (Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence), while also supporting the broader enterprise application portfolio as needed.

This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role that blends technical engineering — configuration, scripting, integrations, automations, and upgrades — with day-to-day operational support — tickets, incidents, and user requests. The IT Applications Engineer is a trusted first- and second-line point of contact for application issues, and is equally comfortable delivering enhancements and automations that improve reliability and reduce manual effort across the application landscape. Where the IT Application Operations Manager sets direction and leads the team, this role does the technical and support work directly, partnering closely with the Service Operations, Infrastructure Operations, and Security Operations teams.

What You Will Do

  • Application Administration & Configuration — Own day-to-day administration and configuration of NetSuite, Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, Entra ID), Box, and Atlassian (Jira, JSM, Confluence), plus other assigned enterprise applications, including user provisioning, permissions, and platform settings.
  • Technical Support & Incident Resolution — Act as a key point of escalation for tier 2/3 application support tickets, diagnosing and resolving issues across the supported application stack and coordinating with vendors and other IT teams as needed.
  • Engineering & Customization — Build and maintain customizations to meet business requirements — including SuiteScript/SuiteFlow (NetSuite), Power Automate/Graph API automations (Microsoft 365), workflow and scripting configuration (Atlassian), and equivalent customizations for other supported applications.
  • Integrations & Automation — Develop and support integrations between applications using APIs, webhooks, and low-code/iPaaS tooling, building automations that reduce manual effort and improve reliability.
  • Change, Release & Patch Management — Plan, test, and execute upgrades, patches, and configuration changes across supported applications, minimizing disruption to the business.
  • Security & Compliance — Apply access control, licensing, and data-handling practices aligned with company security policy and relevant regulatory and quality requirements.
  • Monitoring & Continuous Improvement — Monitor application health, usage, and performance; proactively identify issues and recommend and implement improvements.
  • Vendor & Stakeholder Coordination — Liaise with software vendors and business stakeholders on support cases, licensing, and roadmap requests for supported platforms.
  • Documentation & Knowledge Sharing — Maintain runbooks, configuration standards, and knowledge base articles; participate in knowledge transfer and cross-training to build coverage across the application portfolio.
  • AI & Automation Adoption — Identify and pilot opportunities to apply AI-assisted tooling, agents, and low-code automation to improve support efficiency and business workflows.
  • Roadmap Support — Contribute to application-specific roadmaps for releases, improvements, and vendor-provided enhancements, in partnership with the IT Application Operations Manager.

Preferred Qualifications

  • NetSuite — Administration and configuration; SuiteScript 2.x and SuiteFlow; saved searches/SuiteAnalytics; SuiteTalk and REST API integrations.
  • Microsoft 365 — Administration of Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, and Entra ID (Azure AD); familiarity with Intune and the Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps).
  • Box — Content management administration, permissions and governance, and API-based integrations.
  • Atlassian — Administration and configuration of Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence, including workflow design and scripting (e.g., ScriptRunner).
  • APIs & Integrations — Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, and low-code/iPaaS tools (e.g., Power Automate, N8N, Boomi) for connecting applications.
  • Scripting & Automation — Proficiency in at least one scripting language (JavaScript, PowerShell, or Python) for customization, troubleshooting, and automation.
  • Application Lifecycle Management — Experience with patching, upgrades, testing, and change management for SaaS/cloud and on-premise applications.
  • Security & Compliance Awareness — Understanding of access management, data protection, and relevant compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GxP where applicable).
  • ITSM & Monitoring Tools — Familiarity with ticketing/ITSM tooling (e.g., Jira Service Management) and application monitoring/observability tools.

Decision Making and Influence

  • Clear and effective communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Good organizational and time-management skills across competing priorities.
  • Ability to document clearly and concisely for varied audiences.
  • Adaptability and resilience amid changing priorities and technologies.
  • Effective cross-team collaboration with Infrastructure, Security, Automation, and Business Analyst teams.

Desired Qualifications

  • Hands-on, detail-oriented problem solver who takes ownership of issues through to resolution.
  • Strong technical curiosity and comfort learning new platforms and technologies quickly.
  • Customer-service mindset, balancing user needs with operational and security requirements.
  • Self-motivated, able to manage multiple applications and competing priorities simultaneously.
  • Collaborative team player who shares knowledge and supports colleagues across time zones.
  • Calm and methodical under pressure, especially during incidents or critical deployments.

Why Signant Health

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.

If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.

At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all candidates are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.

The Senior Manager 2 will provide comprehensive programming expertise to lead and support all programming activities as per the project strategies. The incumbent should be able to work independently implementing and executing the programming and project standards to support ongoing clinical studies and requests for study report, regulatory submission, and ad hoc/post hoc analysis. The incumbent will work closely with internal partnering functions, stakeholders, and external functional service providers to ensure all the programming deliverables are delivered in timely manner with high quality.   • Develop and maintain programming documentations following programming standards and processes. Create CDISC standard SDTM mapping specifications and ADaM specifications.

  • Participate and contribute towards department goals, SOPs, training guidelines and SME topics.
  • Mentor and Coach new hires and junior programmers.

  • Proficiency in SAS programming skills in a clinical data environment with excellent analytical skills. Working knowledge of other programming languages such as R, Python etc. is a plus.
  • Excellent knowledge of pharmaceutical clinical development (i.e., understanding of statistical concepts, techniques, and clinical trial principles) and regulatory submissions (NDA, ANDA etc.).

  • Ability to work independently and on global interdisciplinary teams. Good organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills. Positive attitude, team player and growth mindset.

  • Hands-on programming as well as people and process management experience.
  • Demonstrated and applied SAS programming skills. SAS certificates a plus.

The organization is known for compassionate, efficient service and a commitment to enhancing every stage of a woman's life. Motherhood provides holistic care spanning gynaecological and reproductive health, labour and delivery, and pediatric services from the fetal stage through adolescence and young adulthood. The hospitals combine experienced clinical teams with state-of-the-art technology and infrastructure to deliver high-quality, dignified care and support informed decision-making for patients and families.
Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Physiotherapist role based at Motherhood in Chennai. The Physiotherapist will assess patients physical conditions, develop individualized treatment plans, and provide evidence-based therapeutic interventions for women and children across different life stages. Daily responsibilities include conducting clinical evaluations, delivering physiotherapy sessions, guiding patients through exercise programs, and monitoring progress to adjust care plans as needed. The role also involves educating patients and caregivers on rehabilitation, preventive care, and safe movement practices, while collaborating with obstetricians, gynaecologists, paediatricians, and nursing staff to ensure coordinated, holistic care. The Physiotherapist maintains accurate clinical documentation, adheres to hospital protocols, and supports quality and safety initiatives within the department.
Qualifications

  • Clinical physiotherapy expertise, including assessment, treatment planning, and delivery of therapeutic exercises and manual therapy.
  • Knowledge of women's health, obstetric and postnatal physiotherapy, and pediatric/ adolescent rehabilitation is highly desirable.
  • Strong patient-centered communication skills, with the ability to educate and counsel patients and caregivers in a clear, empathetic manner.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team and contribute to integrated care pathways.
  • Good documentation, organizational, and time-management skills to handle a structured clinical workload.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Physiotherapy from a recognized institution; valid professional registration/licensure as applicable.
  • Previous experience in hospital-based physiotherapy or women & child health settings is an advantage.
  • Commitment to evidence-based practice, continuous learning, and adherence to ethical and safety standards.
  • This position is offered on an 8-month contract basis.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Associate
jobs.description:
Senior Legal Associate

ABOUT DOCEREE

Doceree Inc, is the world's first Healthcare OS built for the pharmaceutical and life sciences ecosystem. As a pioneering global network of physician-only platforms, Doceree enables programmatic, AI-driven communication between pharma brands and healthcare professionals (HCPs) at the point of care and beyond.

Operating across 25 countries with offices in the US, India, and the UK, Doceree delivers precision HCP engagement through a suite of products spanning programmatic advertising, AI-powered sales enablement, co-pay solutions, and digital out-of-home. Our technology sits at the intersection of healthcare data intelligence, adtech infrastructure, and SaaS, and our legal function is built to match that complexity.

Our core belief: technology can connect fragmented healthcare ecosystems to deliver the right information, at the right moment, to improve patient outcomes. For the legal team, that belief is not abstract. Every contract we negotiate, every risk position we take, and every commercial structure we build is in service of that mission. We are not a support function. We are a strategic enabler of a business that is changing how healthcare professionals receive information and how patients get better care. The legal team at Doceree is built to operate at the speed and complexity that mission demands.

THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced Senior Legal Associate to join Doceree's in-house legal team in Noida. This role goes beyond day-to-day contract execution: you will own template development, playbook creation, and process infrastructure for the contracting function, while handling a portfolio of complex commercial agreements independently. This role sits at the intersection of:

  • Commercial contracting
  • Data privacy & healthcare regulation
  • AI-enabled legal operations

Reporting to the Associate Director - Legal, you will be a senior individual contributor who shapes how Doceree's legal function scales. You will interact directly with US-based commercial teams, senior business stakeholders, and external counterparty counsel. The work is fast-paced, multi-jurisdictional, and demands both legal precision and commercial judgment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own end-to-end negotiation of complex commercial agreements including NDAs, Statements of Work, Insertion Orders, Amendments, Master Service Agreements, Data related agreements (DVAs, DPAs, TPAs and DUAs).
  • Comfort engaging with data-related clauses (data sharing, confidentiality, and basic data protection obligations) in commercial agreements. Provide first-line guidance on data privacy obligations under HIPAA, CCPA, and GDPR as they arise in commercial contracts, escalating and coordinating with external counsel where required.
  • Build and maintain negotiation playbooks for each contract type, including preferred positions, acceptable fallbacks, and escalation triggers.
  • Primary focus will be on complex commercial contracting and negotiation, with gradual ownership of playbooks, templates, and process improvements.
  • Independently manage end-to-end contract lifecycle from intake to execution.
  • Identify legal and commercial risks and propose mitigation strategies.
  • Manage the contracting pipeline with end-to-end TAT ownership and proactive status reporting to the AD - Legal.
  • Identify process inefficiencies and propose automation or CLM enhancements to reduce manual workload.
  • Contribute to legal ops initiatives including CLM tool optimisation, contract tracking, and reporting infrastructure.
  • Support junior team members with contract knowledge, review feedback, and structured mentoring where required.

WHO YOU ARE

You bring the following to this role:

  • 5 to 8 years of post-qualification experience in commercial contracting, with demonstrated independent ownership of complex negotiations.
  • Deep working knowledge of MSA, SoW, NDA, IO, DPA, and Addendum structures across technology, SaaS, adtech, or pharma / life sciences commercial models.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain negotiation playbooks - not just use them.
  • Working familiarity with US data privacy frameworks including HIPAA, CCPA, and GDPR as they manifest in commercial DPAs and MSAs.
  • Experience with CLM tools for pipeline management and workflow automation (SpotDraft, Ironclad, Icertis, or equivalent).
  • Comfort operating as the primary legal interface for senior business stakeholders and external counsel on commercial matters.
  • Ability to independently identify material risk deviations and propose and defend well-reasoned legal positions without senior oversight on standard matters.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English: correspondence and live negotiation with US-based commercial teams is a core part of this role.
  • LL.B. or B.A. LL.B. from a recognised institution.
  • Prior in-house experience at a technology, SaaS, health tech, pharma or global adtech company.

Preferred:

  • Exposure to AI-assisted contract review tools (Harvey, Wordsmith AI, GC AI, Ivo, Spellbook, or equivalent) or general LLM tools (Claude, ChatGPT) applied to legal workflows will be considered a differentiator from other candidates.
  • Experience supporting or leading legal ops initiatives including CLM implementation, contract tracking dashboards, or team-level process design.
  • Understanding of US programmatic advertising, HCP data ecosystems, or pharma commercial contracting models.

WHAT MAKES DOCEREE DIFFERENT

  • You will work on real, consequential agreements from day one, not shadow reviews or internal memos.
  • The legal team operates as a US-standard in-house function, not a traditional Indian corporate legal team.
  • You will have direct exposure to global counterparties, cross-border contract structures, and multi-jurisdictional commercial law.
  • The company is AI-forward by design: the legal team is expected to be at the forefront of how AI changes legal practice, not behind it.
  • Doceree is one of the top players globally in HCP-targeted programmatic advertising - the contracts you work on shape a category-defining business.
  • You will be part of a lean, senior team where your work is visible, your judgment is trusted, and your growth is accelerated.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive compensation as per industry norms
  • Generous leave policy
  • Group medical insurance
  • Full-time, in-office role based in Noida: structured environment with a collaborative, high-performance culture
  • Direct mentorship from senior legal leadership with a clear and fast career progression track
  • Exposure to US-facing commercial transactions and cross-border legal work from day one
  • Access to cutting-edge AI and legal tech tools: Doceree actively invests in legal function infrastructure

OUR COMMITMENT

At Doceree, we believe the strength of our team lies in the diversity of the people in it. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace where every individual is evaluated based on their skills, experience, and contribution, regardless of gender, background, nationality, or any other characteristic. If you require any reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Reg Submission Lead, SDE- LCM
jobs.description:
Business Introduction

At GSK, we have bold ambitions for patients, aiming to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade. Our R&D focuses on discovering and delivering vaccines and medicines, combining our understanding of the immune system with cutting-edge technology to transform people's lives. GSK fosters a culture ambitious for patients, accountable for impact, and committed to doing the right thing, making sure that we focus our efforts on accelerating significant assets that meet patients needs and have the highest probability of success. We're uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.

Find out more:

Our approach to R&D

Position Summary

The Regulatory Submission Lead is responsible for independently supporting regulatory submission activities, including authoring, reviewing, providing Regulatory registration requirements and compiling dossiers for assigned deliverables in compliance with health authority regulations and GSK policies and processes. The position holder works with the Submission teams, Local Operating Company contacts, Global Regulatory Strategy or Functional Teams (or equivalent) to coordinate and prepare submission packages within the Veeva Vault system.

The position holder will also include mentoring and training new team members.

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for independently delivering assigned submissions as per agreed dossier strategy to the Submission teams, Local Operating Company contacts, Global Regulatory Strategy or Functional Teams (or equivalent), by working collaboratively with functional teams (e.g., CMC, Clinical, Nonclinical, etc.) ensuring adherence to established timelines in assigned markets.
  • Simultaneously oversees, multiple project assignments, including Variations (CMC and Therapeutic), PBRER, Renewals, Site Registrations/Site Renewals, Tenders of more complexity.
  • Manage complex regulatory registration requirements, including those requested directly from regulatory agencies, manufacturing sites or third-party service providers. This includes providing manufacturing site support to meet regulatory expectations.
  • Independently prepare, coordinate and ensure timely delivery of documents requested from health authorities, legalisation providers, manufacturing sites or third parties.
  • Collaborates with staff across various functions and demonstrates the ability to engage with senior-level process development teams by providing advice, interpreting relevant guidelines, conducting research, and resolving complex issues. Possesses comprehensive knowledge of GSK processes and workflows, offering training, consultation, and tailored solutions both within and beyond the department.
  • Ensure alignment with a comprehensive understanding of regulatory requirements, legislation, and guidelines for EU, US, and ROW markets, including Regulatory registration requirements. Independently perform data assessments to confirm that the dossier meets all necessary standards and is fit for purpose.
  • Responsible for conducting scenario planning for multiple regulatory strategies and recommending delivery approaches to support accelerated timelines when needed. Proactively escalates business-impacting issues and suggests potential solutions.
  • Serve as a reviewer for peers deliverables and propose improvements to regulatory processes, policies, and systems, thereby driving efficiency & innovation.
  • Engage with Regulatory Agencies to address and resolve issues within their areas of responsibility.
  • Demonstrates a strong understanding of regulations, guidelines, procedures and policies relating to registration and manufacturing of pharmaceutical products, to expedite submission, review and approval of global applications.
  • Communicate effectively with internal and external GSK stakeholders on project- and policy-related matters with minimal managerial supervision, ensuring the best outcomes for the organization.

Preferred Qualification

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in biological or healthcare science.
  • Preferably 5 years of experience with a strong understanding of industry, drug development, and R&D processes.
  • In-depth knowledge of regulations, guidelines, and policies for pharmaceutical and vaccine registration and manufacturing.
  • Proficient in using Veeva Vault systems to ensure efficient and compliant submission deliverables.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills, with a focus on delivering high-quality results under tight deadlines.
  • Skilled in interpreting global regulatory requirements and providing expert guidance based on recent GSK experience.
  • Adaptable and proactive in managing workloads, priorities, and timelines while effectively collaborating in a matrix environment.
  • Proven ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously and build strong relationships with internal stakeholders

Ready to apply

If you are motivated by meaningful work and want to grow your regulatory career, we'd like to hear from you. Please apply and tell us how your experience will help drive high-quality regulatory submissions.

Skills

Why GSK

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. Reporting to: Hospital Director (Unit) & Group Head HR (Corporate)

Job Purpose: The Unit Head - HR will serve as the strategic HR business partner for the hospital unit and will be responsible for driving people strategy, organizational effectiveness, employee engagement, talent management, and HR operations in alignment with the organization's vision, values, and business objectives. The incumbent will play a pivotal role in creating a high-performance culture by fostering employee engagement, strengthening leadership capability, ensuring regulatory compliance, and implementing best-in-class human resource practices across the organization.

1. HR Strategy and Governance

  • Develop and implement the overall people strategy in alignment with organizational goals and growth plans.

  • Drive organizational effectiveness and cultivate a culture of excellence, collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

  • Develop comprehensive manpower plans based on hospital capacity, bed strength, occupancy levels, productivity benchmarks, staff-to-patient ratios, and business requirements.

3. Talent Acquisition and Workforce Planning

  • Lead end-to-end recruitment and selection activities across clinical, nursing, operational, and corporate functions.
  • Define recruitment strategies and turnaround time (TAT) metrics for all positions.

  • Strengthen assessment methodologies, interview processes, and evaluation frameworks to improve hiring quality and candidate experience.

4. Learning, Development, and Capability Building

  • Develop and implement induction, onboarding, orientation, and mandatory training programs for employees.
  • Ensure compliance with training requirements related to fire safety, radiation safety, infection control, occupational health, and other statutory requirements.
  • Partner with department heads to identify technical, functional, behavioral, and leadership development needs.
  • Drive learning initiatives through digital learning platforms and learning management systems (LMS).
  • Promote continuous learning and capability development across the organization.

5. Performance and Talent Management

  • Lead the performance management process, including goal setting, performance reviews, normalization, feedback mechanisms, and annual appraisal cycles.
  • Work closely with business leaders to identify high-potential employees and critical talent.
  • Develop succession planning frameworks and leadership development initiatives.
  • Design and implement strategies aimed at strengthening employee retention and enhancing organizational capability.

6. Compensation, Benefits, and HR Operations

  • Ensure effective administration of payroll, compensation and benefits, transfers, promotions, market corrections, incentives, separations, and full-and-final settlements.
  • Drive the effective utilization of HR technology platforms, including HRMS and SAP systems.
  • Conduct compensation benchmarking exercises and support annual compensation review processes.
  • Ensure the highest standards of accuracy, efficiency, and compliance across all HR operations.

7. Compliance and Employee Relations

  • Ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws, statutory regulations, and employment-related guidelines.
  • Liaise with regulatory and statutory authorities, including labour departments, provident fund authorities, ESI authorities, insurance providers, banks, and other government agencies.
  • Oversee disciplinary processes, grievance management, domestic inquiries, and conflict resolution initiatives.
  • Lead industrial relations activities and maintain harmonious relationships with employees and external stakeholders.
  • Conduct regular audits to strengthen governance, risk management, and compliance.

8. Employee Experience and Engagement

  • Develop and implement employee engagement strategies to enhance employee satisfaction, retention, and productivity.
  • Promote an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing work environment.
  • Drive initiatives related to employee well-being, recognition, diversity, inclusion, and organizational culture.

9. Accreditation and Quality Initiatives

  • Lead all people-related initiatives associated with NABH, JCI, and other accreditation standards.
  • Ensure adherence to all human resources policies, processes, and documentation requirements mandated by accreditation bodies.
  • Support continuous quality improvement initiatives across the organization.

10. Leadership and Stakeholder Management

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the Hospital Director and the corporate HR leadership team.
  • Mentor, coach, and guide HR managers and team members to strengthen organizational capability.
  • Partner closely with department heads to support organizational transformation initiatives and business priorities.
  • Lead the implementation of HR systems and process improvement initiatives across the hospital.

Education and Experience

  • MBA or Postgraduate qualification in Human Resources or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 12–15 years of progressive HR experience within healthcare.
  • Strong understanding of talent management, organizational development, and HR operations.
  • Experience in managing large and diverse workforces in a multi-specialty hospital environment will be given preference.

Competencies

jobs.description:
Job Description

Drug Safety Physician

We are seeking a drug physician in Biocon Biologics Pharmacovigilance who independently or in association with senior physicians will be responsible for continuous evaluation of the safety profile of company products through adverse event monitoring, supporting clinical trial PV safety activities, overseeing aggregate report reviews, safety signal and risk management activities and drive proactive implementation of risk management initiatives to meet global regulatory requirements. The right candidate will have leadership skills, be an excellent communicator with an ability to have oversight over CRO activities and can successfully lead and influence external and internal stakeholders. DSP also serves as a subject matter expert for product-specific safety information.

Responsibilities:

• Contributes to the development & maintenance of product safety profile.

• Involved in all safety surveillance activities, which may include monitoring of adverse event and all other safety information to manage the safety profile of the company products

• Collaborates with, medical monitors and other functional groups in identification, analysis, and reporting of possible safety-related trends or concerns.

• Responsible for the evaluation of safety data from pre-clinical studies, clinical studies, literature and other sources to establish safety profile of company products to manage risk to the patients

• Provides medical input into the identification and utilization of appropriate sources of information and database searches to retrieve relevant data for signal evaluation

• Discuss results of data evaluation with pharmacovigilance safety review team, drug safety committee and/or other key stakeholders

• Provides inputs to literature search strategy and review to effectively determine appropriate and relevant literature for the purposes of safety analysis.

• Responsible for the review of the Risk Management Plans (RMP)/Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) providing expertise to the medical content of the safety specification, risk management plan, risk minimisation measures including the locally implemented risk minimisation measures and drives the implementation of risk minimisation activities in accordance with global regulatory requirements.

• Provides medical input in ensuring that risk minimisation strategies are implemented appropriately in relevant documents such as product reference safety information

• Collaborates with external provider representatives in the preparation and review of aggregate reports having thorough oversight over the critical aspects like summary of safety concerns, benefit risk evaluation, conclusion etc

• Have thorough medical oversight over the external vendors on the medical review of ICSRs

• Provides medical inputs to deliver accurate safety evaluation documents with clear conclusions in response to internal or regulatory authority requests for safety data

• Provides medical inputs in responding to safety questions from regulatory authorities and partners in collaboration with service providers and cross-functional teams

• Review and provides medical inputs to the safety sections of CCDS, local label updates, health hazard analysis, QA trend analysis, device hazard lists, CER etc

• Understands the role of QPPV and contributes to the maintenance of the pharmacovigilance system and process

• Provides inputs to various pharmacovigilance documents like PSMF, SDEA

• Provides input and review for key regulatory or clinical documents (i.e. SMP, protocol, IB, SAE/SUSAR, safety sections of DSUR, ASR, CSR, integrated summaries of safety etc.) related to pharmacovigilance

• Contributes to and leads initiatives for process improvement and consistency regarding aggregate reporting, signal management, risk management plan preparation and responding to ad-hoc safety questions

• Participates and supports pharmacovigilance audit/inspection preparation and CAPA management

• Participates in internal pharmacovigilance committee meetings as well as joint safety meetings with partners.

• Provides inputs in the preparation/revision of SOPs, working guidance and ensuring pharmacovigilance compliance.

• Meets pharmacovigilance commitments to regulatory authorities with respect to marketing authorization.

• Follows good pharmacovigilance practices (ICH, Eudravigilance, local regulations etc).

• Trains and mentors the team members. Other Drug Safety Physician responsibilities include:

• Accountable for maintaining personal readiness in response to internal audit or regulatory inspection

• Includes knowledge of case processing, expedited reporting and safety database concepts

• Proactively raises concerns/issues to senior management in a timely and appropriate manner ensures quality and integrity of the issue/event being escalated

• Demonstrates leadership and interacts collaboratively and effectively in team environment (including safety, clinical development, medical affairs,regulatory, commercial, devices) as well as with external stakeholders

• Must be an excellent communicator and have strong negotiation skills with an ability to have oversight over CRO activities

• Strong organisational skills, including capability to prioritise independently with minimal supervision.

Qualifications

• MD with 10+ years of pharmacovigilance experience in the pharmaceutical industry, clinical care setting, or Academia Page 2 of 3

• Knowledge of the biopharmaceutical industry, drugs and indications with an understanding of applicable guidelines, regulations and best practices for conduct of pharmacovigilance activities.

• High degree of professionalism, maturity, business understanding and passion.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills as well as strong interpersonal skills, with impeccable attention to detail

• Ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders at all levels and influence decision-making.

• Must have knowledge of common data processing software like MS office tools (Excel, Power Point, Microsoft Word etc) Job Location: • Bangalore, India.

jobs.title: Competitive Applications and Grants Researcher & Writer
jobs.description:
About Company:

Kinexcs is an AI-driven digital health platform and wearables company with a mission to enable and empower people for mobility and a better quality of life. It is focused on reducing the burden of musculoskeletal conditions, which affects about 25% of the world's population. Their 1st product, KIMIA Recover, a continuous monitoring device for the knee joint, has obtained FDA Approval, CE marking and HSA approval, and booked revenues from large implant companies and hospitals. It has recently won the Johnson and Johnson Quickfire Challenge Award and has been selected by the Cedars Sinai Healthcare System (#1 in California and #5 in the USA according to US world rankings) for investment and commercial projects using the two products of the company. KIMIA Recover is a comprehensive recovery management solution providing reduction in number of hospital visits and complications for Total Knee Replacement Patients. The product was also the National Winner and International Top 20 of the prestigious James Dyson Award, and has gained traction with major public hospitals and orthopedic clinics.Their digital therapy platform, consisting of KIMIA Assess, uses artificial intelligence technology for digital MSK assessment and therapy. This platform is capable of providing pre-consultation assessments and real-time exercise guidance and feedback to musculoskeletal patients, and is being adopted by some of the largest private healthcare providers in the region, along with large corporate players.

About the Job:

As a Competitive Applications and Grants Researcher & Writer at Kinexcs, you will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, and securing funding opportunities through competitive applications, grants, and awards. You will research relevant calls, craft compelling proposals, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to highlight Kinexcs unique value proposition. Your work will directly support the company's innovation and expansion by strengthening its financial foundation and global recognition.

What You Will Do:

Research & Analysis

  • Proactively identify and track relevant funding opportunities including government grants, research programs, innovation challenges, and international competitions.
  • Analyze eligibility criteria, requirements, and competitive landscapes for each opportunity.
  • Maintain a pipeline/database of upcoming opportunities with deadlines and strategic fit.

Proposal Writing & Submission

  • Develop high-quality, tailored grant applications, proposals, and award submissions.
  • Collaborate with product, clinical, R&D, and business teams to gather technical and business inputs.
  • Ensure applications align with organizational strategy, mission, and product innovation roadmap.
  • Edit, proofread, and refine submissions to ensure clarity, persuasiveness, and compliance.

Strategy & Collaboration

  • Work closely with leadership to prioritize opportunities based on funding potential and strategic alignment.
  • Create templates, best practices, and documentation to streamline future submissions.
  • Provide insights into trends in funding landscapes (e.g., healthtech, AI, medtech grants).
  • Build relationships with funding bodies, grant officers, and program managers to stay updated.

Tracking & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate records of applications submitted, status updates, and outcomes.
  • Track key performance indicators such as win rates and funding amounts secured.
  • Prepare reports and updates for senior leadership on grant activities and pipeline.

What You Need:

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Business, Communications, or related field.
  • 3–5 years of proven experience in grant writing, proposal development, or research funding.
  • Strong track record of successful applications to competitive grants, awards, or research programs.
  • Excellent research, writing, and editing skills with attention to detail.
  • Ability to translate complex scientific/technical information into persuasive, accessible language.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills to manage multiple deadlines.

Preferred

  • Experience in healthcare, medtech, or digital health sectors.
  • Familiarity with global funding programs (EU Horizon, NIH, SBIR, H2020, IMDA, EnterpriseSG, etc.).
  • Knowledge of intellectual property, regulatory, or R&D processes.
  • Prior experience collaborating with clinicians, researchers, or technical teams on applications.

Are you an experienced UX Designer looking for a new opportunity

Do you have experience of using design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Sketch and Figma`

Are you passionate about engaging with others and working as part of a team to achieve shared goals

Who We Are

As NHS Scotland's unique provider of a national tele-health and tele-care service, we are responsible for the delivery of health advice and information by telephone and online services to the population of Scotland 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. NHS 24 is a patient-focused service providing the people of Scotland with triage, advice, guidance, referral and information on health and healthcare services.

We have five regional centres – Aberdeen, Dundee, South Queensferry, Cardonald and Clydebank. NHS 24 supports hybrid working, and this post can be based within any NHS 24 regional centres. The successful candidate must be within commuting distance to a regional centre to attend if required and must also be able to travel to other regional centres when requested to attend meetings, undertake training and any other activities.

The Role

The UX Designer is responsible for researching, designing, and implementing all user experiences when interacting with a digital product or tool. To ensure the end user experience is improved the post holder will engage with key stakeholders to better understand their needs and goals, conduct usability and accessibility testing, design user flows and prototypes. You will also be responsible for creating and supporting continuous user experience improvement across NHS 24.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mock-ups that effectively communicate design concepts and interactions.
  • Work in collaboration with the IT Test Team to create, maintain and report on project exception logs which reflects the exceptions discovered during testing.
  • Impact analysis to identify the impacts upon people, processes, and technology that a proposed solution and/or decision may have, including financial impact.
  • Assess and report on highly complex technical information and situations requiring analysis, interpretation, and comparison of a range of options in order to ensure NHS 24 Technology proposals and solutions offer the best match to organisational need.
  • Interpret national legislation, such as Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.0), to ensure that NHS 24's ICT & Digital deliverables are compliant and meet the required standards.

Successful Applicant Will

  • Be educated to SCQF Level 9 in UX Design, Interaction Design, Human Computer Interaction or a related discipline, or equivalent knowledge and experience.
  • Be experienced in conducting user research, including user interviews, surveys, and usability testing.
  • Demonstrate excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to present and justify design decisions.
  • Have proven experience as a UX Designer, with a portfolio showcasing a range of design projects and solutions.

Benefits

jobs.title: Associate Director, Master Data Stewardship
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Opportunity

  • Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
  • Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
  • Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company's IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.

A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.

Role Overview

As an Associate Director, you will provide strategic direction and business-facing leadership for customer master data stewardship. You will define and advance stewardship operating models, partner with business and technology leaders, and ensure that customer data governance is executed effectively across systems and regions.

You will also lead and develop a team of stewardship professionals while remaining actively engaged in the operational and strategic aspects of customer master data management. This is not solely a people management role; it requires deep subject matter expertise, strong business partnership, and the ability to influence stewardship practices, data quality outcomes, and automation priorities across the enterprise.

Role Description

  • Stewardship Strategy and Operating Model
  • Define and drive the customer master data stewardship strategy in alignment with enterprise data governance objectives and business priorities.
  • Establish and evolve the stewardship operating model, including roles, responsibilities, processes, controls, and escalation paths.
  • Ensure stewardship practices support a trusted customer golden record and enable harmonization, survivorship, and consistency across domains.
  • Partner with business and technology stakeholders to assess current-state challenges and shape future-state stewardship capabilities.
  • Translate business needs into scalable stewardship processes, controls, and service expectations.
  • Governance, Standards, and Data Quality Leadership
  • Oversee the enforcement of master data standards, hierarchies, code sets, survivorship rules, and data quality expectations for customer data.
  • Monitor stewardship effectiveness through data quality metrics, issue trends, SLA performance, and operational dashboards.
  • Lead root cause analysis and remediation initiatives for recurring customer data issues, duplicates, conflicts, and process gaps.
  • Ensure appropriate governance for sensitive customer master data, including PII and PHI, in partnership with the MDM lead and compliance stakeholders.
  • Drive continuous improvement in data quality management and stewardship controls.
  • Business Partnership and Stakeholder Engagement
  • Serve as a senior business-facing leader for customer master data stewardship across commercial and enterprise functions.
  • Build trusted relationships with business leaders, data owners, technology partners, and governance teams to align stewardship priorities and resolve issues.
  • Influence decision-making on customer data policy, process design, and operational trade-offs.
  • Represent stewardship in enterprise forums, governance councils, and transformation initiatives.
  • Communicate risks, progress, and recommendations in a clear, concise, and executive-ready manner.
  • Lead delivery teams and review technical designs and code (if required)
  • Engage senior stakeholders to align data standards, priorities, and roadmap
  • Provide thought leadership on MDM best practices
  • Operational Leadership and Service Management
  • Oversee day-to-day stewardship operations for customer master data, including match/merge, issue triage, lifecycle management, and exception handling.
  • Ensure effective management of customer data requests, system impacts, and downstream dependencies.
  • Monitor and maintain Service Level Agreements (SLAs), operational commitments, and escalation management.
  • Support system upgrades, release readiness, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for MDM changes and enhancements.
  • Ensure operational discipline through documented procedures, controls, and performance review mechanisms.
  • Automation, AI Enablement, and Innovation
  • Champion automation and agentic AI initiatives to reduce manual effort and improve stewardship scalability and responsiveness.
  • Identify opportunities to automate validation, routing, issue classification, reporting, and exception management activities.
  • Partner with technology teams to evaluate and implement intelligent workflows and decision-support capabilities.
  • Promote a culture of innovation within stewardship operations, balancing control with efficiency and scalability.
  • Support adoption of tools and processes that enhance business value and reduce operational friction.
  • Team Leadership and Talent Development
  • Lead, coach, and develop stewardship team members to build functional expertise, accountability, and high performance.
  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and customer-focused team culture.
  • Set clear expectations, provide feedback, and support professional growth and succession planning.
  • Ensure effective workload management, role clarity, and team alignment to business priorities.
  • While people management is a key part of the role, the position remains deeply engaged in strategic stewardship, stakeholder partnership, and operational execution.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 14+ years of experience in data stewardship, master data management, data governance, or related disciplines.
  • Proven experience working with Commercial Pharma domains (HCP/HCO, affiliations, sales, CRM) and leading customer master data stewardship in a complex, regulated enterprise environment.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Informatica MDM.
  • Strong SQL skills are required.
  • Proven experience driving stewardship strategy, governance execution, and data quality improvements.
  • Experience partnering with business leaders and technology teams in a matrixed organization.
  • Experience with merge/unmerge processes, release management, and User Acceptance Testing.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms such as Veeva CRM or comparable systems.
  • Strong understanding of SOP compliance, operational controls, and data privacy requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams while remaining hands-on in strategic and operational stewardship work.
  • Strong executive communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong experience for automation, workflow optimization, or AI-enabled operational transformation is preferred.

Who We Are

We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.

What We Look For

Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

jobs.description:
Company Description

FemLyra is an emerging women-focused healthcare venture by Apna Family, focused on improving access to high-quality, ethical, evidence-based, and technology-enabled healthcare services in New Delhi and across India.

FemLyra is building a trusted digital healthcare ecosystem covering women's wellness, menstrual health, fertility, pregnancy care, preventive healthcare, mental wellness, nutrition, dermatology, online doctor consultations, lab test booking, health reports, and AI-enabled educational wellness support.

The organization aims to combine clinical expertise, patient-first care, technology, and innovation to address unmet needs in women's health and wellness. FemLyra is building services and products that prioritize safety, transparency, privacy, accessibility, and measurable outcomes.

As an early-stage healthcare venture, FemLyra offers the opportunity to help shape its clinical strategy, care pathways, doctor network, patient experience, and long-term medical vision. Prospective co-founders will join a collaborative, mission-driven environment committed to ethical healthcare practice, medical safety, and continuous improvement.

Website: https://femlyra.com/

Role Description

FemLyra is looking for a committed Medical Co-founder / Healthcare Co-founder who will be a core member of the founding team and will help lead the clinical vision, medical standards, and healthcare strategy of the platform.

This is an active co-founder role, not a fixed-salary job, advisory-only role, passive investment role, or short-term consulting opportunity.

The Medical Co-founder will work closely with product, technology, operations, business, and healthcare stakeholders to design safe, evidence-based, and scalable care models for FemLyra.

Day-to-day responsibilities may include developing clinical protocols, reviewing and validating medical content, supporting doctor onboarding and verification, overseeing quality and safety standards, guiding care pathways, and ensuring that FemLyra's healthcare services follow ethical, patient-first, and compliant practices.

The Medical Co-founder will also participate in patient journey design, FemAI safety guidance, teleconsultation workflow development, healthcare partnership discussions, clinical governance, and strategic decision-making.

This role requires both medical leadership and investment commitment.

Investment and Equity

This is a serious investment-based co-founder opportunity.

Mandatory Investment Commitment: ₹20 lakh

 Proposed Equity: 10%, or as mutually discussed and legally documented

Please apply only if you are highly interested in joining FemLyra as an active co-founder and are ready to discuss the mandatory ₹20 lakh investment commitment.

Final investment, equity, vesting, role, responsibilities, decision rights, dilution, exit terms, and legal structure will be discussed transparently and documented through proper founder and shareholder agreements.

Candidates are encouraged to take independent legal and financial advice before entering into any co-founder or investment arrangement.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead FemLyra's clinical vision and medical strategy

 • Develop safe, evidence-based care pathways and consultation workflows

 • Help define clinical protocols for women's health, fertility, pregnancy care, preventive healthcare, mental wellness, dermatology, nutrition, and related services

 • Review and validate medical and wellness content for accuracy and safety

 • Support doctor onboarding, credential verification, and quality standards
