 • Help build a scalable, trusted, and sustainable healthcare offering

 • Minimum 5 years of medical experience

 • Demonstrated clinical experience, preferably in women's health, gynecology, fertility, pregnancy care, primary care, preventive healthcare, public health, or related areas

 • Understanding of healthcare ethics, patient safety, telemedicine practices, and healthcare regulations in India

 • Ability to collaborate with non-medical founders and cross-functional teams, including product, technology, operations, business, and marketing

 • Strong interest in healthcare innovation, digital health, AI-enabled health education, and new care delivery models

 • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain medical concepts clearly to non-clinical stakeholders

 • Entrepreneurial mindset, comfort with ambiguity, and willingness to take ownership in an early-stage startup environment

 • Ability to actively contribute meaningful time to the startup

Preferred Experience

 • Preventive healthcare

 • General practice with women's health exposure

Job Description Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Staff AI & Cloud Solution Architect to lead the design and development of scalable AI platforms and intelligent solutions on AWS. This role requires deep expertise across AI/ML engineering, cloud architecture, MLOps, and Generative AI, along with strong experience in building enterprise-grade, secure, and compliant SaaS platforms.

You will be responsible for architecting end-to-end AI systems, enabling machine learning and deep learning engineering workflows, and driving innovation in GenAI and agentic AI solutions. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, data architecture, and applied AI, with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, and governance.

GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

AI Platform & Solution Architecture

  • Design and build scalable, multi-tenant AI platforms on AWS supporting diverse ML and GenAI use cases.
  • Define reference architectures, reusable components, and best practices for AI/ML systems.
  • Architect end-to-end AI pipelines spanning data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Ensure platform readiness for SaaS environments, including tenant isolation, scalability, and cost optimization.

Machine Learning & Deep Learning Engineering

  • Lead development of machine learning and deep learning models for production-grade applications.
  • Establish standards for ML engineering, including data preprocessing, feature stores, training pipelines, and inference services.
  • Optimize model performance, scalability, and latency for real-time and batch inference systems.

Generative AI & Agentic AI Systems

  • Design and implement Generative AI solutions using AWS Bedrock and foundation models.
  • Build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines with vector databases and embeddings.
  • Develop agentic AI systems, including autonomous agents, orchestration frameworks, and tool integration.
  • Apply advanced techniques such as prompt engineering, fine-tuning, evaluation frameworks, and guardrails.

AWS Cloud Architecture

  • Architect and implement solutions using:
  • AWS SageMaker (training, pipelines, deployment)
  • AWS Bedrock (GenAI services)
  • Compute: Lambda, ECS, EKS
  • Orchestration: Step Functions
  • Storage/Data: S3, Redshift, DynamoDB, Glue
  • Build highly available, fault-tolerant, and cost-optimized cloud-native systems.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation.

MLOps & Model Lifecycle Management

  • Establish and scale MLOps frameworks for continuous integration and deployment of ML models.
  • Implement MLflow for experiment tracking, model registry, and lifecycle management.
  • Build automated CI/CD pipelines for ML workflows.
  • Enable model monitoring, drift detection, retraining pipelines, and explainability.

Data Architecture & Engineering

  • Design scalable data architectures to support AI/ML workloads (batch and streaming).
  • Implement data pipelines, feature stores, and data governance frameworks.
  • Ensure data quality, lineage, and accessibility across teams.

Security, Compliance & Governance

  • Architect AI systems with security-first principles, including encryption, IAM, and network controls.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise and regulatory standards (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR, SOC2 as applicable).
  • Implement responsible AI practices, including bias detection, auditability, and explainability.
  • Establish governance for data, models, and AI services.

SaaS Platform Engineering

  • Design and implement AI-powered SaaS platforms, supporting:
    • Multi-tenancy and tenant isolation
    • API-driven architectures
    • Usage metering and cost attribution
  • Enable platform extensibility and integration with enterprise systems.
Leadership & Collaboration

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship across AI, ML, and cloud engineering teams.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable solutions.
  • Lead architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical decision-making.
  • Drive innovation and adoption of emerging AI paradigms.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field (PhD preferred) with a minimum of 12+ years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML, and cloud architecture.
  • Good expertise in Machine Learning Engineering and Deep Learning Engineering.
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock, core cloud services)
  • MLflow and MLOps frameworks
  • Good programming skills in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, etc.).
  • Proven experience designing and deploying scalable AI systems in production.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CDK, CloudFormation).
  • Good understanding of data architecture and distributed systems.
  • Experience implementing secure and compliant cloud solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic AI frameworks and multi-agent systems.
  • Familiarity with LLM orchestration tools (LangChain, LlamaIndex).
  • Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, OpenSearch, FAISS).
  • Knowledge of streaming and big data technologies (Kafka, Spark).
  • AWS certifications:
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional.
  • AWS Machine Learning Specialty
  • Experience in enterprise SaaS platforms or regulated industries.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Expertise in scalable AI system design
  • Good foundation in ML, DL, and GenAI
  • Deep knowledge of MLOps and cloud-native architectures
  • Excellent problem-solving and system design skills
  • Good communication and stakeholder management
  • Ability to balance innovation with enterprise constraints (security, compliance, cost)

Impact of the Role

This role will be instrumental in shaping the organization's AI platform strategy and execution, enabling rapid development and deployment of next-generation AI solutions, including Generative AI and agentic systems, while ensuring scalability, security, and compliance at enterprise scale.

Inclusion and Diversity

GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

This role offers the opportunity to support global healthcare and life sciences projects through scientific writing, publication coordination, and operational excellence.

You will manage end-to-end publication workflows, ensuring high-quality deliverables across journals, congresses, and scientific communication activities.

The position combines medical writing expertise, project coordination, stakeholder management, and knowledge of regulatory standards.

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, authors, and external partners to support the successful delivery of critical medical information.

This is an ideal opportunity for a detail-oriented professional who enjoys organizing complex processes and advancing healthcare communications.

You will contribute to impactful projects that support the development and communication of therapies worldwide.

Accountabilities

You will coordinate workflows, maintain documentation, and support teams throughout the publication lifecycle.

The ideal candidate combines medical writing expertise, strong organizational skills, and experience managing scientific publication workflows. You should be comfortable coordinating multiple stakeholders, handling complex documentation, and working within regulated healthcare environments.

  • Experience in medical writing, scientific communications, publication management, or related life sciences fields.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end publication processes, including journal submissions, congress activities, and author review cycles.
  • Experience managing workflows using publication planning platforms such as PubConnect, Datavision, or similar tools is preferred.

  • Experience conducting clinical literature searches and managing scientific documentation.

About Brillio:

Brillio is one of the fastest growing digital technology service providers and a partner of choice for many Fortune 1000 companies seeking to turn disruption into a competitive advantage through innovative digital adoption. Brillio, renowned for its world-class professionals, referred to as Brillians, distinguishes itself through their capacity to seamlessly integrate cutting-edge digital and design thinking skills with an unwavering dedication to client satisfaction.

Brillio takes pride in its status as an employer of choice, consistently attracting the most exceptional and talented individuals due to its unwavering emphasis on contemporary, groundbreaking technologies, and exclusive digital projects. Brillio's relentless commitment to providing an exceptional experience to its Brillians and nurturing their full potential consistently garners them the Great Place to Work® certification year after year.

Brillio is an AI-first technology company, backed by private equity, Bain Capital and Orogen Group, partnering with enterprise organizations to drive AI-led transformation at scale. We focus on industries where technology directly impacts growth financial services, healthcare, consumer, telecom and technology.

To make that happen, we work closely with executive teams and operate alongside our clients to deploy AI into core business systems moving from strategy to execution.

Our Team

We bring together three distinct layers of capability:

AI-Native Engineers: Engineers, Architects and Product leaders who are native to AI systems designing, building, and scaling production-grade solutions.

Leadership: Leaders who have delivered large-scale, global transformation programs — combining business insight with execution discipline

Board & Advisors: Providing strategic oversight, governance, and perspective across complex enterprise environments

What You'll Do

Problem Discovery & Solution Design

  • Engage directly with business stakeholders, VPs, clinical leads, operations owners to surface ambiguous, high-value problems and translate them into buildable AI opportunities
  • Ask sharp questions, challenge assumptions, and define what a minimum viable AI solution looks like before writing a line of code
  • Map existing processes end-to-end, identify where AI can eliminate friction, reduce cost, or accelerate decisions and communicate your findings in business terms
  • Build lightweight scoping documents and ROI estimates that align stakeholders and set clear success criteria before development begins

Rapid Prototyping & Full-Stack AI Development

  • Design and build working AI prototypes within days using Claude and the modern AI development stack
  • Develop full-stack AI applications spanning LLM orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, REST API integrations, and lightweight front-end interfaces
  • Own your technical architecture end-to-end from prompt design to data pipeline to user interface and be able to explain every design decision to both engineering and business audiences
  • Iterate based on real user feedback in the field ship early, learn fast, and drive toward production-grade quality with intention and speed
  • Use Claude as a core development accelerator for code generation, testing, documentation, and solution design not just as a product capability

Scaling Solutions with AI Governance

  • Partner with Brillio's AI Governance team to validate, harden, and evolve prototypes into production-grade, enterprise-ready systems.
  • Apply responsible AI principles bias review, explainability, HIPAA compliance, audit logging, and model monitoring as a standard part of every build.
  • Document solutions clearly and completely so they can be handed off, scaled, and maintained by broader engineering teams without rework.
  • Contribute to Brillio's reusable AI accelerator library turning client-specific solutions into patterns that can be deployed across engagements.

Business Rhythm & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Participate in all client business rhythm meetings sprint reviews, program steering committees, and executive status updates
  • Demonstrate progress through live demos and working software not slide decks alone
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical business leaders and build the trust required to move from pilot to scale
  • Surface blockers, dependencies, and risks early with clear, solutions-oriented framing

Client Immersion & Domain Depth

  • Develop genuine expertise in your client's business, their workflows, their data, their competitive pressures, and their regulatory environment
  • Understand healthcare operations deeply enough to generate your own problem hypotheses not just respond to inbound requests
  • Build relationships with business counterparts that go beyond project delivery, becoming a trusted advisor on what AI can and cannot do in their environment
  • Contribute to internal knowledge sharing bring learnings from client engagements back to Brillio's broader applied AI community

Must have

  • 8+ years of healthcare industry experience: Direct, hands-on experience in health insurance operations (underwriting, claims adjudication, utilization management, product launch) or health system clinical and operational workflows not adjacent or observational. You must understand how these environments actually work.
  • Proficiency with Claude (Anthropic) as a development tool. Demonstrated use of the Claude API including prompt engineering, tool use, and agentic patterns to build real applications. Using Claude as a chat interface does not qualify. You must have built with it.
  • Full-stack AI engineering capability: Ability to build and ship end-to-end AI applications independently. LLM integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic orchestration, REST API development, and lightweight front-end interfaces sufficient to put a working demo in front of a client.
  • Demonstrated ability to prototype at speed: Proven track record of moving from a business conversation to a working AI prototype in days not sprints or quarters. You can show examples of what you built, how fast, and what problem it solved.
  • Business articulation and stakeholder communication: Ability to walk into a meeting with healthcare executives and explain what you built, why it matters, what it costs, and what comes next clearly, confidently, and without jargon. This is a non-negotiable for a client-embedded role.
  • Maturity to engage at the executive level: Comfortable participating in steering committees, executive briefings, and business rhythm meetings without needing hand-holding. You can hold the room, handle pushback, and demonstrate progress in terms business leaders care about.
  • Ability to structure ambiguous problems: When a business leader says we need to reduce risk in our underwriting process, you know how to break that into a scoped AI opportunity with clear inputs, outputs, and success criteria before opening a laptop.
  • Quantitative fluency for ROI and impact measurement: Ability to build simple but credible business cases estimating time saved, cost reduced, or revenue protected and translate AI outputs into financial terms that resonate with finance and operations leaders.

Strong Preference

  • Experience with agentic AI frameworks: Hands-on use of LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent orchestration frameworks to build multi-step, tool-calling AI agents that operate in real workflows.
  • Healthcare data standards and regulatory context : Working familiarity with HL7, FHIR, ICD-10, CPT, and claims data structures. Understanding HIPAA requirements, CMS regulations, and FDA digital health guidance as they apply to AI system design and deployment.
  • Prior forward-deployed, embedded, or startup engineering experience: You have worked directly inside a client organization, operated in a consulting or embedded delivery model, or built products in a startup environment where you owned the full stack with limited support.
  • Experience shipping AI in health insurance technology company or health system: You have navigated the additional complexity of deploying AI where compliance, audit trails, explainability, and data governance are not optional and you know how to move fast without cutting corners that matter.
  • Experience contributing to reusable AI platforms or accelerators: You have built solutions with an eye toward reuse creating components, patterns, or frameworks that others on a team can adopt rather than rebuilding from scratch on every engagement.
  • Knowledge of AI governance and responsible AI practices in enterprise settings: Familiarity with model risk management, bias evaluation, audit logging, and enterprise AI governance frameworks and experience working alongside governance or compliance teams to get AI systems approved for production use.

Who you are

  • A builder first : you are most energized when something tangible exists that didn't exist before
  • Equally fluent in the language of healthcare operations and the language of AI engineering and able to switch between them in the same meeting
  • Someone who earns trust through working software, not promises you show progress, you don't just report it
  • Deeply curious about what AI can do in healthcare and intellectually honest about where it falls short
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, urgency, and high stakes you thrive when the path is unclear and the expectation is still high

Know what it's like to work and grow at Brillio: Click here

jobs.title: QC Lab Chemist
jobs.description:
Company Description Amster Microcell, established in 2018, specializes in manufacturing and exporting high-quality microcrystalline cellulose powder and other pharmaceutical excipients. The organization is supported by a team of highly qualified and experienced professionals in pharmaceutical excipients. With strong expertise and advanced technologies in its facilities, Amster Microcell is recognized for reliable production and export of excipients and their derivatives. The company is committed to delivering superior quality products at reasonable rates while maintaining long-term relationships with customers.
Role Description The QC Lab Chemist is a full-time, on-site role based in Kadi. This position is responsible for performing routine and non-routine quality control testing of microcrystalline cellulose and other excipients, following established SOPs and regulatory guidelines. The QC Lab Chemist will prepare samples, operate and maintain laboratory equipment, document test results, and support investigations for out-of-specification findings. Daily activities include calibrating instruments, maintaining laboratory records, assisting with method validation, and collaborating with production teams to ensure product quality and compliance. The role also involves contributing to continuous improvement initiatives within the QC laboratory and supporting internal and external audits as needed.
Qualifications
  • Candidates should possess strong Quality Control skills, including knowledge of QC procedures, specifications, and documentation practices.
  • Candidates should possess core Laboratory Skills, such as sample preparation, handling of chemicals, and adherence to safety protocols.
  • Candidates should possess robust Analytical Skills, including interpreting test data, troubleshooting results, and understanding pharmacopeial methods.
  • Candidates should possess proficiency with Laboratory Equipment, including routine operation, maintenance, and basic troubleshooting of analytical instruments.
  • Candidates should possess experience in Calibration of laboratory instruments to ensure accurate and reliable test results.
  • Relevant degree in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related field.
  • Prior experience in a pharmaceutical QC laboratory or excipient manufacturing environment is preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail, documentation accuracy, and ability to follow GMP and regulatory guidelines.
  • Effective communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

Contract Principal Medical Writer

This is a senior individual contributor role with responsibility for leading complex medical writing projects across clinical development, including protocols, clinical study reports, submission-level documents and scientific publications.

  • Take ownership of submission-level documents
  • Act as Medical Writing Lead on large, multi-document projects
  • Review clinical study outlines, protocols, SAPs, tables, figures, listings and CSRs

  • Produce abstracts, posters, manuscripts and scientific presentations
  • Manage multiple assignments in parallel, ensuring delivery against quality, timelines and budget
  • Work closely with sponsors, internal project teams and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Mentor and guide Medical Writers
  • Support audits, bid defences, SOP development and process improvement initiatives

Experience required

  • Degree in Life Sciences or a related discipline
  • Advanced degree such as an MSc or PhD preferred
  • Typically 6+ years of medical writing experience
  • At least 3 years experience leading medical writing projects
  • Strong experience with protocols, CSRs and submission-level documents
  • Excellent knowledge of ICH guidelines and regulatory requirements
  • Strong understanding of medical and scientific terminology, data analysis and interpretation
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Strong stakeholder management, organisation and time-management skills
  • Previous CRO experience is highly desirable

This position would suit an experienced Medical Writer who can operate independently, lead complex deliverables and provide technical leadership across major client programmes.

jobs.title: Manager, Product Lifecycle Management (LCM) Execution
jobs.description:
Manager, Product Lifecycle Management Execution

About Amgen

Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world's toughest diseases, and make people's lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what's known today.

About The Role

Role Description: Let's do this. Let's change the world.

We are seeking an experienced people leader who thrives in a dynamic, cross-functional environment and is passionate about building high-performing teams that deliver operational excellence across the product lifecycle.

In this vital role, you will lead the Lifecycle Management Execution Team, managing a team of approximately 7–8 Senior Associates responsible for the planning, coordination and execution of post-approval Lifecycle Management activities and Change Control implementation across Amgen's commercial portfolio.

You will ensure the team delivers timely, compliant and high-quality execution of CMC variations, labeling updates, SKU rationalizations, product discontinuations and other lifecycle initiatives supporting both Regional Supply Chain Operations and Manufacturing Site Operations.

Working closely with the Senior Manager, Product Lifecycle Management Capability Lead, Product Lifecycle Teams (PLTs), Regional Operations, Manufacturing Sites, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Artwork & Labeling and Commercial organizations, you will establish execution priorities, develop organizational capability and continuously improve project delivery performance across the Lifecycle Management portfolio.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Enterprise AI Scaling and Innovation
jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it's work worth doing. If you're driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Position Overview

For more than 140 years, Eli Lilly and Company has been committed to discovering and developing medicines that improve lives. Facing an accelerating pace of digital and AI transformation across healthcare, Lilly established Lilly Bengaluru India (LBI) as a strategic investment in future-ready capabilities: a globally connected, agile and innovation-driven organization, deeply attuned to the evolving needs of patients and healthcare systems. Within it, the Commercialization Capabilities organization enables Lilly's commercial teams worldwide across the end-to-end commercialization lifecycle, spanning five core focus areas: Business Intelligence & Analytics (BI&A), Global Operations Sales Organization (GOSO), Global Content Hub (GCH), Experience Activation (EXPA), and Commercial Learning Services (CLS).

Lilly's enterprise AI agenda is delivered through NOVA (Next-generation Organizational Value through AI), the program through which AI initiatives are submitted, shaped, governed and scaled across GCCI, Medical Capabilities, GOSO and IBU Central.

To further elevate LBI's strategic impact, we are seeking an accomplished AI leader to serve as Senior Director of Enterprise AI Scaling and Innovation. The role leads NOVA's global rollout and operational execution across these four organizations, working directly with their senior leaders to shape AI submissions into work that can credibly reach enterprise scale. Beyond NOVA, it drives Lilly's most critical cross-functional AI initiatives — including frontier programs such as SAGE, focused on agentification within brand launches — and maintains the enterprise's line of sight into a fast-moving external technology landscape.

This is a deep-domain senior technical leadership role. The incumbent brings independent judgment on AI architecture, feasibility and cost-to-scale, and is the person the enterprise relies on to distinguish an AI initiative that will scale from one that will not. Success depends on technical credibility and the willingness to redirect or stop well-sponsored work that cannot reach production.

This position reports to the Vice President and Global Head of LBI Commercialization Capabilities and operates with an enterprise mandate across the organizations NOVA serves.

Primary Responsibilities

NOVA Rollout & Operational Execution (50%)

  • Own NOVA's rollout and operational execution across the four organizations, establishing it as the route through which enterprise AI work is shaped, prioritized, built and scaled.
  • Partner with senior leaders to shape AI submissions against the enterprise bar for scalability — value hypothesis, data readiness, architecture, cost-to-scale and path to production — reshaping what's unready and redirecting, consolidating or stopping what cannot clear it, so work reaches governed production rather than stalling as a proof of concept.
  • Maintain the governance that makes speed safe (risk tiering, decision gates, responsible-AI standards, model and agent oversight), and raise the AI fluency of the leaders you advise so they sponsor AI work with realistic expectations of cost, risk and value.
  • Own the value framework and KPIs that hold the NOVA portfolio accountable to realized impact, and help lead the organizational change, culture and talent development.

Drive Next-Generation Frontier & Cross-Functional Programs (40%)


  • Lead the cross-functional AI initiatives that span organizational boundaries, have no natural single owner, and will not succeed without senior technical leadership.
  • Drive frontier programs from concept to a defensible path to deployment: define the technical thesis, pressure-test feasibility, sequence milestones and secure cross-functional investment.
  • Advance Lilly's agentic mission — multi-agent architectures, orchestration, tool use, evaluation and human-in-the-loop design — and resolve the architectural, data and operating-model dependencies that block scale, working across Tech@Lilly, legal, compliance and privacy.

Assess the External Environment and Accelerate External Innovation (10%)


  • Maintain a rigorous, current read of the external AI landscape — models, agents, tooling and applied practice within and beyond life sciences — and route it back through NOVA in actionable form that shapes live submissions, architecture choices and investment sequencing.
  • Maintain an active map of companies, including startups, that can accelerate Lilly's agentic mission, and partner with Procurement, Legal, Privacy and Information Security on a fast-track evaluation pathway — pre-negotiated terms, right-sized risk assessment, time-boxed evaluation — so promising partners aren't lost to a multi-month onboarding cycle.

Minimum Qualification Requirements


  • A postgraduate qualification (MBA, MSc, M.Pharm or equivalent), or an equivalent depth of professional experience.
  • 15+ years of progressive leadership across enterprise strategy, transformation and technology, in pharmaceutical, healthcare or life sciences, or other complex regulated global enterprises, including substantial experience leading AI initiatives.
  • A track record of taking AI from concept to production at enterprise scale across multiple business functions — including the architectural, data and responsible-AI decisions required to deploy safely — with measured business impact, not strategy alone.
  • Proven success as the senior technical voice on large, cross-functional initiatives within Global Capability Centers and/or Fortune-100 enterprises — including the standing to challenge and redirect executive-sponsored work, and a track record of influencing decisions across a matrixed, global organization.
  • Deep, current expertise across the AI and generative-AI lifecycle — large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic and multi-agent systems, evaluation methodology and the data foundations they depend on — sufficient to independently assess feasibility, interrogate architecture and cost-to-scale, and hold your own with engineering and research leaders. This is not a hands-on engineering role, but it demands genuine technical depth; program and process-management capability alone will not suffice.
  • Sound judgment on enterprise AI governance, operational risk and performance measurement, and on where to trade speed against trust and compliance.
  • Exceptional executive presence and communication: the ability to influence executives, align diverse teams, explain complex technical and risk factors in clear business terms, lead through ambiguity, and develop others.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate emerging technology vendors and startups on technical merit and build co-innovation partnerships that convert into enterprise adoption, working with procurement, legal and security functions to compress evaluation and onboarding cycles without weakening enterprise risk standards.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Fluency with recognized responsible-AI and governance frameworks (for example, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, and the EU AI Act).
  • Experience elevating Global Capability Centers from delivery into innovation and value creation.
  • Familiarity with Lilly's commercial model or other regulated, global operating environments.
  • A background in digital product, platform or automation delivery.
  • Recognized project or process-excellence credentials (PMP, Lean or Six Sigma) are a plus.

jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it's work worth doing. If you're driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

About Lilly

At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you're driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.

About Lilly Research Labs, Bengaluru

At Lilly in Bengaluru, the research function works directly alongside Lilly's global teams to advance the science behind tomorrow's medicines. Whether through product research and development, computational modelling, data-driven experimentation, or the intelligence that shapes Lilly's external innovation strategy, the work here contributes to the pipeline that will determine which life-changing medicines reach patients across the globe.

Purpose of the Job

The External Innovation function which is comprised of the C360, Search and Evaluate and Corporate Business Development teams collectively manage Lilly's ecosystem of partnerships, investments, and acquisitions that accelerate our access to innovative therapies and technologies. The newly established Salesforce CRM platform serves as the source of truth for historical and current partnering conversations and thereby enables line of site across Search & Evaluate, Corporate Business Development, and venture teams.

The System Custodian will work with the System Owner as well as strategic stakeholders to enable the practical functionality and utility of the system to meet the primary needs of the system users. The system owner and custodian will have the primary accountability for platform governance, cross-team coordination, and alignment with broader External Innovation program objectives. Operating at the intersection of business needs and technical operations, the System Custodian ensures that platform capabilities evolve to serve the changing priorities of External Innovation stakeholders while maintaining system health, data integrity, and operational continuity.

The System Custodian works closely with the System Owner (Salesforce SME and technical authority) to translate business requirements into platform direction, drive strategic platform roadmap prioritization, maintain operational oversite and governance as well as coordinate across S&E, CBD, C360 and venture teams to maximize platform value.

Responsibilities

  • Platform Governance & Roadmap Authority: Define and maintain governance frameworks, decision-making protocols, and prioritization criteria for platform enhancements, configuration changes, and technical debt; partner with the System Owner to evaluate and approve releases and major system changes in alignment with External Innovation strategy.
  • Cross-Functional Stakeholder Coordination: Coordinate platform priorities and release schedules across Catalyze360, Search & Evaluate, and Corporate Business Development teams; resolve competing stakeholder needs and ensure platform direction reflects the broader External Innovation portfolio.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Communication: Maintain structured engagement with External Innovation teams and subject matter experts to surface evolving business needs, communicate platform capabilities and constraints, and translate feedback into actionable platform guidance.
  • Platform Operations & Data Integrity: Collaborate with Salesforce administration to define and prioritize configuration changes, reporting enhancements, and system optimizations; establish and enforce data quality standards, metadata governance, and information architecture protocols to ensure reliability for downstream analysis and decision-making.
  • Platform Health, Adoption & Continuous Improvement: Monitor adoption trends, platform health metrics, and user satisfaction; identify and escalate risks to uptime, data quality, or regulatory compliance; track business outcomes and drive continuous improvement based on stakeholder feedback and lessons learned.
  • Knowledge Transfer & Internal Capability Building: Lead structured knowledge transfer initiatives to document platform architecture, governance decisions, and operational runbooks; build internal Lilly ownership and reduce dependency on external vendors and professional services over time.
  • Business Value Realization: Define and track key performance indicators for platform adoption, user experience, and business impact; identify opportunities to increase platform value and communicate progress against strategic objectives to leadership stakeholders.

Basic Qualifications/Requirements


  • Bachelor's degree in Life Science, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field; Master's degree preferred.
  • 7+ years of experience in platform operations, systems governance, or technology-enabled business operations, with at least 3 years managing a Salesforce instance in a post-implementation or operational phase.
  • Demonstrated experience translating business requirements from cross-functional stakeholders across multiple business units into documented Salesforce configuration specifications, workflows, or governance policies.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent platform projects to defined timelines and success metrics in a matrixed, international organization.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing documentation and presenting platform guidance to both technical teams and non-technical leadership audiences.

Additional Skills/Preferences


  • Salesforce Administrator certification or equivalent hands-on configuration experience, including familiarity with data governance frameworks, metadata management, and platform roadmap prioritization.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences R&D operations, with exposure to external innovation strategies or business development partnerships.
  • Background managing vendor relationships and professional services engagements, including scope definition, delivery accountability, and agile or iterative implementation methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead without direct authority — building credibility across organizational levels, influencing peer groups, and driving alignment in ambiguous or fast-changing environments.
  • Self-directed and adaptable, with a track record of translating unclear requirements into actionable direction through structured stakeholder engagement and a continuous improvement mindset.

Additional Information


Note: When applying internally for a position your current supervisor receives notification that you have applied to the position. We encourage employees to discuss the opportunity with their supervisor prior to applying.

We believe the people who dedicate themselves to making medicines better deserve an environment that makes their lives better too, one where they are supported, respected, and given the space to do their best work. jobs.title: Nursing Intensivist
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities:

Patient Care & Monitoring:

  • Provide direct, round-the-clock nursing care to critically ill patients in the ICU.
  • Monitor vital signs and clinical parameters, interpret data, and identify early signs of deterioration.
  • Administer medications, intravenous infusions, and titrate vasoactive drugs as per ICU protocols.
  • Manage mechanical ventilation, tracheostomy care, suctioning, and oxygen therapy.
  • Perform critical procedures such as CVP monitoring, arterial line care, NG/OG tube insertion, and central line care.
  • Ensure strict aseptic techniques and infection control protocols are maintained at all times.

Emergency Response:

  • Respond promptly to Code Blue and other medical emergencies within the unit.
  • Assist physicians during emergency procedures like intubation, resuscitation, and invasive monitoring.
  • Provide advanced life support (ALS/BLS certified care) as needed.

Documentation & Coordination:

  • Maintain accurate and timely patient records, including assessments, nursing interventions, medication administration, and progress notes.
  • Coordinate with physicians, respiratory therapists, and other ICU staff to ensure integrated patient care.
  • Communicate effectively with patients families, providing updates and emotional support.

Training & Development:

  • Participate in orientation and training of new ICU nurses and junior staff.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest critical care practices, equipment, and guidelines.
  • Attend and contribute to ICU rounds, audits, and nursing conferences.

Quality & Safety:

  • Ensure compliance with hospital policies, ICU protocols, and accreditation standards (e.g., NABH, JCI).
  • Participate in infection control audits, medication error reporting, and nursing quality improvement initiatives.
  • Monitor and maintain ICU equipment; promptly report malfunctions or safety concerns.

Qualifications and Experience:

  • Educational Qualification:
  • B.Sc Nursing / GNM with ICU training (Post Basic B.Sc Nursing preferred)
  • Critical Care Nursing Certification / Diploma (preferred)
  • Experience:
  • Minimum 3 years of ICU experience in a multispecialty or tertiary care hospital.
  • Hands-on experience with ventilators, infusion pumps, and critical care protocols.
  • Licensure:
  • Registered Nurse with valid Nursing Council Registration (State/National)

Key Skills:

  • Strong clinical judgment and decision-making in emergency and high-stress environments
  • In-depth knowledge of ICU equipment and procedures
  • Effective communication and teamwork
  • Compassionate, patient-focused attitude
  • Ability to work in rotating shifts and extended hours when necessary

Desirable Attributes:

  • ACLS / BLS certification (mandatory or preferred based on hospital policy)
  • Experience in specialized ICUs (e.g., Neuro ICU, Cardiac ICU, Pediatric ICU)
  • Participation in ICU accreditation, audits, and quality improvement programs
  • Teaching or mentorship experience in clinical nursing settings

jobs.description:
Job description

  • They are responsible for administering medication starting and maintaining intravenous fluids and checking to make sure doses are correct for each patients medical needs.

jobs.title: Head and Neck Onco Surgeon
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities:

1. Surgical and Clinical Care:

  • Perform complex head and neck surgeries for malignancies, including:
  • Laryngectomies, thyroidectomies, and neck dissections
  • Oral cavity cancer surgeries, mandibulectomies, and reconstructive procedures
  • Parotid gland and salivary gland surgeries
  • Endoscopic and minimally invasive procedures for early-stage cancers
  • Skull base surgeries for advanced cases, if applicable
  • Manage pre-operative evaluations, post-operative care, and complications for head and neck cancer patients.
  • Provide adjuvant therapy management in collaboration with medical and radiation oncologists.
  • Perform reconstructive surgeries, including free flap and microvascular techniques, for functional and cosmetic restoration.

2. Multidisciplinary Team Collaboration:

  • Participate in multidisciplinary tumor board meetings, discussing complex cases and formulating treatment plans.
  • Work closely with oncologists, radiation therapists, speech therapists, and nutritionists to provide holistic care.
  • Guide junior surgeons, medical residents, and other team members in clinical practice, ensuring high standards of care.

3. Patient Counseling and Education:

  • Provide clear, compassionate, and empathetic counseling to patients and their families regarding diagnosis, treatment options, surgery, and post-operative care.
  • Educate patients about rehabilitation options post-surgery, including speech therapy, swallowing therapy, and psychological support.

4. Research and Academic Contributions:

  • Participate in or lead clinical research projects and contribute to academic publications.
  • Engage in clinical audits, review surgical outcomes, and implement strategies for continuous improvement.
  • Conduct teaching and training programs for medical residents, fellows, and other clinical staff.
  • Present at conferences, workshops, and professional meetings to stay updated with the latest in head and neck oncology.

5. Quality and Safety Management:

  • Ensure strict adherence to surgical protocols, infection control practices, and patient safety standards.
  • Collaborate with the hospital management to enhance the head and neck oncology services, ensuring compliance with national and international standards.
  • Participate in institutional committees and contribute to the development of clinical guidelines, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and patient care protocols.

Qualifications and Experience:

  • Educational Qualification:
  • MBBS + MS (General Surgery) or equivalent
  • MCh / DNB (Head and Neck Surgical Oncology) or equivalent
  • Fellowship or additional training in head and neck oncology is preferred.
  • Experience:
  • 8–12+ years of experience in surgical oncology with a specialized focus on head and neck cancers.
  • Proven experience in performing a wide range of head and neck oncological surgeries, including advanced procedures and reconstructive surgeries.
  • Experience with minimally invasive and robotic techniques is a plus.
  • Licensure:
  • Valid medical license with registration from State/National Medical Council.

Key Skills and Competencies:

  • Expert-level proficiency in head and neck oncological surgery, including advanced reconstructive techniques.
  • Strong clinical decision-making skills and the ability to manage complex cases independently.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.
  • Strong patient counseling and empathetic skills, particularly with cancer patients and their families.
  • Commitment to academic and research excellence in the field of head and neck oncology.
  • Knowledge of hospital and healthcare compliance standards, including infection control, ethical guidelines, and patient safety.

jobs.title: Infection Control Nurse
jobs.description:
Job Title: Infection Control Nurse

Overview: The Infection Control Nurse plays a crucial role in the healthcare sector, ensuring the safety and well-being of patients, staff, and visitors through the prevention and control of infections. This position is vital in promoting best practices in infection prevention, collaborating with various departments to implement effective policies and procedures, and providing education and training to healthcare personnel. The Infection Control Nurse conducts surveillance, identifies outbreaks, analyzes data, and develops strategies to reduce infection rates within the healthcare facility. This multifaceted role requires a deep understanding of microbiology, epidemiology, and clinical practices. Additionally, the Infection Control Nurse acts as an advocate for infection prevention initiatives, collaborating with public health organizations and participating in quality assurance programs. By maintaining high standards of infection control, this nurse contributes to improved patient outcomes and the overall operational efficiency of the healthcare organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct regular surveillance of healthcare-associated infections.
  • Develop, implement, and evaluate infection prevention policies and protocols.
  • Provide training and education to staff on best infection control practices.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to assess and manage infection control risks.
  • Perform infection control audits and report findings to management.
  • Investigate and analyze infection outbreaks and implement control measures.
  • Develop educational materials for patients and families regarding infection prevention.
  • Stay current with local, state, and federal infection control regulations.
  • Prepare and present infection control reports to key stakeholders.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives related to infection prevention.
  • Maintain accurate records of infection control activities and outcomes.
  • Provide consultation to healthcare providers regarding infection control issues.
  • Assist in the development of emergency preparedness plans related to infection control.
  • Utilize data analytics to track infection trends and improve practices.
  • Act as a resource for infection control questions and concerns within the organization.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in nursing (BSN) is required; Master's degree preferred.
  • Current nursing license in the state of practice.
  • Certification in Infection Control (CIC) is highly preferred.
  • At least 2 years of nursing experience, preferably in a clinical setting.
  • Strong knowledge of infection prevention and control guidelines.
  • Experience in data collection and analysis related to infection control.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to evaluate and adapt infection control practices based on current research.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and infection control databases.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Experience in conducting staff education and training.
  • Capability to handle multiple priorities and work under pressure.
  • Knowledge of public health regulations related to infection control.
  • Commitment to ongoing professional development in infection prevention.

Skills: communication skills,communication,infection control databases,team collaboration,microsoft office suite,critical thinking,infection control,microbiology,data analysis,epidemiology,organizational skills,collaboration,clinical assessment,policy development,patient education

jobs.title: Intensivist
jobs.description:
We are looking for a skilled and dedicated Intensivist with a background in Anesthesiology to manage critically ill patients in the Intensive Care Unit (ICU). The candidate will be responsible for the round-the-clock monitoring, stabilization, and advanced life support of patients requiring intensive care.

  • Manage medical emergencies and critically ill patients in the ICU and emergency settings.
  • Monitor and interpret patient vitals, ventilatory parameters, and laboratory data.
  • Administer sedation, analgesia, and anesthesia as appropriate for ICU procedures.

  • Experience in managing high surgical volumes or in a high-end ophthalmic setup
  • Exposure to EMR systems and digital diagnostics
  • Participation in academic research or community ophthalmology is a plus

jobs.title: Anesthesia Specialist with Cardiac IOU
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Anesthesia Specialist with expertise in Cardiac Anesthesia and post-operative critical care in Cardiac Intensive Observation Units (IOU). The role involves administering anesthesia for cardiac surgeries and managing critically ill post-op patients in cardiac care units.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Administer general and regional anesthesia for cardiac and thoracic surgical procedures (e.g., CABG, valve replacement, aortic dissection, etc.)
  • Perform pre-anesthetic evaluations, risk assessments, and patient optimization
  • Monitor and manage intraoperative hemodynamics, ventilation, and anesthesia depth
  • Post-operative care and ICU/IOU monitoring, including ventilator management, pain relief, and sedation
  • Collaborate with cardiologists, cardiothoracic surgeons, intensivists, and nursing teams
  • Handle emergency cardiac cases requiring anesthesia or sedation
  • Interpret and manage arterial lines, CVP, ABG, and other ICU parameters
  • Ensure accurate documentation of anesthesia procedures and post-op recovery notes
  • Participate in training, clinical audits, and departmental meetings

Key Requirements:

  • MBBS with MD/DNB in Anesthesiology
  • Registered with the Medical Council of India or State Medical Council
  • Minimum 1–2 years of hands-on experience in cardiac anesthesia and/or cardiac ICU
  • Proficient in intubation, invasive line insertion, TEE, and intraoperative monitoring
  • Strong understanding of cardiac pharmacology and post-op ICU protocols
  • Excellent decision-making and crisis management skills

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Fellowship in Cardiac Anesthesia or Critical Care (optional but advantageous)
  • BLS/ACLS certification
  • Experience in NABH-accredited cardiac hospitals or tertiary care units
  • Exposure to ECMO, IABP, and advanced ventilator management

jobs.title: Consultant General and Laparoscopic Surgeon
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and skilled General and Laparoscopic Surgeon to join our surgical team. The role involves managing a wide range of general surgical conditions and performing both open and minimally invasive laparoscopic procedures.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Diagnose and manage general surgical conditions, both elective and emergency
  • Perform open and laparoscopic surgeries including but not limited to:
  • Hernia (inguinal, umbilical, incisional)
  • Cholecystectomy
  • Appendectomy
  • GI surgeries
  • Participate in patient consultations, evaluations, and surgical planning
  • Collaborate with anesthesiologists, physicians, and hospital staff for perioperative care
  • Manage post-operative patient recovery and follow-up
  • Maintain accurate surgical records, informed consent, and patient communication
  • Attend surgical rounds, departmental meetings, and contribute to surgical protocols
  • Instruct junior doctors or surgical residents (if part of a teaching hospital)

Key Requirements:

  • MBBS with MS/DNB in General Surgery
  • Valid MCI or State Medical Council Registration
  • Proven experience in independent laparoscopic surgery
  • Strong clinical and surgical judgment
  • Effective patient communication and counseling skills

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Fellowship in Minimal Access Surgery (FMAS) or equivalent (preferred but not mandatory)
  • Experience with advanced laparoscopic procedures (e.g., colectomy, fundoplication)
  • Exposure to trauma/emergency surgeries
  • Experience in NABH-accredited hospitals

jobs.title: Sr Consultant Cardiologist
jobs.description:
We are looking for a seasoned and skilled Senior Cardiologist to lead cardiac care services. The ideal candidate will be responsible for the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of cardiovascular diseases, and will guide the cardiology team in clinical excellence and patient care.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Diagnose and manage cardiac conditions such as CAD, arrhythmias, cardiomyopathy, valvular diseases, and heart failure
  • Perform non-invasive and interventional procedures:
  • Echocardiography (TTE, TEE)
  • ECG, Holter Monitoring, TMT
  • Cardiac catheterization and angiography
  • Angioplasty, stenting, and pacemaker implantation (if Interventional)
  • Lead critical cardiac emergency cases including MI, cardiac arrest, and arrhythmias
  • Supervise junior cardiologists, residents, and clinical staff
  • Participate in cardiac surgeries and post-operative management as needed
  • Contribute to department planning, CME, research, and protocol development
  • Build patient trust through effective communication and counseling

Main Skills Required:

Clinical & Technical Expertise

  • Strong understanding of cardiovascular pathophysiology
  • Proficiency in diagnostic and interventional cardiology procedures
  • Advanced skills in echocardiography, angioplasty, and cardiac ICU management
  • Sound knowledge of medications, anticoagulation, lipid and BP management

jobs.title: Gasteroenterology
jobs.description:
We are seeking a skilled and experienced Gastroenterologist to join our specialty team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for diagnosing and treating patients with conditions related to the gastrointestinal (GI) tract and liver, and performing both diagnostic and therapeutic endoscopic procedures.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Diagnose and manage disorders of the digestive system including:
  • Acid reflux, ulcers, IBS, IBD (Crohn's, ulcerative colitis)
  • Liver diseases (hepatitis, cirrhosis)
  • Pancreatic and biliary conditions
  • Perform procedures such as:
  • Upper GI endoscopy (OGD scopy)
  • Colonoscopy
  • ERCP
  • Sigmoidoscopy
  • Capsule endoscopy (if available)
  • Evaluate and interpret diagnostic tests and imaging reports
  • Collaborate with other departments (e.g., Surgery, Oncology, Radiology) for holistic care
  • Counsel patients on preventive GI care and lifestyle changes
  • Maintain patient records, reports, and prescriptions as per hospital protocol
  • Participate in on-call rotations, CMEs, and hospital committees as required

Key Requirements:

  • DM or DNB in Gastroenterology from a recognized institute
  • Valid MCI/State Medical Council registration
  • Proficient in diagnostic and therapeutic endoscopic procedures
  • Strong clinical acumen and decision-making abilities
  • Excellent patient interaction and communication skills

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in managing ICU/critical GI cases
  • Exposure to hepatology and liver transplant cases (preferred, not mandatory)
  • Comfortable using EMRs and reporting software
  • NABH/JCI hospital experience is an advantage

jobs.title: Emergency Medicine Consultant
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Emergency Medicine Consultant to lead our emergency department. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing emergency cases, providing immediate medical care, and overseeing the emergency medicine team. You will ensure that patients receive timely and appropriate treatment in critical situations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide emergency medical care to patients in critical conditions
  • Diagnose and treat acute medical conditions, injuries, and life-threatening situations
  • Perform life-saving procedures such as resuscitation, trauma care, and intubation
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including surgeons, intensivists, and nursing staff
  • Oversee and guide junior doctors and medical staff in the emergency department
  • Maintain patient records, ensure documentation is accurate, and comply with medical standards
  • Participate in quality control, case reviews, and continuous medical education

Requirements:

  • MD/DNB in Emergency Medicine or equivalent
  • 5+ years of experience in emergency medicine
  • Ability to handle high-pressure situations and critical care
  • Strong decision-making, diagnostic, and problem-solving skills
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work well in a fast-paced and team-oriented environment

jobs.title: Medical Oncologist Consultant
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and compassionate Medical Oncologist Consultant to provide specialized care in the diagnosis, treatment, and management of patients with cancer. The consultant will be responsible for creating personalized cancer treatment plans, including chemotherapy, immunotherapy, and targeted therapies, and working closely with surgical and radiation oncology teams in a multidisciplinary setting.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Diagnose and manage various types and stages of cancer in adult and/or pediatric patients.
  • Design and supervise chemotherapy, hormonal therapy, immunotherapy, and targeted therapy regimens.
  • Monitor patient progress, manage side effects, and adjust treatment plans as needed.
  • Collaborate with surgical and radiation oncologists, pathologists, and palliative care teams.
  • Participate in tumor boards, multidisciplinary team meetings, and clinical discussions.
  • Counsel patients and families on prognosis, treatment options, and supportive care.
  • Ensure accurate medical documentation and compliance with treatment protocols.
  • Participate in clinical research, trials, and academic activities if applicable.

Skills and Competencies:

  • Deep knowledge of medical oncology, pharmacology, and cancer biology
  • Excellent decision-making in complex oncologic cases
  • Empathetic patient communication and counseling skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a multi-disciplinary cancer care team
  • Up-to-date with latest advancements and evidence-based oncology guidelines

Preferred Certifications:

  • Fellowship in Oncology (optional but preferred)
  • Palliative Care certification (for advanced-stage care focus)
  • Participation in national/international oncology conferences or clinical trials

jobs.title: Pediatric Surgeon
jobs.description:
We are seeking compassionate, qualified, and experienced Pediatricians and PICU/NICU Doctors to provide high-quality medical care to infants, children, and adolescents. The role involves diagnosing and treating various conditions, with a special focus on intensive care for neonates and critically ill pediatric patients. You will work closely with a multidisciplinary team to ensure comprehensive, timely, and effective care.

Key Responsibilities:

General Pediatrician:

  • Conduct physical exams and assess the health of infants, children, and adolescents.
  • Diagnose and treat illnesses, infections, injuries, and developmental disorders.
  • Provide preventive care including vaccinations and health education for parents.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date medical records.
  • Collaborate with nurses and other healthcare staff to provide holistic care.

Qualifications:

  • MBBS with MD/DNB in Pediatrics
  • Valid Medical Council Registration

Experience:

  • Pediatrician: Minimum 1–3 years of experience in general pediatrics

Skills Required:

  • Strong clinical and diagnostic skills
  • Ability to work under pressure and in emergency situations
  • Empathetic communication with children and families
  • Team collaboration with nurses, therapists, and other doctors
  • Familiarity with modern pediatric equipment and electronic medical records (EMRs)

jobs.title: First line field manager (Area Sales Manager )
jobs.description:
• Supervise and lead a team of Medical Representatives (MRs) in the assigned territory.
  • Ensure achievement of monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets for the area.
  • Develop and implement area-specific sales strategies aligned with company goals.
  • Conduct fieldwork with MRs to support product promotion and ensure effective doctor coverage.
  • Monitor and ensure daily reporting, doctor call average, and secondary sales by MRs.
  • Identify and develop new business opportunities in hospitals, clinics, and pharmacies.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), doctors, and stockists.
  • Ensure timely stock availability at distributor and retail levels.
  • Conduct training, motivation, and performance evaluations of MRs to improve productivity.
  • Monitor and control territory expenses, ensuring adherence to company norms.
  • Collect and analyze market intelligence, competitor activity, and feedback.
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Marketing, Distribution, HR) for smooth operational flow.
  • Ensure team adherence to company policies, ethical guidelines, and regulatory compliance.
  • Organize and execute doctor meetings, CMEs, and promotional events in the assigned area.

Key Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong team leadership and people management skills.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving ability.
  • Proficiency in sales planning, data analysis, and reporting.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Sound knowledge of pharma selling techniques and therapeutic areas (aligned with Tablets India's portfolio).
  • Strong result orientation and customer focus.

Qualifications:

  • Graduate in Science / Pharmacy / related discipline (MBA in Marketing is a plus).
  • Minimum 2–5 years of experience as an MR, with at least 1 year in a managerial or senior MR role.
  • Prior experience in handling pharma brands similar to Tablets India (e.g., gastroenterology, nutritionals, probiotics, etc.) preferred.

jobs.title: Infection Control Nurse
jobs.description:
• Supervises the maintenance of the established protocols for infection prevention e.g. isolation procedures, hand washing techniques used, the use of hand rub, change of IV set, change of central line dressing, availability of supplies, terminal cleaning of a unit, evaluation of equipment etc. in the hospital.
  • Collection and tabulation of daily data of all incidents of hospital acquired infections.

  • Corrects and teaches staff whenever the need arises during rounds. E.g. unnecessary use of gloves, improper handling of equipment, practice of aseptic precautions etc.
  • Participates in the formal teaching programs during the orientation of new staff.
  • Carries out surveillance through regular contact with all hospital departments, particularly those providing patient care.
  • During hospital rounds, should collect & maintain Various data related to dates and details of various Patients. Various data is then analyzed and interpreted together with the microbiologist.
  • To share her concerns with microbiologist time to time to improve the hospital and implement measures to reduce the infections if any.
  • Some of the information is then disseminated immediately, so that the required precaution may be taken to prevent the spread of infection.
  • Co-ordinates between different departments and the hospital and public health Department.
  • Identifying as promptly as possible infection hazards in patients staff or equipment.

jobs.title: Anti-Money Laundering Officer
jobs.description:
Job Title: Corporate KYC Analyst

Experience: 2–10 Years

Location: Pune

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary:

We are seeking a meticulous and experienced Corporate KYC Analyst to join our compliance team. The ideal candidate will have 2–10 years of experience in KYC, EDD, AML, or financial crime compliance, particularly within the banking or financial services domain. This role demands a sharp eye for risk, an understanding of global regulatory frameworks, and strong investigative and reporting skills.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Customer Due Diligence & Enhanced Due Diligence

  • Conduct KYC reviews for high-risk entities (PEPs, complex structures, high-risk jurisdictions).
  • Validate client documents including business licenses, financials, and legal agreements.
  • Identify beneficial owners and perform background screening via tools like World-Check or LexisNexis.

2. Risk Assessment & Investigation

  • Assign risk ratings and escalate high-risk accounts.
  • Monitor transactions for unusual activity and draft investigation reports.
  • Analyze ownership structures to detect red flags.

3. Regulatory Compliance & Reporting

  • Ensure adherence to AML/KYC/CTF laws (FATF, FinCEN, FCA, MAS).
  • Maintain thorough documentation for audits and support SAR filing if needed.

4. Monitoring & Process Improvement

  • Stay current with regulatory trends and emerging risks.
  • Recommend improvements in KYC/EDD practices.
  • Support internal AML/KYC awareness and training initiatives.

Skills & Qualifications:

Education:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in any field.

Experience:

  • 2–10 years of hands-on experience in KYC, AML, EDD, or compliance roles.

Technical Skills:

  • Knowledge of global AML/KYC regulatory frameworks (FATF, OFAC, EU AML).
  • Experience with KYC screening platforms (e.g., World-Check, LexisNexis).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other documentation/reporting tools.

Soft Skills:

  • Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.
  • Ability to operate independently under pressure.

Preferred Certifications:

  • CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist)
  • CAMI (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Investigator)

jobs.title: Product Specialist
jobs.description:
Brand Division: Niklo (Smoking Cessation)

Position Title: Product Specialist

Location: Kochi office-based, with field operations in multiple Kerala cities as part of the pilot implementation phase.

Reports To: Assistant Brand Manager

About Protectol

Protectol Healthcare is an innovation-driven health and wellness company focused on advancing public health, hydration, and disease prevention through high-quality, accessible products.

Beyond its commercial success, Protectol invests deeply in social impact — through initiatives like the Protectol Water Initiative, the Protectol Impact platform, and programs that link health awareness with sustainability and youth empowerment.

About Niklo

Niklo is Protectol's nicotine replacement therapy brand, marketed as Niklo.

With the tagline Let it Go, Niklo encourages smokers to take the first step toward quitting through a 12-week, guided Quit 100 Program that integrates behavioural counselling, digital guidance, and medical education.

Niklo is positioned as a modern, science-backed NRT brand built on Protectol's ethos that Life Matters.

Role Purpose

To build medical awareness, credibility, and adoption of Niklo among doctors and healthcare professionals through education, clinical engagement, and evidence-based promotion — supporting the brand's mission of reducing tobacco dependence through safe, guided NRT therapy.

Key Responsibilities

Conduct educational and scientific discussions with doctors to promote Niklo as a safe and effective Nicotine Replacement Therapy (NRT).

Drive prescription generation through consistent doctor engagement, follow-ups, and clinical support.

Present clinical data, dosage guidance, and patient program details of the 12-week Niklo Quit 100 Program.

Identify and engage key prescribers across general practice, psychiatry, pulmonology, and dentistry.

Support and coordinate CME programs and awareness sessions with hospitals and medical associations.

Track and report doctor coverage, prescription trends, and feedback to guide field strategy.

Ensure all medical communication and promotion are ethical, compliant, and evidence based.

Candidate Profile

Bachelor's degree in pharmacy, Life Sciences, or Allied Health.

1–3 years of experience in medical affairs, doctor engagement, or scientific promotion (preferably in NRT, respiratory, or wellness segments).

Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage and influence healthcare professionals.

Strong scientific aptitude combined with an empathetic, patient-centered mindset.

Highly motivated, well-organized, and passionate about contributing to public health and behavioral-change programs.

Why Join Niklo

Be part of a purpose-driven, science-based brand changing how India approaches smoking cessation.

As a Product Specialist, you'll work at the intersection of health education, doctor collaboration, and social impact, helping people reclaim their lives through knowledge and care.

jobs.title: MD Dermatologist
jobs.description:
An aesthetic doctor diagnoses and treats a variety of skin conditions and performs cosmetic procedures to enhance patients appearance. They provide personalized care and stay updated with the latest advancements in aesthetic medicine.

Responsibilities

  • Patient Consultation: Conduct thorough consultations to understand patients aesthetic goals and medical history.
  • Physical Examinations: Perform skin health assessments and physical examinations.
  • Personalized Treatment Plans: Design treatment plans tailored to patients needs and preferences.
  • Non-Surgical Procedures: Perform cosmetic procedures such as Botox injections, dermal fillers, laser treatments, and chemical peels.
  • Patient Monitoring: Monitor patients progress and make necessary adjustments to treatment plans.
  • Skincare Advice: Advise patients on skincare routines and lifestyle changes to improve aesthetic health.
  • Record Keeping: Maintain accurate and detailed patient records.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Adhere to healthcare regulations and safety standards.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay updated on the latest techniques and technologies in aesthetic medicine.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with other healthcare professionals to provide comprehensive care.

Qualifications and Education Requirements

  • Medical degree (MD) and completion of a residency in dermatology or aesthetic medicine.
  • Board certification or eligibility in dermatology or aesthetic medicine.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Knowledge of dermatological conditions and treatments.
  • Experience with cosmetic procedures and skin surgeries is a plus.

Company Description

Founded with a deep sense of purpose and compassion, NIAC (Niraj Intensive & Anesthesia Care Pvt. Ltd.) started with a mission to bring expert critical care closer to those in need. Beginning as an anesthesia and ICU care service, it has grown into a multi-vertical healthcare organization, including smart ICU setups, tele-ICU monitoring, hospital operations management, home critical care, and clinical staffing solutions. During the COVID-19 pandemic, NIAC managed hundreds of critical care beds across hospitals and homes, showcasing clinical excellence and unshakeable commitment. Today, NIAC continues to expand its healthcare footprint, blending technology with a human touch to elevate care standards.

Role Description

This is a full-time, on-site role for a Consultant Anesthesiologist located in Delhi NCR. The Consultant Anesthesiologist will be responsible for administering anesthesia, providing pain management, and offering critical care services. The role involves working closely with surgeons, critical care nurses, and other medical professionals to ensure the safety and comfort of patients during and after surgical procedures. Responsibilities also include pre-operative assessments, monitoring patients vital signs during surgery, and post-operative care and pain management.

Qualifications

  • Experience in Medicine and Critical Care
  • Knowledgeable in Surgery and relevant clinical procedures
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills
  • Ability to provide compassionate and patient-centered care
  • MD or equivalent degree in Anesthesiology
